title: Conditional preservation of chimera states under equitable network coarse-graining
summary: Chimera states, characterized by the coexistence of coherent and incoherent dynamics in networks of coupled oscillators, are among the most intriguing collective phenomena in nonlinear systems and are strongly shaped by the underlying topology and initial conditions. Their analysis in large-scale networks remains computationally demanding and motivates the development of coarse-graining strategies that reduce network size while retaining the essential dynamical features of chimera behavior. In this Letter, we investigate whether equitable-partition-based quotient graphs can preserve chimera patterns under substantial reductions of network size. Using nonlocally coupled FitzHugh-Nagumo (FHN) oscillators, we exploit the fact that, for an equitable partition, the full-network dynamics restricted to the associated cluster-synchronous subspace coincide exactly with the quotient dynamics. We ask whether this structural exactness is sufficient to preserve chimera signatures after the network size reduction. Our results show that this is not necessarily the case: agreement between quotient and full-network chimera dynamics depends on the equitable partition, and exact quotient dynamics do not necessarily guarantee the transverse stability of the corresponding full-network trajectory. Importantly, when the cluster-synchronous solution becomes transversely unstable, the full network may depart from the exact quotient trajectory while remaining in a macroscopic chimera regime. Therefore, structural exactness and dynamical preservation are distinct requirements, and transverse stability provides a complementary criterion for assessing quotient-based coarse-graining of chimera states.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于公平划分的商图能否在大幅缩减网络规模时保留嵌合态（chimera）模式，发现结构精确性不足以保证动力学保留，横向稳定性是关键补充判据。
AI.motivation: 大规模网络中嵌合态分析计算成本高，需粗粒化策略缩减网络规模同时保留关键动力学特征；商图（quotient graph）是否是有效的粗粒化工具尚不明确。
AI.method: 使用非局域耦合的FitzHugh-Nagumo（FHN）振子网络，利用公平划分下全网络动力学在簇同步子空间上恰等于商动力学这一性质，检验缩减后嵌合特征的保留情况。
AI.result: 商图与全网络的嵌合动力学一致性取决于所选的公平划分；即使商动力学精确，也不能保证对应全网络轨迹的横向稳定性。当簇同步解横向失稳时，全网络可能偏离精确商轨迹，但仍处于宏观嵌合状态。
AI.conclusion: 结构精确性与动力学保留是两个不同要求，横向稳定性为评估基于商图的嵌合态粗粒化提供了补充判据。

title: A Physics-Driven Framework for Parametric Periodic-Flow Modeling and Finite-Amplitude Aeroelastic Response Analysis
summary: Periodic unsteady flows are common in forced-motion and fluid-structure interaction problems. Their parametric analysis typically requires repeated high-fidelity simulations, whereas existing reduced-order and surrogate models generally rely on pre-generated flow-field or aerodynamic data. This study proposes a purely physics-driven framework for solving parametric periodic flows and finite-amplitude aeroelastic responses. First, a Periodic Physics-Informed Neural Network (P-PINN) is developed to directly solve periodic flows by imposing temporal periodicity over a single motion cycle, thereby avoiding the need to resolve the long transient evolution preceding the establishment of the periodic state. The flow conditions and motion parameters are further incorporated as network inputs to construct continuous parametric representations of the periodic flow field and aerodynamic forces. On this basis, the parametric aerodynamic model is coupled with the structural dynamic equation through first-order harmonic balance to solve the response amplitude and frequency of a single-degree-of-freedom aeroelastic system. This framework is validated using forced-motion cases of a circular cylinder and an airfoil, demonstrating accurate reproduction of periodic aerodynamic forces, surface load distributions, and instantaneous flow fields under different flow and motion parameters compared with time-marching results. Furthermore, aeroelastic analysis is conducted for an elastically mounted circular cylinder at subcritical Reynolds numbers, and the resulting aeroelastic response agrees well with fully coupled CFD/CSD results. Once trained offline, the parametric model can be repeatedly evaluated for different structural parameter states, enabling the complete aeroelastic response curve to be obtained online within seconds, without repeated long-time fluid-structure interaction time marching.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种纯物理驱动的周期流与气弹响应参数化求解框架：P-PINN 在单个运动周期上施加时间周期性直接求解周期流，并将流动与运动参数作为网络输入构建连续参数化气动力模型，再与结构动力学方程经一阶谐波平衡耦合求解气弹响应。
AI.motivation: 周期性非定常流在强迫运动与流固耦合问题中常见，但参数化分析需反复高保真模拟；现有降阶/代理模型依赖预生成的流场或气动数据，缺乏纯物理驱动能力。同时传统时间推进需先求解周期态建立前的长瞬态过程，代价高。
AI.method: 1) 提出周期物理信息神经网络 P-PINN，在单个运动周期上施加时间周期性约束，直接求解周期流，避免长瞬态推进；2) 将流动条件与运动参数作为网络输入，构建周期流场与气动力的连续参数化表示；3) 将该参数化气动模型与结构动力学方程通过一阶谐波平衡耦合，求解单自由度气弹系统的响应幅值与频率。
AI.result: 在圆柱与翼型强迫运动算例上验证，能准确复现不同流动与运动参数下的周期气动力、表面载荷分布与瞬时流场，与时间推进结果一致；对亚临界雷诺数下弹性支撑圆柱的气弹分析结果与全耦合 CFD/CSD 结果吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 离线训练完成后，参数化模型可针对不同结构参数状态反复评估，数秒内在线获得完整气弹响应曲线，无需重复长时间流固耦合时间推进，为周期性流动与气弹参数化分析提供了高效纯物理驱动途径。

title: Monte Carlo sampling of first-order QED processes in laser and pulsar plasmas
summary: Monte Carlo sampling of strong-field quantum electrodynamics processes underpins simulations of high-intensity laser experiments and of astrophysical compact-object magnetospheres. Sampling an event requires the total rate of the process together with the cumulative probability that determines how energy is partitioned between the produced particles. Simulations typically tabulate both in advance and invert the tabulated probability numerically. Here we replace this procedure with elementary-function approximations for synchrotron radiation and the nonlinear Breit--Wheeler process. For each process, we approximate the auxiliary function that sets the total rate, as well as the cumulative probability, with Padé approximants chosen so that the inversion reduces to a quartic equation. This yields the sampled quantum parameter---electron $χ_e$ or photon $χ_γ$---in closed form. The approximations and the particle spectra sampled from them agree with the exact results to within $1\%$. The procedure requires no lookup tables, no interpolation, and no numerical root finding, and can be inserted directly into radiative particle-in-cell codes.

AI.tldr: 本文用初等函数（Padé 近似）替代强场 QED 过程蒙特卡洛采样中的预先制表与数值反演，使采样量子参数以闭式（四次方程解）给出，误差 <1%。
AI.motivation: 强场 QED 蒙卡模拟（高强度激光实验、致密天体磁层）通常需预先制表总速率与累积概率并数值反演，流程繁琐、依赖查表和数值求根。
AI.method: 对同步辐射与非线性 Breit-Wheeler 过程，用 Padé 近似同时逼近总速率的辅助函数与累积概率，选取的近似使反演化简为四次方程，从而闭式得到电子 χ_e 或光子 χ_γ。
AI.result: 近似结果及由其所采样的粒子谱与精确结果吻合在 1% 以内；无需查表、插值和数值求根，可直接嵌入辐射 PIC 代码。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为强场 QED 蒙卡采样提供了高效、精确且易于实现的闭式替代方案，便于直接集成到辐射粒子-网格模拟中。

title: Bayesian Monitoring of a Diffusive Particle in One Dimension
comment: 6 pages (main text) + 2 pages (End Matter) + 15 pages (Supplemental Material)
summary: We study the Bayesian monitoring of a single particle diffusing along a line, while an observer tracks it continuously using noisy measurements at each spatial point. The average Shannon entropy $\overline{S(t)}$ associated with the posterior distribution of the particle's position quantifies the uncertainty that remains after conditioning on the sequence of measurements. We map the problem to the calculation of the moments of the partition functions of directed polymers in $1 + 1$ dimensions. For a constant monitoring rate, the entropy remains bounded for any finite measurement intensity and can be quantified using exact results from the Kardar-Parisi-Zhang equation, providing both the saturation value and the asymptotic behavior for long times. For a monitoring intensity that decreases according to a power law $\sim t^{-α}$, two distinct asymptotic regimes emerge: $\overline{S(t)} \simeq \tfrac12 \ln t$ for $α> 1/2$ and $\overline{S(t)} \simeq α\ln t$ for $0 < α< 1/2$. Both results are obtained using the replica method, which maps the problem onto an attractive Lieb-Liniger Hamiltonian with a time-dependent coupling: the two regimes can be understood from a perturbative expansion around free diffusion and around the attractive Lieb-Liniger ground state, respectively. We discuss the limiting case $α= 1/2$ and compare the predictions with simulations of discrete Gaussian and log-gamma polymer models.

AI.tldr: 研究贝叶斯监测下单粒子扩散的香农熵，将其映射到1+1维定向聚合物的配分函数矩，用KPZ方程和复制方法得到熵的长期行为。
AI.motivation: 量化连续噪声测量下粒子位置后验分布的不确定性（平均香农熵），并理解不同监测强度下熵的渐近行为。
AI.method: 将问题映射为1+1维定向聚合物配分函数的矩计算；利用KPZ方程的精确结果处理恒定监测率；用复制方法映射到含时耦合的吸引Lieb-Liniger哈密顿量，分别通过自由扩散微扰展开和吸引Lieb-Liniger基态展开分析幂律衰减监测强度。
AI.result: 恒定监测率下熵有界，可由KPZ方程给出饱和值和长时渐近；监测强度按t^{-α}衰减时出现两个渐近区域：α>1/2时平均熵约(1/2)ln t，0<α<1/2时约α ln t。结果与离散高斯和log-gamma聚合物模型模拟比较。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯监测扩散问题的熵可由聚合物/KPZ及Lieb-Liniger框架精确刻画，不同监测衰减率导致不同的对数发散行为。

title: CTrex: A Research-Oriented Framework for Kernel- and Projection-Level Algorithm Development in CT Reconstruction
summary:
Micro-computed tomography (micro-CT) is increasingly applied to imaging scenarios in which object motion, deformation, truncated fields of view, continuous rotation, or unconventional scanning protocols violate assumptions underlying classical reconstruction pipelines. Existing reconstruction frameworks efficiently support standard geometries and workflows but offer limited control over how projection operators are discretized and evaluated. This restricts methodological exploration when accuracy depends on ray sampling, interpolation, or operator coupling.
  We introduce CTrex, a research-oriented, GPU-accelerated iterative reconstruction framework that exposes the projection-correction-backprojection pipeline down to the kernel level. Rather than treating these operators as fixed black boxes, CTrex represents them as editable computational building blocks within a unified iterative structure. This allows non-ideal acquisition effects to be incorporated directly into the numerical operators rather than treated as external corrections.
  CTrex combines GPU-level accessibility with an extensible geometry formulation based on homogeneous-coordinate view matrices, allowing rigid and affine transformations, detector misalignments, and time-varying geometries to be expressed consistently. It supports circular, helical, offset, and conveyor-belt trajectories while keeping GPU kernels agnostic to the trajectory definition.
  Applications in motion- and deformation-aware reconstruction, event-based 4D imaging, cylindrical-coordinate reconstruction, and extended-field-of-view CT illustrate how operator-level adaptations enable strategies difficult to realize in conventional frameworks. CTrex provides a flexible platform for CT reconstruction research under realistic and unconventional imaging conditions.

AI.tldr: CTrex是一个GPU加速、面向研究的迭代CT重建框架，将投影-校正-反投影流水线开放到内核级别，作为可编辑计算模块，支持非理想几何与轨迹，适应运动、形变、截断视场等场景。
AI.motivation: 现有micro-CT重建框架高效支持标准几何与流程，但把投影算子当作固定黑盒，难以控制离散化和求值方式；当精度依赖射线采样、插值或算子耦合时，方法探索受限。同时真实成像常伴随运动、形变、截断视场、连续旋转或非常规扫描协议，违反经典重建假设。
AI.method: 提出CTrex：GPU加速的迭代重建框架，暴露投影-校正-反投影流水线至内核级。将这些算子表示为可编辑的计算构建块，统一迭代结构；非理想采集效应直接纳入数值算子。基于齐次坐标视图矩阵的可扩展几何表述，支持刚体/仿射变换、探测器失配和时变几何，且GPU内核与轨迹定义解耦。
AI.result: 支持圆形、螺旋、偏移和传送带轨迹；应用于运动与形变感知重建、事件式4D成像、柱坐标重建和扩展视场CT，展示算子级适配可实现传统框架难以实现的策略。
AI.conclusion: CTrex为真实和非常规成像条件下的CT重建研究提供了灵活平台。

title: Fluctuation--Response Relation in Finite-Size Noisy Coupled Phase Oscillators
summary: Fluctuation--response relations (FRRs) provide a fundamental relation between spontaneous fluctuations and the linear response to external perturbations, yet their validity in non-equilibrium systems remains an open problem. In a general class of noisy, finite-size, mean-field models of coupled phase oscillators, we reveal two types of FRRs in the incoherent phase below the synchronization transition. The first, corresponding to the infinite-size limit (I-FRR), involves the convolution between the external force and the correlation function in the time domain. The second, the finite-size counterpart (F-FRR), is governed by finite-size fluctuations and carries a correction factor: a spectrum function whose roots correspond to eigenvalues, or Landau poles, of the linear operator. The finite-size fluctuations are suppressed in the weak-coupling or strong-noise limits, and F-FRR reduces to I-FRR. Our analytical findings are verified by extensive numerical simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了耦合相位振子有限尺寸平均场模型中涨落-响应关系(FRR)的有效性，在同步转变以下的非相干相中揭示了两种FRR：无限尺寸极限的I-FRR和携带谱函数修正因子的有限尺寸F-FRR，二者在弱耦合或强噪声极限下趋于一致，并通过数值模拟验证。
AI.motivation: 涨落-响应关系虽建立了自发涨落与对外部扰动线性响应之间的基本联系，但其在非平衡系统中的有效性仍是未解问题，尤其缺乏对有限尺寸效应的深入理解。
AI.method: 在一类带噪、有限尺寸的耦合相位振子平均场模型中，通过理论分析研究非相干相下的涨落-响应关系，并结合大量数值模拟进行验证。
AI.result: 发现非相干相下存在两类FRR：I-FRR为外部力与关联函数在时域上的卷积；F-FRR由有限尺寸涨落主导，并包含一个谱函数修正因子，其根对应线性算子的本征值(朗道极点)。有限尺寸涨落在弱耦合或强噪声极限下被抑制，F-FRR退化为I-FRR。
AI.conclusion: 该工作阐明了非平衡有限尺寸系统中FRR的修正机制，揭示了有限尺寸涨落与线性算子的谱结构之间的联系，为理解非平衡涨落-响应关系提供了新视角。

title: Stimulation of superconductivity in $d$-wave superconductors
summary: We study the stimulation of superconductivity by an external electromagnetic radiation --- the Eliashberg effect --- in a disordered $d$-wave superconductor. We use the self-consistent Keldysh--Nambu quasiclassical formalism augmented by an inelastic relaxation term to compute the static correction to the pairing amplitude by treating elastic scattering within the Born approximation with the full second-order impurity vertex retained. We find that the clean $d$-wave superconductor shows no enhancement at any frequency: without a momentum relaxation channel a spatially uniform drive produces no absorption, only pair breaking. Elastic impurity scattering restores absorption and with it activates response in the Eliashberg channel. We find enhancement of the pairing amplitude which is confined to a bounded window in frequency, disorder strength, inelastic scattering rate and gap magnitude. Both edges of the window scale with the gap but are set by the competition between quasiparticle redistribution, heating and pair breaking rather than by a feature of the spectrum. Furthermore, in contrast to the $s$-wave when the threshold is pinned at $2Δ$, the upper edge is not pinned to the maximum gap and crosses it as the system approaches the critical temperature.

AI.tldr: 研究无序d波超导体中电磁辐射增强超导电性（Eliashberg效应），发现清洁d波无增强，只有弹性杂质散射恢复吸收后才激活增强，且增强存在有限参数窗口。
AI.motivation: 探究电磁辐射能否增强d波超导（Eliashberg效应），尤其是无序与配对对称性如何影响该效应。
AI.method: 采用自洽Keldysh–Nambu准经典形式，加入非弹性弛豫项，用Born近似并保留完整二阶杂质顶点处理弹性散射，计算配对幅的静态修正。
AI.result: 清洁d波在任何频率均无增强（无非弹性动量弛豫则无不均匀吸收，仅破对）；弹性杂质散射恢复吸收并激活Eliashberg通道。增强局限于频率、无序强度、非弹性散射率和能隙大小的有限窗口，窗口两边缘随能隙标度，但由准粒子再分布、加热与破对的竞争决定，而非谱特征。与s波阈值固定在2Δ不同，上边缘不被最大能隙钉住，并在接近临界温度时穿过它。
AI.conclusion: 无序是d波Eliashberg效应的关键：它通过恢复吸收使配对幅增强成为可能，且增强窗口的参数依赖由弛豫与破对竞争控制。

title: Large-Area SnS Crystals by Controlled Sn-S Chemical Vapor Deposition: Growth Optimization, Morphology, and Raman Characterization
summary: Tin monosulfide (SnS) is a layered IV-VI semiconductor with strong in-plane anisotropy and promising properties for optoelectronic and ferroic applications. However, obtaining large, continuous, and morphologically well-defined SnS crystals remains challenging. Here, we report the growth of large-area SnS crystals using chemical vapor deposition with separate elemental Sn and S precursors. By controlling the precursor temperatures, source positions, substrate temperature, carrier-gas flow, and hydrogen flow, we obtain SnS crystals with lateral dimensions approaching 350 micrometers. The optimized growth occurs with the Sn source at approximately 750 degrees C, the S source at approximately 230 degrees C, and the substrate maintained near 650-680 degrees C, using Ar/H2 flow rates of 120/10 sccm. X-ray diffraction shows a dominant SnS (111) reflection with no detectable secondary crystalline tin-sulfide phase within the measurement sensitivity. Raman spectroscopy reveals six characteristic SnS phonon modes at approximately 39.3, 48.8, 95.2, 165.0, 193.1, and 219.1 cm^-1. In particular, the low-frequency modes near 39 and 49 cm^-1 are clearly resolved with FWHM values of approximately 2.52 and 2.37 cm^-1, respectively. SEM and AFM measurements further show large continuous crystals and a relatively smooth nanoscale surface. Growth on mica produces more regular square and rectangular flakes, with lateral dimensions approaching 300 x 300 micrometers, while crystals grown on SiO2/Si are more frequently fractured or irregular at their edges. These results demonstrate a practical growth window for obtaining large-area SnS crystals suitable for further optical, electrical, and device studies.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过CVD法使用分离的Sn和S前驱体生长出大面积SnS晶体，横向尺寸可达350微米，并系统研究了生长参数优化及衬底影响。
AI.motivation: SnS是具有强面内各向异性的层状IV-VI半导体，在光电子和铁性应用中前景广阔，但获得大面积、连续且形貌良好的SnS晶体仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 采用化学气相沉积法，使用独立的元素Sn和S前驱体，通过调控前驱体温度、源位置、衬底温度、载气流速和氢气流速来优化生长；并用XRD、拉曼光谱、SEM和AFM对晶体进行表征。
AI.result: 优化条件为Sn源约750°C、S源约230°C、衬底约650-680°C、Ar/H2流量120/10 sccm，获得横向尺寸近350微米的晶体；XRD显示主导SnS(111)反射且无二次相；拉曼观察到六个特征声子模（约39.3、48.8、95.2、165.0、193.1、219.1 cm^-1），其中39和49 cm^-1低频模FWHM约2.52和2.37 cm^-1；云母衬底上生成更规则的方形/矩形薄片（约300×300微米），SiO2/Si上则更易破碎或不规则。
AI.conclusion: 研究确定了获得大面积SnS晶体的实用生长窗口，为其后续光学、电学和器件研究提供了基础。

title: Pauli exclusion as a necessary condition for the existence of the H$_2$ + H$^{\bullet}$ atom transfer barrier
summary: The transition state barrier is a foundational concept in chemical kinetics, yet its physical origin is seldom investigated. In this study we analyze the barrier to hydrogen atom transfer in collinear H$_2$+H$^{\bullet}$ on its Born$-$Oppenheimer surface. We extend upon the energy component analysis of chemical bonds to develop an electronic kinetic energy-based interpretation of the transition state barrier. This approach reveals that Pauli exclusion is necessary for the existence of the energy barrier to H$_2$+H$^{\bullet}$ atom transfer, which is consistent with a complementary analysis using absolutely-localized molecular orbitals.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过电子动能分析，揭示泡利排斥是H₂+H•氢原子转移过渡态能垒存在的必要条件。
AI.motivation: 过渡态能垒是化学动力学的基础概念，但其物理起源很少被探究，本文旨在厘清其本质。
AI.method: 在共线H₂+H•的Born-Oppenheimer势能面上，将化学键的能量组分分析推广至基于电子动能的过渡态能垒解释，并用绝对定域分子轨道进行互补分析。
AI.result: 分析表明，泡利排斥对于H₂+H•原子转移能垒的存在是必要的。
AI.conclusion: 过渡态能垒的物理起源可归因于泡利排斥，绝对定域分子轨道分析支持这一结论。

title: Competing magnetic and spin vestigial orders from continuum field theory
summary: We study magnetic systems featuring competing antiferromagnetic and spin-nematic phases, described by dipolar primary and quadrupolar secondary order parameters. While the antiferromagnetic phase breaks time-reversal and spin-rotational symmetries, only spin-rotational symmetry is broken in the nematic phase, which can be understood as a spin-vestigial phase. We develop a classical continuum field theory with independent vector and tensor fields and use mean-field and renormalization group methods to analyze its phases and finite-temperature transitions. We determine the fixed-point structure using an $ε$ expansion about the upper critical dimension of six and track the resulting fixed points to lower dimensions using a perturbative fixed-dimension renormalization group approach. The multicritical fixed point governing the meeting of the antiferromagnetic, nematic, and paramagnetic phases occurs at imaginary coupling throughout the dimensions accessible to our analysis, indicating a first-order transition through the triple point. Away from the triple point, a direct paramagnetic-to-antiferromagnetic transition can be continuous when the tensor mass is sufficiently large, without an intervening vestigial phase. We argue that it is governed by the cubic universality class in $d=3$ and the Ising universality class in $d=2$ for three-component order parameters. The theory also supports a two-step transition with an intermediate spin-nematic phase. The paramagnetic-to-nematic transition is governed by the four-state Potts universality class in $d=2$ and is first order in $d=3$, while the nematic-to-antiferromagnetic transition is generically expected to be continuous and of Ising type in both dimensions. Our results provide a field-theoretical framework for understanding the finite-temperature transitions observed in the candidate Kitaev material Na$_2$Co$_2$TeO$_6$.

AI.tldr: 本文用经典连续场论（含独立矢量与张量场）研究反铁磁与自旋向列竞争相，结合平均场、ε展开与不动点维度重整化群，确定相变类型与普适类。
AI.motivation: 理解反铁磁（破缺时间反演与自旋旋转）与自旋向列（仅破缺自旋旋转的vestigial相）竞争体系的有限温度相变，并为候选Kitaev材料Na2Co2TeO6提供理论框架。
AI.method: 构建含独立矢量与张量序参量的经典连续场论；用平均场与重整化群分析；在上临界维d=6做ε展开求不动点结构，并用微扰固定维重整化群追踪到低维。
AI.result: 控制反铁磁、向列与顺磁三相交汇的多临界不动点在可达维度下均为虚耦合，暗示三重点为一阶；远离三重点，直接顺磁-反铁磁转变在张量质量足够大时可连续，d=3属立方普适类、d=2三组分为Ising类；两步转变中顺磁-向列转变在d=2为四态Potts类、d=3一阶，向列-反铁磁转变一般连续且为Ising类。
AI.conclusion: 该场论框架刻画了反铁磁/自旋向列竞争相的有限温度相变普适性，可解释Na2Co2TeO6中观测到的相变行为。

title: Theory of extrinsic contributions to the full orbital current
summary: The orbital Hall effect (OHE) underpins the emerging field of orbitronics. A complete quantum-mechanical evaluation of the usual orbital-current operator must retain all matrix elements of the position operator, including its band-diagonal differential part; intrinsic calculations based on this full evaluation can differ by orders of magnitude from the conventional truncation. A relaxation-time estimate of disorder effects on the full current has been reported, but a microscopic treatment of extrinsic scattering has remained unavailable because the position operator requires wavevector-off-diagonal density-matrix elements. Here we develop such a theory by solving the quantum kinetic equation for the wavevector-off-diagonal density matrix, including band-structure, field-corrected side-jump, and skew-scattering terms within the non-crossing approximation. We apply the theory to a massive Dirac cone and to the same model with a particle-hole-symmetry-breaking quadratic term. Disorder-generated contributions of order $τ^0$ are generically comparable to the intrinsic current in the metallic regime and cannot be separated from it by simple disorder-strength scaling. For the bare massive Dirac cone the surviving non-crossing extrinsic correction cancels the conventional intrinsic value and leaves a total current exactly twice the quantum correction, whereas particle-hole asymmetry activates conventional skew scattering for disorder with a non-zero third moment, which dominates in sufficiently clean samples. The wavevector-off-diagonal construction is independent of the two-band model and provides a general route to disorder corrections for position-dependent observables in multiband solids.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了轨道霍尔效应的微观无序理论，通过求解波矢非对角密度矩阵的量子动理学方程，揭示外禀散射修正与内禀电流量级相当且不可简单分离。
AI.motivation: 轨道霍尔效应是轨道电子学的核心，但以往对轨道流算符的量子力学评估存在截断问题：完整评估需保留位置算符所有矩阵元（含带对角微分部分），而传统截断与完整评估可差数量级。已有基于弛豫时间的无序效应估算，但因位置算符需要波矢非对角密度矩阵元，外禀散射的微观处理一直缺失。
AI.method: 求解波矢非对角密度矩阵的量子动理学方程，在非交叉近似下纳入能带结构、场修正的side-jump和skew-scattering项。理论应用于大质量狄拉克锥及其带粒子-空穴对称破缺二次项的模型。
AI.result: 无序产生的τ^0量级贡献在金属区普遍与内禀电流相当，且不能通过简单无序强度标度分离。对裸大质量狄拉克锥，存活的外禀修正抵消常规内禀值，总电流恰为量子修正的两倍；粒子-空穴不对称则激活具有非零三阶矩无序的常规skew散射，在足够干净的样品中占主导。
AI.conclusion: 波矢非对角构造独立于双带模型，为多带固体中位置相关可观测量的无序修正提供了通用途径。

title: Full-frequency GW from Cayley-transformed self-energy moments
summary: The dynamical GW self-energy approximation is a key computational tool to provide the fundamental spectrum of electronic systems. We reformulate this approximation, representing the particle and hole parts of the GW self-energy through a highly compact set of Cayley-transformed moment constraints. The Cayley transformation maps real frequencies to the unit circle, keeping the moments bounded as their order increases, ensuring numerical stability and allowing resolution to be focused on an energy range of interest. We calculate these Cayley-transformed moments via an efficient O[N$^4$] scaling contour integration, and from them, construct a Hermitian upfolded Hamiltonian with a linearly scaling dimensionality with system size. A single-shot diagonalization of this effective Hamiltonian gives an explicit full-frequency G0W0 Green's function with manifestly real poles and non-negative spectral weights. This enables quasiparticle energies, satellite features, and their spectral weights to be obtained across the full G0W0 spectrum. Comparisons with exact G0W0 calculations and convergence across the GW100 test set and the larger Chlorophyll A molecule demonstrate substantially faster and more reliable convergence with moment order than an earlier monomial-moment approach. These Cayley moment representations therefore provide a stable, compact, and systematically improvable route to the complete spectral information of zero-temperature GW, without explicit frequency grids, plasmon-pole models and other common approximations, or analytic continuation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用Cayley变换的矩约束重构GW自能，构建厄米上折叠哈密顿量，通过一次对角化获得全频G0W0格林函数，实现稳定快速的谱收敛。
AI.motivation: 传统GW自能计算需要显式频率网格、等离激元极点模型或解析延拓等近似，且单调矩方法收敛慢、数值不稳定。作者希望找到一种稳定、紧凑、可系统改进的方法来获得完整的零温GW谱信息。
AI.method: 将GW自能的粒子与空穴部分表示为Cayley变换后的矩约束；Cayley变换把实频率映射到单位圆，使高阶矩保持有界，保证数值稳定并可聚焦感兴趣的能区。通过O[N^4]标度的围道积分高效计算这些矩，再由其构造维度线性标度的厄米上折叠哈密顿量。
AI.result: 对该有效哈密顿量做单次对角化即可得到显式全频G0W0格林函数，具有实数极点和非负谱权重，可获得准粒子能量、卫星峰及其谱权重。在GW100测试集和叶绿素A分子上，与精确G0W0比较显示该方法随矩阶数收敛比单调矩方法更快更可靠。
AI.conclusion: Cayley矩表示为零温GW的完整谱信息提供了一种稳定、紧凑、可系统改进的途径，无需显式频率网格、等离激元极点模型或其他常见近似，也无需解析延拓。

title: Amplified Memory and Finite-Time Regularity in Driven Non-Hermitian Systems
summary: We study the roles of broken spectra and exceptional points in finite-time driven non-Hermitian fermionic dynamics. We compute the Nambu biorthogonal correlation matrix for this purpose. The imbalanced-pairing Kitaev chain serves as our concrete realization. Transient passage through a broken-spectrum region amplifies preparation memory. The effect survives when the final Hamiltonian returns to a real-spectrum regime. Negative imbalance forces spectral nonpositivity in the static endpoint state. We isolate the genuine drive history by subtracting out this baseline, leaving an excess that is strictly controlled by the accumulated imaginary-energy action and persists over the entire post-ramp time window. A connected longitudinal correlation mirrors this physics. Its slow-ramp growth tracks the corresponding doubled action. Unstable sectors instead continue amplifying post-ramp if the drive halts inside the broken-spectrum region. Exceptional points yield distinct physics. The finite-time propagator and subsystem correlation matrix remain entirely regular near an exceptional endpoint, even as the quasiparticle gap exhibits its characteristic square-root closing. This finite-time regularity reflects the analyticity of the matrix evolution in the endpoint parameter; a diagonalizable endpoint is strictly not required. A diverging long-time crossover eventually reveals the exceptional scale. We halt the drive exactly at the exceptional point to find that the correlation projector and the connected longitudinal correlation share an identical ballisti front. The subsystem saturation length establishes a distinct but comparable spatial scale. Memory and exceptional-endpoint scalings show no divergence across the tested negative-imbalance range. Memory scaling is fixed by the drive and remains insensitive to the specific choice of real-spectrum final endpoint.

AI.tldr: 研究有限时间驱动非厄米费米子动力学中破缺谱与异常点的作用，以失配配对Kitaev链为例，用Nambu双正交关联矩阵计算。
AI.motivation: 探究破缺谱区和异常点在有限时间驱动非厄米费米子动力学中扮演的角色，特别是瞬态通过破缺谱区对制备记忆的放大效应及其与异常点物理的区别。
AI.method: 计算Nambu双正交关联矩阵；以失配配对Kitaev链为实现；通过扣除静态端点基线分离真实驱动历史；分析积累虚能作用、连接纵向关联及有限时间传播子。
AI.result: 穿越破缺谱区放大制备记忆，即使最终哈密顿量回到实谱区仍存在；负失配导致静态端点谱非正性；剩余效应由积累虚能作用严格控制。异常点处有限时间传播子和子系统关联矩阵保持正则，尽管准粒子能隙呈现平方根闭合；长时间交叉发散揭示异常尺度；在异常点处关联投影子与连接纵向关联共享弹道前沿。
AI.conclusion: 有限时间正则在异常端点反映矩阵演化对端点参数的解析性，不需要可对角化端点。记忆与异常端点标度在测试的负失配范围内无发散；记忆标度由驱动决定，对实谱最终端点选择不敏感。

title: Weak-Coupling Pair-Density-Wave from Momentum-Space Nonsymmorphic Symmetry
summary: Pair-density-wave (PDW) order is a superconducting state with a spatially modulated order parameter and is generally subleading to uniform superconductivity within the conventional weak-coupling BCS paradigm. Here, using a twisted bilayer checkerboard-lattice model, we show that momentum-space nonsymmorphic symmetry provides a generic mechanism that can instead promote PDW order to a leading weak-coupling instability. Combining a controlled Wilsonian renormalization-group analysis at charge neutrality with a finite-doping Bethe--Salpeter analysis, we determine the leading ordering tendencies among various competing instabilities. At charge neutrality, two symmetry-related quadratic band touchings support spin-singlet and spin-triplet PDW instabilities for different attractive interactions, whereas repulsive interactions favor quantum Hall insulators and finite-$\mathbf Q$ density-wave orders. Upon doping, the nonsymmorphic symmetry, together with time reversal, protects the Cooper logarithm in the finite-momentum $\mathbf Q$ pairing channel at generic fillings, allowing PDW order to remain a leading instability over the broad doping range studied. This mechanism extends naturally to moiré Chern bands: by breaking time-reversal symmetry while preserving the nonsymmorphic symmetry and inversion, we obtain a fully gapped topological spin-triplet PDW state with BdG Chern number $C_{\text{BdG}}=8$. Our results establish momentum-space nonsymmorphic symmetry as a general weak-coupling route to PDW superconductivity, including topological PDW states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动量空间非对称群对称性可作为弱耦合下使配对密度波(PDW)成为主导失稳的普适机制，并在扭转双层棋盘格模型及莫尔陈带中验证，得到拓扑自旋三重态PDW态(C_BdG=8)。
AI.motivation: 传统弱耦合BCS范式中，空间调制的PDW序参量通常次属于均匀超导。作者希望寻找一种普适机制，能在弱耦合下将PDW提升为主导失稳。
AI.method: 采用扭转双层棋盘格点模型；结合电荷中性处的可控Wilsonian重整化群分析与有限掺杂的Bethe-Salpeter分析，确定各竞争失稳的主导序趋势。
AI.result: 电荷中性处，两个对称相关的二次能带接触点在不同吸引相互作用下支持自旋单态与三重态PDW失稳；排斥作用利于量子霍尔绝缘体与有限Q密度波序。掺杂后，非对称群对称性与时间反演共同保护有限动量Q配对通道的Cooper对数，使PDW在宽掺杂范围内保持主导。破缺时间反演但保留非对称群对称与反演时，获得全隙拓扑自旋三重态PDW态，BdG陈数C_BdG=8。
AI.conclusion: 动量空间非对称群对称性是通向PDW超导(含拓扑PDW态)的一般弱耦合途径。

title: Magnetostrictive properties in Fe$_{4-x}$Co$_{x}$N films: Insight from experiments and first-principles calculations
summary: The ferromagnetic nitride Fe$_{4}$N has attracted attention for application in spintronic devices due to its high spin polarization and large magnetostriction. We present a combined experimental and theoretical study on the magnetostriction of Fe$_{4-x}$Co$_{x}$N films across a wide composition range. The Fe$_{4-x}$Co$_{x}$N films were grown on SrTiO$_{3}$(001) substrates using molecular beam epitaxy, and the magnetostriction constants along the [100] direction ($λ$$_{100}$) and [111] direction ($λ$$_{111}$) were precisely evaluated using an optical cantilever method. The experimental results reveal that $λ$$_{111}$ remains positive in the whole composition range and shows a maximum value of +82 ppm around x = 0.9. The variation in $λ$$_{111}$ with x is much smaller than that in $λ$$_{100}$, for which giant tunability and sign reversal are observed. First-principles calculations show reasonable agreement with the experimental $λ$$_{111}$ for x ${\ge}$ 1.6, but give negative values at lower x, and an exceptionally large negative $λ$$_{111}$ is obtained at x = 0.8, where the Fermi level coincides with a pronounced minority-spin peak in the density of states. The calculated $λ$$_{111}$ depends strongly on the smearing parameter, indicating that the rhombohedral magnetostriction is highly sensitive to the treatment of atomic disorder. The saturation magnetostriction constant ($λ$$_{s}$) derived from $λ$$_{100}$ and $λ$$_{111}$ is also compared with the $λ$$_{s}$ measured for the (001)-oriented polycrystalline Fe$_{4-x}$Co$_{x}$N films, and a possible scenario for deviation between them is discussed. Our findings clarify the basic features of magnetostriction in the Fe$_{4-x}$Co$_{x}$N system, providing essential magnetoelastic parameters for designing nitride-based spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文结合实验与理论研究了Fe$_{4-x}$Co$_{x}$N薄膜的磁致伸缩，揭示了其成分依赖性、符号变化及理论计算的局限性。
AI.motivation: Fe$_{4}$N因高自旋极化和大磁致伸缩在自旋电子器件中有应用前景，但Fe$_{4-x}$Co$_{x}$N体系的磁致伸缩基本特性尚不明确。
AI.method: 用分子束外延在SrTiO$_{3}$(001)上生长Fe$_{4-x}$Co$_{x}$N薄膜，通过光学悬臂法精确测量$λ$$_{100}$和$λ$$_{111}$，并辅以第一性原理计算。
AI.result: $λ$$_{111}$在整个成分范围保持正值，x≈0.9时达最大+82 ppm，变化远小于$λ$$_{100}$（后者有巨大可调性和符号反转）。第一性原理计算在x≥1.6时与实验吻合，但低x时给出负值，x=0.8时异常大负值（费米能级与少数自旋态密度峰重合），且$λ$$_{111}$对展宽参数高度敏感。
AI.conclusion: 研究阐明了Fe$_{4-x}$Co$_{x}$N体系磁致伸缩的基本特征，为氮化物自旋电子器件设计提供了关键磁弹参数。

title: A kinetic model of electron transfer at the electrode-electrolyte interface: Statistical mechanics and electrochemical aspects
summary: A new simulation approach ({\it J. Chem. Phys.} {\bf 163}, 164113), based on the seamless combination of the electron transfer at the electrode/electrolyte interface with the charge and mass transport in electrolyte solutions, holds the promise to advance the comprehensive modeling of basic electrochemical devices such as electrolytic cells and batteries. The underlying model also includes a fully consistent treatment of structural, thermodynamic and statistical properties of the electrical double-layer at non-ideal electron-conducting interfaces. As a result, subtle aspects such as Tafel and Butler-Volmer equations, the overpotential concept, as well as (stationary) non-equilibrium features such as the entropy production, arise naturally from the model, with a minimum of ad-hoc assumptions and elaborations of the simulation results. We illustrate these aspects for a simple model of electrochemical interface, and discuss further improvements of the method meant to enhance its ability to model systems and phenomena of interest for electrochemistry. One such improvement, concerning the effect of fluctuating electric fields on the electron transfer rate, is explicitly developed.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍一种新的电化学模拟方法，将电极/电解质界面的电子转移与电解质中的电荷、质量传输无缝结合，能自然导出Tafel方程、Butler-Volmer方程、过电位及熵产生等特征，并讨论了改进方向。
AI.motivation: 实现对电解池、电池等基本电化学器件的综合建模，并在非理想电子导界面上一致地处理双电层的结构、热力学与统计性质，减少对临时假设和结果后处理的依赖。
AI.method: 基于电极/电解质界面电子转移与电解质中电荷及质量传输的无缝组合的模拟方法，模型包含对双电层结构、热力学和统计性质的完全一致处理；并显式发展了考虑涨落电场对电子转移速率影响的改进。
AI.result: Tafel和Butler-Volmer方程、过电位概念以及（稳态）非平衡特征如熵产生，均以最少临时假设自然地从模型中出现；通过在简单电化学界面模型上的示例加以说明。
AI.conclusion: 该模拟方法有望推进电解池与电池等基本电化学器件的综合建模，并可通过进一步改进（如纳入涨落电场对电子转移速率的影响）增强其模拟电化学相关体系与现象的能力。

title: Defect Poisoning of Quantum Spin Ice
summary: The hunt for a material realization of quantum spin ice has motivated more than two decades of experimental effort. The candidate materials inevitably contain crystal imperfections, such as magnetic vacancies, whose effects are often disregarded. Here, we show that experimentally relevant levels of dilution can qualitatively reshape the low-energy behavior, as nearby vacancies generate quantum fluctuations that are absent in the clean system. Already at dilution levels as low as two percent, well below those reported in cerium-based pyrochlores, these vacancy-induced processes connect percolating clusters of spins and dominate over the conventional quantum-spin-ice dynamics. We therefore argue that magnetic vacancies in current experiments can strongly contaminate, and potentially completely obscure, the sought-after signatures of quantum spin ice. We support these conclusions using large-scale, unbiased quantum Monte Carlo simulations and exact diagonalization.

AI.tldr: 磁性空位即使浓度低至2%，也能产生洁净系统中不存在的量子涨落，连接自旋渗流团簇并主导量子自旋冰动力学，可能污染甚至掩盖量子自旋冰的实验信号。
AI.motivation: 寻找量子自旋冰材料已历经二十多年实验努力，但候选材料不可避免含有磁性空位等晶体缺陷，而这些缺陷的影响通常被忽视。作者希望揭示这些被忽略的空位对低能物理行为的关键作用。
AI.method: 采用大规模无偏量子蒙特卡洛模拟和精确对角化方法进行研究。
AI.result: 在低至2%的稀释浓度（远低于铈基烧绿石中报道的水平）下，空位诱导的量子涨落过程即可连接渗流自旋团簇，并主导传统的量子自旋冰动力学。
AI.conclusion: 当前实验中的磁性空位会强烈污染、甚至可能完全掩盖所寻找的量子自旋冰特征，因此实验分析必须考虑空位效应。

title: Interaction induced flattening of optical transition quantum geometry
summary: The Riemannian geometry of optical transition dipoles has become a useful picture for understanding linear and nonlinear optical response. Here we argue that the interacting quantum geometry of optical transitions possesses a rich structure and can be naturally delineated into two types: localized and delocalized particle-hole excitations. The former possess uniform quantum geometry with flat (vanishing) Hermitian curvature; the latter possess non-uniform quantum geometry with non-vanishing Hermitian curvature. As a striking example, we find that uniform quantum geometry can be produced by electron-hole interactions: even when composed from extended Bloch states in the particle and hole bands, we find excitons have uniform and flat quantum geometry. By developing a many-body length gauge formulation of nonlinear response, we find this uniform and flat excitonic quantum geometry zeros its third-order circular photoconductivity in non-magnetic materials in stark contrast to its non-interacting counterparts. Similarly, the zero Hermitian curvature of localized optical transitions locks their Hall response to that of the ground state. This demonstrates the rich landscape of many-body optical response controlled by an interacting quantum geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出相互作用量子几何分为局域与离域粒子-空穴激发两类，发现激子具有均匀平坦的量子几何，这使三阶圆光电导在非磁材料中为零，并锁定霍尔响应等于基态。
AI.motivation: 理解线性与非线性光学响应需要新的几何图像，而现有研究多关注非相互作用光学跃迁的黎曼几何，缺乏对相互作用（多体）量子几何结构及其对非线性光学响应影响的刻画。
AI.method: 构建非线性响应的多体长度规范（length gauge）理论框架，将光学跃迁的量子几何区分为局域与离域粒子-空穴激发，并分析其厄米曲率（均匀/平坦 vs 非均匀/非零），以激子作为典型案例。
AI.result: 离域激发具有非均匀量子几何和非零厄米曲率；局域激发具有均匀平坦（消失）厄米曲率的量子几何。电子-空穴相互作用可产生均匀量子几何：即使由扩展布洛赫态构成，激子仍具有均匀平坦量子几何，从而使非磁材料的三阶圆光电导为零，与非相互作用情形形成鲜明对比；局域光学跃迁的零厄米曲率则将其霍尔响应锁定为基态响应。
AI.conclusion: 多体光学响应由相互作用量子几何调控，局域与离域激发展现出丰富的光学响应景观，为理解和设计非线性光学现象提供了新框架。

title: Strong-Field-Driven Non-Linear Electron Dynamics in Thiophene Oligomers
summary: The interaction between conjugated molecules and intense electric field pulses drives a plethora of intriguing nonlinear phenomena, including optical limiting. While excited-state absorption was recently identified as the primary mechanism for this effect in thiophene oligomers, open questions remain regarding field-dependent population dynamics under intense laser driving. Using real-time time-dependent density functional theory combined with a determinant-overlap population framework, we track the intensity-dependent nonlinear response of a single thiophene ring (1T) and quaterthiophene (4T) as prototypical members of the oligothiophene family with different length and symmetry. We demonstrate that extended $π$-conjugation in 4T lowers nonlinear excitation thresholds by orders of magnitude compared to 1T. State-resolved population dynamics reveal complete ground-state depletion accompanied by sequential excited-state absorption channels under intense driving. High-harmonic generation spectra explicitly reflect molecular symmetry constraints, while energy-resolved occupation densities confirm continuous orbital redistribution across the $π^*$-manifold. This work provides dynamic physical insights for engineering organic materials with tailored nonlinear optical properties.

AI.tldr: 该工作用实时含时DFT结合行列式重叠布居分析，追踪单噻吩环(1T)与四联噻吩(4T)在强激光场下的非线性响应，揭示扩展π共轭大幅降低非线性激发阈值，并阐明基态耗尽、顺序激发态吸收、高次谐波对称约束及π*轨道连续重分布等机制。
AI.motivation: 共轭分子与强电场脉冲相互作用会产生光学限幅等非线性现象，此前虽已确认激发态吸收是噻吩寡聚物的主导机制，但在强激光驱动下的场依赖布居动力学仍不清楚。
AI.method: 结合实时含时密度泛函理论(rt-TDDFT)与行列式重叠布居框架。
AI.result: 4T中扩展π共轭使非线性激发阈值比1T低几个数量级；态分辨布居显示强驱动下基态完全耗尽并伴随顺序激发态吸收通道；高次谐波谱反映分子对称性约束；能量分辨占据密度确认π*流形上的连续轨道重分布。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为设计具有定制非线性光学性质的有机材料提供了动态物理见解。

title: Multidimensional dynamical centrality from Green functions in complex networks
summary: Conventional centrality measures provide compact descriptions of node importance, but they emphasize specific structural relations and do not directly resolve the temporal and spectral organization of dynamical perturbation responses. Building on the Green function of a linearized networked system, we develop a multidimensional framework for dynamical node characterization. From the same response function, we extract three complementary indicators---Influence, Efficiency, and Distortion---that quantify cumulative response strength, temporal rate of response, and spectral concentration, respectively, together with a contribution matrix that resolves these quantities into source--target pathways. As a numerical demonstration, we apply the framework to weighted Kuramoto--Sakaguchi dynamics on heterogeneous Barabási--Albert networks. The three indicators distinguish implanted dynamical node classes through complementary dimensions of the perturbation response, while remaining strongly coupled to conventional topological centralities. These results demonstrate how a common dynamical response can be decomposed into distinct, physically interpretable characteristics rather than represented by a single aggregate descriptor. We finally discuss the scope and limitations of the linear-response assumption and extensions to time-dependent and nonlinear regimes.

AI.tldr: 基于线性化网络系统的Green函数，提出一个多维动态节点表征框架，从同一响应函数中提取Influence、Efficiency、Distortion三个互补指标及贡献矩阵，并在加权Kuramoto-Sakaguchi动力学上验证其能区分植入的动态节点类别。
AI.motivation: 传统中心性度量虽能简洁描述节点重要性，但侧重特定结构关系，无法直接刻画动态扰动响应在时间与谱上的组织方式。
AI.method: 以线性化网络系统的Green函数为基础，从同一响应函数中提取三个互补指标：Influence（累积响应强度）、Efficiency（响应时间速率）、Distortion（谱集中度），并构建贡献矩阵将各指标分解为源-目标路径；在异构Barabási-Albert网络的加权Kuramoto-Sakaguchi动力学上做数值验证。
AI.result: 三个指标从扰动响应的互补维度成功区分植入的动态节点类别，同时与传统拓扑中心性保持强耦合，表明单一动态响应可被分解为多个具有物理可解释性的特征。
AI.conclusion: 动态节点重要性不应由单一聚合描述子表示，而可分解为多个物理可解释特征；文中还讨论了线性响应假设的适用范围与局限，以及向时变和非线性情形的推广。

title: Majorana zero modes in half-quantum vortices of pair density wave superconductors
summary: Pair-density-wave (PDW) superconductors admit half-quantum vortices that can bind Majorana zero modes, but whether such defects are energetically stabilized in microscopic models remains unclear. We address this question in a spinless honeycomb-lattice model with a PDW phase. Microscopic Hartree-Fock calculations determine the superfluid stiffness $ρ$ and PDW relative-phase stiffness $κ$, and show that $κ/ρ$ approaches unity near the continuous PDW--Dirac-semimetal transition, strongly reducing the long-wavelength cost of vortex fractionalization. Combining this with microscopically extracted Ginzburg--Landau couplings, we show that vortex-core energetics favor fractionalization, producing a strongly enhanced splitting scale and a field-driven full-vortex--to--half-vortex lattice transition. We determine the resulting two-flavor half-vortex lattice structure and construct the associated Majorana lattice. Majorana hybridization produces geometry- and flux-dependent bands with Dirac nodes and zero-energy Fermi lines. Together, these results establish a microscopic route from PDW superconductivity to field-induced half-vortex and Majorana lattices.

AI.tldr: 该文在无自旋蜂窝晶格PDW模型中，用微观Hartree-Fock计算证明半量子涡旋可被能量稳定，并给出场诱导的半涡旋与Majorana晶格。
AI.motivation: PDW超导体理论上可承载束缚Majorana零模的半量子涡旋，但在具体微观模型中这类缺陷是否能量稳定尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在无自旋蜂窝晶格PDW相模型中进行微观Hartree-Fock计算，确定超流刚度ρ与PDW相对相位刚度κ，并提取Ginzburg-Landau耦合系数来分析涡旋核心能量学。
AI.result: κ/ρ在连续PDW-Dirac半金属转变附近趋近1，显著降低涡旋分数化的长波成本；涡旋核心能量学偏好分数化，导致增强的分裂尺度及场驱动的全涡旋到半涡旋晶格转变；构建的Majorana晶格具有几何与磁通依赖的能带、Dirac节点和零能Fermi线。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果建立了从PDW超导到场诱导半涡旋及Majorana晶格的微观路径。

title: Influence of chemical vapor deposition conditions on N incorporation ratio on vicinal 4H-SiC(000-1) surface: Ab Initio-based approach
summary: In experimental studies, increasing the ratio of source gases (C3H8/SiH4; C/Si ratio) for chemical vapor deposition (CVD) causes the growth rate to increase monotonically, and nitrogen incorporation tends to decrease accordingly; however, a unique phenomenon has been observed in which nitrogen incorporation increases discontinuously in the range of C/Si ratio between 1.0 and 1.5. This phenomenon is specific to the vicinal 4H-SiC(000-1) C-face and is not observed on the vicinal 4H-SiC(0001) Si-face. In this study, N incorporation behavior on a vicinal C-face during CVD is investigated using an ab initio-based approach. The calculation results suggest that when C/Si ratio is less than 1.0, the Si-terminated step edge is stable, whereas when C/Si ratio exceeds 1.0, the existence probability of the C-H-terminated step edge, where the N substitution energy is lower than in the former case, increases sharply. This change in the step-edge state across C/Si = 1.0 is thought to be the cause of the discontinuous increase in N incorporation.

AI.tldr: 本文用从头算方法研究C面4H-SiC在CVD过程中C/Si比变化下N掺入行为的异常现象。
AI.motivation: 实验发现C/Si比在1.0–1.5之间时N掺入量不连续增加，且该现象仅出现在4H-SiC(000-1)C面，机理尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用基于从头算（ab initio）的方法，考察邻位C面台阶边缘随C/Si比变化的结构稳定性及N替代能。
AI.result: C/Si<1.0时Si终止台阶边缘稳定；C/Si>1.0时C-H终止台阶边缘出现概率骤增，且其N替代能低于前者。
AI.conclusion: 台阶边缘状态在C/Si=1.0处的转变是N掺入不连续增加的原因。

title: A Task-Based Framework for Evaluating Raman Spectral Quality Measures
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Supporting Information (13 pages) is provided as an ancillary file. Code and aggregate results: https://github.com/PuppyQ08/Raman_quality_measure
summary: Raman spectral preprocessing and enhancement are often evaluated by comparing output spectra with a reference. Interpreting these comparisons requires evidence that spectral quality measures reflect downstream task performance. We present a controlled-perturbation framework for testing this relationship. Five perturbation types (baseline distortion, independent noise, correlated noise, a global wavenumber shift, and nonlinear axis warping) generate paired changes in a spectral measure (metric harm) and in downstream performance (task harm). An alignment gap (AG) quantifies how much the relationship between metric harm and task harm changes with perturbation type. Ordering concordance (OC) measures how often a metric correctly ranks two conditions by their task harm. The framework evaluates thirteen outputs (MSE, RMSE, MAE, NMSE, spectral angle, Pearson correlation, Wasserstein distance, a structure-to-noise ratio, peak precision, recall, F1, artifact ratio, and missing ratio). Three public datasets provide bacterial classification, sugar-mixture quantification, and mineral identification tasks. PCA with logistic regression, partial least squares regression, and cosine library matching supply the task outcomes. Classifiers and calibrations are fitted either to unperturbed training spectra or to each perturbed training condition, then evaluated on the same perturbed test spectra. Mineral queries are compared with an unchanged or correspondingly perturbed library. The resulting comparisons identify task-specific strengths and limitations, including cases where better ordering does not accompany a smaller AG. Removing axis perturbations and comparing spectra on a common physical grid test how these findings depend on the evaluation design. The framework provides a reproducible procedure for assessing existing measures and testing new candidates against downstream task performance.

AI.tldr: 提出受控扰动框架，检验拉曼光谱质量指标与下游任务性能的关系，用对齐差距(AG)和排序一致性(OC)评估13种输出指标在3个数据集上的表现。
AI.motivation: 拉曼光谱预处理与增强常通过输出光谱与参考光谱的比较来评估，但需证明光谱质量指标能反映下游任务性能。
AI.method: 五种扰动（基线畸变、独立噪声、相关噪声、全局波数偏移、非线性轴扭曲）产生指标损害与任务损害的成对变化；AG量化两者关系随扰动类型的变化，OC衡量指标对任务损害的排序正确率；评估13种指标，使用3个公共数据集（细菌分类、糖混合物定量、矿物识别），采用PCA+逻辑回归、PLS回归、余弦库匹配，并考察去除轴扰动的影响。
AI.result: 识别出各指标任务特异性的优势与局限，包括排序更好但AG未更小的情况。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为评估现有指标及检验新候选指标提供了可复现的下游任务性能关联程序。

title: Compact representation of strongly correlated Green's functions: the MOR+EC way to explore phase space
summary: Repeated evaluation of the single-particle Green's function (GF) across parameter space is a recurring bottleneck in many-body methods, limiting the resolution at which phase boundaries may be probed and the frequency resolution of computed spectra. We introduce MOR+EC, a framework that constructs reusable reduced-order models for computing single-particle Green's functions by combining eigenvector continuation (EC) for parameter space exploration and model order reduction (MOR) for extrapolation in frequency space. Contrary to conventional parameterized MOR, we construct these reduced-order models with a parameter-independent resolvent, further reducing the number of required full-space evaluations. Benchmarking against exact diagonalization as the impurity solver for our example case of DMFT calculations for single- and two-band models, MOR+EC reproduces the DMFT-converged impurity GF to an average relative error of $\sim10^{-4}$, with a median wall-time speedup of $16-91\times$. This accuracy and efficiency together resolve a fine-grained scan of the impurity occupation as doping is tuned and produce a high-resolution phase diagram of an orbital-selective Mott transition. The reduced-order model also reproduces real- and imaginary-frequency spectra at no additional cost in full-space evaluations. This framework applies broadly to GF-based methods requiring repeated parametric evaluation and high resolution of the frequency axis.

AI.tldr: 提出MOR+EC框架，通过结合特征向量连续(EC)与模型降阶(MOR)，构造可复用的降阶模型高效计算单粒子格林函数，实现16-91倍加速且保持高精度。
AI.motivation: 多体方法中反复在参数空间评估单粒子格林函数是常见瓶颈，限制了相边界探测的分辨率和计算谱的频率分辨率。传统参数化MOR仍需大量全空间计算。
AI.method: 将特征向量连续(EC)用于参数空间探索、模型降阶(MOR)用于频率空间外推，构造参数无关resolvent的降阶模型，减少全空间评估次数。以精确对角化作为杂质求解器，在单带和双带DMFT中验证。
AI.result: 相对于精确对角化，重现DMFT收敛的杂质格林函数平均相对误差约10^-4，中位墙钟时间加速16-91倍；可高分辨扫描杂质占据数并生成轨道选择性Mott转变的精细相图，且无额外代价复现实频和虚频谱。
AI.conclusion: MOR+EC适用于需要重复参数评估和高频分辨率的各类基于格林函数的方法，兼顾精度与效率。

title: Power-law growth of shift current with superlattice period in flat Chern bands
summary: Quantum geometry governs a wide array of physical observables in topological quantum materials. In its ideal limit, quantum geometry yields exact bounds and analytical results for a growing class of observables. However, a comparable framework for the shift current remains elusive because it depends on geometric relations between multiple bands. In this work, we show that the shift current is proportional to the cyclotron shift, the displacement of the cyclotron center induced by Landau-level mixing. This mechanism yields a universal scaling law: the integrated weight and the peak magnitude scale as $l^{i+1-n}$ and $l^{2i+1-n}$ in the magnetic length or moiré period $l$, where $n$ is the momentum order of the symmetry-breaking perturbation and $ΔE \propto l^{-i}$ is the level spacing. We verify the scaling law in exactly solvable chiral-$N$ Landau levels under a uniform magnetic field and in Schrödinger and Dirac moiré skyrmion crystals, which capture the flat Chern bands of twisted MoTe$_2$ and twisted bilayer graphene. For a Schrödinger flat band with a distorted skyrmion texture, the integrated weight grows linearly with the moiré period and the resonant peak grows cubically.

AI.tldr: 本文证明位移电流正比于回旋位移（Landau能级混合引起），并给出以磁长度或摩尔周期l的普适标度律，在多个体系中验证。
AI.motivation: 量子几何对许多拓扑材料观测量给出精确界限与解析结果，但位移电流因涉及多带几何关系而缺乏类似框架。
AI.method: 建立位移电流与回旋位移（Landau能级混合导致的回旋中心位移）之间的正比关系，推导积分权重与峰值幅度的标度律l^{i+1-n}和l^{2i+1-n}，并在手性N Landau能级、均匀磁场及Schrödinger与Dirac摩尔skyrmion晶格中验证。
AI.result: 标度律在精确可解的手性N Landau能级及模拟扭转MoTe₂与扭转双层石墨烯平带Chern带的摩尔skyrmion晶体中得到验证；对扭曲skyrmion织构的Schrödinger平带，积分权重随摩尔周期线性增长，共振峰呈三次增长。
AI.conclusion: 位移电流可由回旋位移机制统一描述，其标度行为由对称性破缺微扰的动量阶数n和能级间距指数i决定，为多带几何观测量的普适框架提供新途径。

title: Eigenoperator Entanglement Statistics in Local Lindbladians
summary: Random matrix spectral statistics are widely used to diagnose quantum chaos in open systems, but whether chaotic eigenvalue correlations are accompanied by Haar-typical eigenoperators remains unclear. We study the operator-entanglement statistics of Liouvillian eigenoperators with near-maximal entanglement, analogous to states near the middle of the spectrum in Hamiltonian systems. Using the Kullback-Leibler divergence, we show that Haar-random statistics accurately describe both the Ginibre and class-AI$^\dagger$ Gaussian ensembles. For purely dissipative random Lindbladians, we find that locality of the jump operators drastically alters the eigenoperator-entanglement statistics. Nonlocal Lindbladians remain relatively close to Haar-random behavior, whereas local Lindbladians deviate increasingly from random-matrix statistics with system size. Moreover, unlike in Hamiltonian systems, the most highly entangled eigenoperators of local Lindbladians do not generally lie in the region of largest density of states, owing to the clustered structure of the complex eigenspectrum. We introduce an iterative $σ$-clipping scheme to extract the high-entanglement distribution without preselecting a spectral window, and find that it is Gaussian for nonlocal Lindbladians but log-normal for local ones. Remarkably, the same log-normal distribution, with no additional fitting, also describes dissipative mixed-field Ising chains belonging to distinct non-Hermitian symmetry classes. Our results therefore point to a universal eigenoperator-entanglement distribution for local Lindbladians that is not captured by generic non-Hermitian random-matrix ensembles.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Liouvillian本征算符的纠缠统计，发现局域Lindbladian的高纠缠度分布呈普适对数正态分布，无法用一般非厄米随机矩阵系综解释。
AI.motivation: 随机矩阵谱统计常用于诊断开放系统的量子混沌，但混沌本征值关联是否伴随Haar典型本征算符尚不明确。
AI.method: 用Kullback-Leibler散度分析Ginibre与class-AI†高斯系综，研究纯耗散随机Lindbladian的本征算符纠缠，并提出迭代σ-clipping方案提取高纠缠分布。
AI.result: Haar随机统计能准确描述两类系综；非局域Lindbladian接近Haar随机行为，局域Lindbladian随尺寸增大偏离随机矩阵统计并呈对数正态分布；相同对数正态分布也描述不同非厄米对称类的耗散混合场Ising链。
AI.conclusion: 局域Lindbladian存在普适的本征算符纠缠分布，不能被一般非厄米随机矩阵系综捕捉。

title: A Renormalized Ginzburg-Landau Framework for Dimensional Crossover and Fluctuation Specific Heat in High-$T_c$ Superconductors in a Magnetic Field
summary: This paper presents a theoretical analysis of phase transitions and critical phenomena in high-temperature superconductors using a renormalized Ginzburg-Landau framework. Rather than assuming a conventional linear temperature dependence, we treat the quadratic coefficient as a self-consistent, Hartree-renormalized quantity determined by fluctuation-loop corrections. This renormalization regularizes mean-field divergences and yields a finite, dimensionality-dependent specific-heat anomaly near the transition. When an external magnetic field is applied, minimal coupling quantizes order-parameter fluctuations into discrete Landau levels, reducing the effective dimensionality via an effective spectral dimension. In this framework, the intrinsic fluctuation-coupling strength self-consistently determines the temperature width of the critical Ginzburg region, while the cyclotron energy of the quantized fluctuations uniquely establishes both the specific-heat peak position and the upper-critical-field crossover boundary. Comparison with $\text{YBa}_2\text{Cu}_3\text{O}_{7-δ}$ experimental data demonstrates that this approach captures the suppression of the sharp mean-field discontinuity and accurately reproduces the vortex-lattice topological structure under finite magnetic fields.

AI.tldr: 用重整化Ginzburg-Landau框架分析高温超导体的相变与临界现象，将二次项系数作为Hartree重整化量，解释比热异常、磁场下有效维度降低及YBCO实验数据。
AI.motivation: 常规线性温度依赖的平均场理论无法描述高温超导体相变附近的有限比热异常、临界区宽度及磁场下的行为，需要引入涨落修正的自洽重整化处理。
AI.method: 将Ginzburg-Landau二次系数视为由涨落环修正决定的Hartree重整化自洽量；外加磁场时通过最小耦合把序参量涨落量子化为离散Landau能级，引入有效谱维度降低有效维度。
AI.result: 重整化消除了平均场发散，给出有限且依赖维度的比热异常；涨落耦合强度自洽决定临界Ginzburg区温度宽度，回旋能量同时决定比热峰位与上临界场交叉边界；与YBa2Cu3O7-δ数据对比能再现平均场突变被抑制及有限磁场下涡旋晶格拓扑结构。
AI.conclusion: 该重整化Ginzburg-Landau框架可统一描述高温超导体的临界比热行为与磁场效应，并与YBCO实验吻合。

title: Beyond the Kagome Layer: Interlayer Origin of the Flat Band in FeSn
summary: Kagome FeSn exhibits an occupied flat band at its terminated surface, whereas bulk FeSn adopts A-type antiferromagnetic order and does not display the same feature. Here, we combine density functional theory with primitive- and doubled-cell analysis and a double-layer tight-binding model to determine how interlayer electronic coupling and magnetic stacking control flat-band formation in FeSn. We identify an occupied Fe-$d_{z^2}$-derived flat-band manifold in the ferromagnetic state that is consistent with the experimentally observed surface feature. Brillouin-zone folding reveals that its flat branch originates from the $k_z=\fracπ{c}$ sector of the primitive cell, demonstrating that it cannot be understood as an isolated kagome-layer state. Instead, the state depends on coupling between neighboring kagome layers and can be seen as a result of antibonding coupling between nearest neighbor kagome layers. A double-layer tight-binding analysis identifies interlayer Fe-Fe hopping as the dominant microscopic coupling responsible for this behavior, while a contrasting unoccupied flat-band-related manifold is governed primarily by intralayer Fe-Sn hybridization. These results establish interlayer coupling and magnetic stacking as key control parameters for kagome flat bands and highlight how coupling between layers can generate and tune extended correlated-electron states in quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 通过DFT、原胞/双胞分析与双层紧束缚模型，揭示FeSn中占据平带源于层间Fe-Fe反键耦合，而非孤立kagome层态，层间耦合与磁堆叠是关键调控参数。
AI.motivation: Kagome FeSn表面存在占据平带，但块体呈A型反铁磁序且不显示该特征，需厘清层间电子耦合与磁堆叠如何控制平带形成。
AI.method: 结合密度泛函理论、原胞与双胞分析及双层紧束缚模型，研究FeSn的层间耦合与磁堆叠对平带的影响机制。
AI.result: 铁磁态中存在与实验表面特征一致的占据Fe-d_z²平带流形；布里渊区折叠表明其平坦分支源自原胞的k_z=π/c扇区，源于相邻kagome层间反键耦合；双层紧束缚分析显示层间Fe-Fe跃迁为主导微观耦合，而对照的未占据平带流形主要受层内Fe-Sn杂化支配。
AI.conclusion: 层间耦合与磁堆叠是kagome平带的关键控制参数，层间耦合可产生并调控量子材料中的扩展关联电子态。

title: A System-Independent Metadynamics Strategy for Reactive Training Data: Application to Gas-Phase Organic Reactions
summary: General-purpose machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for organic reactions need to be accurate on both the minimum energy path (MEP) for static evaluation of basic properties and the broader configurational space for simulating reaction dynamics. Existing general datasets for gas-phase organic reactions rely on quasi-static relaxation that confines configurations to the MEP vicinity, so models trained on them could fail on direct molecular-dynamics trajectories; the gap is methodological, not a question of dataset size. We introduce a spatiotemporally resolved, system-independent collective variable (CV): Cartesian RMSD within randomly partitioned local domains against an expanding list of time-averaged reference geometries. The CV drives metadynamics as the main exploration engine, supplemented by structural relaxation towards transition state (TS) to augment the coverage around TS. Within a concurrent-learning workflow, this produces OpenRxn26, a dataset of 1.8~M DFT-labeled configurations covering neutral singlet unimolecular reactions in the H/C/N/O chemical space ($N_\mathrm{heavy} \leq 30$), containing reactive atomic environments underrepresented in community datasets. Trained on OpenRxn26, a DPA3 model (denoted DPA3_rxn) achieves transferable accuracy on barrier heights and reaction energies. On off-MEP reactive trajectories, DPA3_rxn is the only model in the benchmark suite to reach 1.0 kcal/mol energy accuracy compared with the labeling method, where the domain MLIP leading on static benchmarks degrades several-fold (e.g. MACE_OMol25), showing the insufficiency of quasi-static sampling and MEP-anchored benchmarks for guaranteeing dynamics reliability of MLIPs. OpenRxn26 thus provides MD-ready reactive training data for gas-phase neutral singlet organic reactions, verifying the generality and efficiency of the sampling strategy.

AI.tldr: 提出时空分辨的集合变量与并发学习流程，构建覆盖反应动力学的 OpenRxn26 数据集，训练出在离MEP轨迹上达到1.0 kcal/mol精度的 DPA3_rxn 模型。
AI.motivation: 现有气相有机反应通用数据集依赖准静态弛豫，将构型限制在最小能量路径（MEP）附近，导致模型在直接分子动力学轨迹上失效；这是采样方法学问题，而非数据集规模问题。
AI.method: 提出系统无关的时空分辨集合变量（随机划分局部域内的笛卡尔RMSD，对扩展的时间平均参考几何），用以驱动元动力学作为主探索引擎，并辅以向过渡态的结构弛豫以增强TS附近覆盖；在并发学习流程中生成 OpenRxn26 数据集（1.8M DFT标注构型，H/C/N/O 中性单重态单分子反应，重原子数≤30）。
AI.result: 训练的 DPA3_rxn 模型在势垒高度和反应能上具备可迁移精度；在离MEP反应轨迹上，它是基准套件中唯一达到1.0 kcal/mol能量精度的模型，而静态基准领先的 MACE_OMol25 等域内MLIP误差退化了数倍。
AI.conclusion: OpenRxn26 为气相中性单重态有机反应提供了MD可用的反应训练数据，并验证了该采样策略的通用性与效率；同时表明准静态采样与MEP锚定基准不足以保证MLIP的动力学可靠性。

title: Altermagnetic Kondo Logic via Floquet Symmetry Conversion
summary: A common belief in Kondo physics is that a magnetic impurity can act as an efficient probe of key properties of its host bath. In altermagnets, however, this intuition fails in a symmetry-enforced way: the momentum-dependent spin splitting cancels in the local impurity spectrum, making a conventional single-impurity Kondo resonance essentially blind to the altermagnetic form factor. Here, we overcome this constraint by introducing Floquet symmetry conversion. We show that an in-plane AC field converts the hidden altermagnetic spin splitting into a locally detectable spin-dependent hybridization channel, which is further amplified by Kondo correlations into a novel altermagnetic Kondo effect. Remarkably, the Kondo splitting exhibits a nontrivial dependence on the field orientation and inherits the same crystalline form factor as the altermagnetic host, thereby serving as Kondo tomography of altermagnetic spin splitting. This field-controlled response further provides a natural route to symmetry-controlled Kondo logic gates. Our results establish a field-controllable altermagnetic Kondo effect, linking symmetry-resolved impurity spectroscopy to Kondo logic functionality.

AI.tldr: 该文提出Floquet对称转换方法，用面内AC场将交替磁体中隐藏的自旋劈裂转化为局域可探测的自旋相关杂化通道，放大为新型交替磁Kondo效应，实现Kondo层析与对称控制逻辑门。
AI.motivation: 在交替磁体(altermagnet)中，动量依赖的自旋劈裂在局域杂质谱中因对称性而抵消，导致传统单杂质Kondo共振对交替磁形式因子"失明"，无法用磁性杂质探测宿主关键性质。
AI.method: 引入Floquet对称转换：对交替磁宿主施加面内AC场，使隐藏的自旋劈裂转化为局域可探测的自旋相关杂化通道，并利用Kondo关联将其放大。
AI.result: Kondo劈裂对场取向呈现非平凡依赖，并继承与交替磁宿主相同的晶体形式因子，可作为交替磁自旋劈裂的Kondo层析手段。
AI.conclusion: 结果建立了一种场可控的交替磁Kondo效应，将对称分辨的杂质谱学与Kondo逻辑功能联系起来，为对称控制的Kondo逻辑门提供途径。

title: Intriguing topological superconductor phases in long-range extended Kitaev models: an interplay between sub-lattices and power-law interaction
summary: The power-law profile of hopping and superconductivity introduces rich critical phenomena that are not possible to explore in the nearest-neighbor models. Having this in mind, we construct the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH)-Kitaev model with mono-, bi-, and tri-partite sub-lattices where superconductivity [hopping] is of power-law Kitaev [SSH] type. The long-range (LR) superconductivity can alone gap out the zero-momentum critical line while LR hopping alters the finite-momentum critical line. There exists open-ended critical line at vanishing superconducting gap on the phase diagram for all versions of the SSH-Kitaev model. Interestingly, LR superconductivity (hopping) promotes massive Dirac (Majorana zero) modes, while in a finite-size system, their emergence in open boundary conditions is caused by the bulk gap of the anti-periodic Hamiltonian in momentum space. This indicates an unconventional bulk-boundary correspondence for power-law models as compared to what is seen in the short-range models. Importantly, the thermodynamic phase boundaries are correctly reproduced by the above unconventional correspondence. Intriguingly, an even (odd) number of sub-lattices yields an integer (half-integer) winding number while the massive Dirac modes continue to survive irrespective of the sub-lattice profile as long as there exists LR pairing only.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了具有单、双、三子晶格的 SSH-Kitaev 模型，其中跃迁(SSH)与超导(Kitaev)均为幂律长程类型，揭示了长程配对与长程跃迁对临界线的不同影响、非常规体-边对应及子晶格数对缠绕数的影响。
AI.motivation: 近邻模型无法探索幂律型跃迁与超导带来的丰富临界现象，因此需要构建长程 SSH-Kitaev 模型来研究长程相互作用下的临界行为与拓扑性质。
AI.method: 构建含单、双、三子晶格的 SSH-Kitaev 模型，其中超导为幂律 Kitaev 型、跃迁为幂律 SSH 型；分析零动量与有限动量临界线、能隙、Dirac/Majorana 模式，并借助反周期哈密顿量的体态能隙解释开边界下模式的涌现，进而检验体-边对应。
AI.result: 长程超导可单独打开零动量临界线能隙，长程跃迁改变有限动量临界线；各版本模型相图中均存在超导能隙消失处的开放临界线。长程超导促成大质量 Dirac 模式，长程跃迁促成 Majorana 零模；有限尺寸开边界下其涌现由动量空间反周期哈密顿量的体态能隙决定，体现非常规体-边对应，并正确重现热力学相边界。偶数(奇数)子晶格给出整数(半整数)缠绕数。
AI.conclusion: 长程 SSH-Kitaev 模型展现出与短程模型不同的非常规体-边对应，且只要存在长程配对，大质量 Dirac 模式便不依赖子晶格剖面而持续存在；子晶格数的奇偶决定了缠绕数的整数或半整数性质。

title: Two temperature scales in the Ising model on the $\{5,4\}$ hyperbolic lattice with free boundaries: susceptibility peak and boundary-induced order
summary: On the $\{5,4\}$ hyperbolic lattice, the outermost generation holds 73\% of the sites at all system sizes, making macroscopic averages strictly boundary-dependent. We study the ferromagnetic Ising model on this geometry with free boundaries by Monte Carlo simulation, demonstrating that conventional observables cease to identify a single critical scale. Instead, the finite lattices are organized by two distinct temperature scales. The susceptibility maximum identifies the lower transition scale at $T_{c2}=1.4782(15)J/k_{B}$ without extrapolation. However, the order-parameter distribution lacks a conventional fixed point at this scale. A distinct pseudocritical scale emerges instead at $T^{*}\simeq1.67(3)$ inside the boundary-sensitive intermediate phase, where Binder cumulant curves cross and effective exponents are compatible with mean-field criticality. Between $T_{c2}$ and $T^{*}$, the interior amplifies boundary fluctuations into induced order. Furthermore, because the volume grows exponentially with depth, finite-size scaling must be formulated in the generation index rather than the total number of sites. The lack of asymptotic power-law convergence in the scaling stretch confirms through an independent observable that $T^{*}$ is a finite-size crossover rather than a thermodynamic fixed point. Finally, by applying a coherent field to the outermost generation alone, we recover the upper thermodynamic transition at $T_{pt}=2.81(1)J/k_{B}$, demonstrating that it remains accessible under an appropriate boundary perturbation.

AI.tldr: 在{5,4}双曲格子上模拟铁磁Ising模型，发现有限系统由两个温度尺度组织，边界主导使传统临界识别失效。
AI.motivation: {5,4}双曲格子最外层占73%格点，宏观平均严格依赖边界，传统可观测量无法识别单一临界尺度，需研究这种几何下的临界行为。
AI.method: 对自由边界的{5,4}双曲格子上铁磁Ising模型进行Monte Carlo模拟，分析磁化率、序参量分布、Binder累积量及有效指数，并在最外层施加相干场。
AI.result: 磁化率极大约束下转变尺度Tc2=1.4782(15)J/kB；序参量分布无常规不动点；伪临界尺度T*≈1.67(3)处Binder累积量交叉、有效指数符合平均场；内部将边界涨落放大为诱导序；最外层加相干场恢复上转变Tpt=2.81(1)J/kB。
AI.conclusion: 有限尺寸标度应以层数而非格点数表述；T*是有限尺寸交叉而非热力学不动点；上热力学转变在适当边界扰动下仍可及。

title: Imaging how fluctuations destroy superconductivity in two dimensions
summary: Two-dimensional superconductors are model systems for thermal and quantum fluctuations. Key questions persist: whether existing models quantitatively describe the destruction of superconductivity, and whether an intermediate "anomalous metal state" represents a new phase of matter. We use scanning magnetic susceptibility to directly image the local phase stiffness, a thermodynamic measure of superconducting order, in gate-tunable Josephson junction arrays, a model two-dimensional superconductor. Across a broad range of carrier densities, we find that the superconducting critical temperature and phase stiffness are suppressed more strongly than expected from thermal fluctuations alone. At low carrier densities, we find that anomalous metal transport and large-scale spatial inhomogeneity emerge together. These results indicate that quantum fluctuations suppress superconductivity and that anomalous metal behavior emerges from phase slips in spatially disordered regions.

AI.tldr: 利用扫描磁化率直接成像可门控约瑟夫森结阵列中的局部相位刚度，发现超导转变温度与相位刚度的抑制超出热涨落预期，表明量子涨落抑制超导，而反常金属态源于空间无序区域的相位滑移。
AI.motivation: 二维超导体是研究热涨落与量子涨落的模型系统。现存两个关键问题：现有模型能否定量描述超导的破坏过程；中间的"反常金属态"是否为一种新的物质相。回答这些问题需要直接测量超导有序的热力学量——相位刚度。
AI.method: 采用扫描磁化率技术，对可门控约瑟夫森结阵列（作为模型二维超导体）进行局部相位刚度的直接成像，并在广泛载流子密度范围内测量超导临界温度与相位刚度。
AI.result: 在广泛载流子密度范围内，超导临界温度和相位刚度的抑制强于仅由热涨落预期的程度；在低载流子密度下，反常金属输运与大尺度空间不均匀性同时出现。
AI.conclusion: 量子涨落抑制超导，反常金属行为源自空间无序区域中的相位滑移，而非一种全新的物质相。

title: Generative crystallographic phasing through invariant relationships
summary: Crystal structure determination requires the phases of scattered waves -- yet diffraction measures only their intensities. Direct methods exploit phase invariants but become less reliable as diffraction information diminishes. Learned phase prediction has lowered the resolution barrier, yet remains primarily confined to centrosymmetric crystals with binary phases. We introduce PhiGen, a generative reformulation of traditional direct methods that learns origin-independent phase relationships for binary and continuous phasing. Across 210 space groups, including groups absent from training, it recovered high-quality maps for 99.0% of centrosymmetric structures and invariant-consistent phases for 92.8% of non-centrosymmetric structures. From simulated 3 Å zeolite powder data, the network recovered framework maps for 84.2% of held-out structures, versus 1.0% for Superflip. For experimental ZSM-25 and TNU-9, generated phases seeded high-resolution phase extension. These results suggest a route to structure determination from low-resolution, incomplete, and overlapped diffraction data.

AI.tldr: PhiGen 将传统直接法重构成生成式学习，学习与原点无关的相位关系，实现二值与连续相位求解，在 210 个空间群（含未训练群）中大幅提升低分辨率衍射的相位恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 衍射只测强度、不测相位，传统直接法依赖相位不变量，随衍射信息减少而可靠性下降；已有学习式相位预测多限于中心对称晶体和二进制相位，适用面窄。
AI.method: 提出生成式方法 PhiGen，把直接法重构为学习原点无关的相位关系，同时支持二值和连续相位求解；并在 210 个空间群（含训练中未出现的空间群）上验证，涵盖模拟 3 Å 沸石粉末数据以及实验 ZSM-25、TNU-9 数据。
AI.result: 在 210 个空间群中，中心对称结构 99.0% 恢复高质量电子密度图，非中心对称结构 92.8% 得到满足不变量的相位；3 Å 模拟沸石粉末数据上，84.2% 未见结构恢复骨架图，而 Superflip 仅 1.0%；对实验 ZSM-25 和 TNU-9，生成相位成功支撑高分辨率相位扩展。
AI.conclusion: PhiGen 表明可从低分辨率、不完整、重叠的衍射数据出发进行结构解析，为传统直接法难以处理的情形提供新途径。

title: Imaging an obstructed Wannier orbital
summary: In conventional insulators, electronic charge is localized in Wannier orbitals centered on the atoms. In an obstructed atomic insulator (OAI), the Wannier orbitals sit instead in the empty voids between atoms. These displaced orbitals give rise to an analog of the topological bulk-boundary correspondence, in which a boundary mode occurs only where the lattice termination severs an orbital. However, experimentally identifying OAIs has remained challenging, because the Wannier orbital of a dispersive electronic band is not an energy eigenstate and cannot be measured directly. Here we engineer an acoustic metamaterial hosting an isolated flat band, in which the Wannier orbitals become energy eigenstates. By measuring the amplitude and phase of the acoustic pressure field, we map the orbital's $f$-like structure and locate its Wannier center in a void between lattice sites---providing the first phase-resolved image of an obstructed Wannier orbital. By altering the lattice termination, we observe the predicted boundary states. Such acoustic flat-band metamaterials offer a direct probe of single-particle ingredients such as quantum geometry, which govern correlated phenomena in electronic flat bands, including proposed routes to unconventional superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用声学超材料构造孤立平带，使Wannier轨道成为能量本征态，首次相位分辨地成像了被阻挫的Wannier轨道并观测到相应边界态。
AI.motivation: 被阻挫原子绝缘体(OAI)中Wannier轨道位于原子间空隙，具有类似拓扑的体-边对应，但实验识别困难：色散能带的Wannier轨道不是能量本征态，无法直接测量。
AI.method: 设计承载孤立平带的声学超材料，使Wannier轨道成为能量本征态；测量声压场的振幅与相位，从而映射轨道结构与Wannier中心位置，并改变晶格终止方式。
AI.result: 获得了首个被阻挫Wannier轨道的相位分辨图像，确定其Wannier中心位于晶格格点之间的空隙；通过改变晶格终止，观测到预言中的边界态。
AI.conclusion: 声学平带超材料为直接探测量子几何等单粒子要素提供了平台，有助于理解电子平带中的关联现象及非常规超导机制。

title: Realization of Very High Mobility InAs Quantum Wells on InP Substrates Through Convex InAlAs Graded Buffer Optimization
summary: Due to strong spin-orbit coupling, large Landé $g$-factor, and a highly transparent interface, the two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) in InAs quantum wells provides an ideal platform for the exploration of topological superconductivity in hybrid semiconductor-superconductor heterostructures. Reduction of disorder in the semiconductor remains a primary challenge to the disambiguation of subtle interaction effects. Here we demonstrate very high mobility InAs 2DEGs grown on insulating InP substrates. Utilizing a convex compositional grading profile in an InAlAs metamorphic buffer we demonstrate InAs quantum wells with thickness greater than 10 nm without need of Ga-containing cladding layers. We examine structural and electrical transport properties of these heterostructures. Advances in the design of the metamorphic InAlAs buffer result in low-temperature electron mobility exceeding $1.7\times10^6$ cm$^2$ V$^{-1}$ s$^{-1}$ at 2DEG density $\leq3.2\times10^{11}$ cm$^{-2}$, the highest value yet reported for this material system.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过凸型组分渐变InAlAs缓冲层，在InP衬底上生长出无需含Ga包覆层、厚度>10 nm的高质量InAs量子阱，2DEG低温迁移率超过1.7×10⁶ cm²V⁻¹s⁻¹。
AI.motivation: InAs量子阱2DEG因强自旋轨道耦合、大g因子和透明界面，是研究拓扑超导的理想平台，但降低半导体中的无序仍是澄清细微相互作用效应的主要挑战，因此需要高迁移率材料。
AI.method: 在半绝缘InP衬底上生长InAs 2DEG，采用凸型组分渐变的InAlAs变质缓冲层，实现厚度>10 nm且无需含Ga包覆层的InAs量子阱，并对其结构与电输运性质进行表征。
AI.result: 变质InAlAs缓冲层设计优化使低温电子迁移率超过1.7×10⁶ cm²V⁻¹s⁻¹（2DEG密度≤3.2×10¹¹ cm⁻²），为该材料体系已报道的最高值。
AI.conclusion: 凸型组分渐变缓冲层设计可有效降低无序、提升InAs量子阱2DEG迁移率，为拓扑超导等研究提供高质量平台。

title: The giant component of complex hypergraphs: automated generating function calculations
summary: Complex hypergraphs (chygraphs) contain graphs, hypergraphs, multiplex and interacting networks as special cases, and the percolation threshold of all of them follows from one symbolic calculation: the spectrum of a tensor $A$ built from four matrices of first moments. That calculation stops at the threshold. Here I show that $A$ is the Jacobian, at its trivial fixed point, of a non-linear self-consistency map whose non-trivial fixed point is the giant component fraction, so threshold and order parameter are two orders of one object on one index set. Carrying the expansion one order further gives the critical amplitude $B$ in $S=BΛ+O(Λ^2)$ in closed form, and exposes a hierarchy: first moments fix the threshold, second moments the amplitude, and only the generating functions themselves the order parameter away from it. Dropping the assumption that a complex's participation in different layers is independent generalises the tensor again, replacing unconditional first moments by inclusion-biased second moments: distributions with identical marginals have different thresholds and different order parameters. Six constructions from the literature are then solved by substitution, among them AND- against OR-logic hypergraph percolation, which share a chygraph and differ in one generating function, and SIR epidemics with two levels of mixing, whose household reproduction number falls out of the tensor. A reported failure of mean-field theory on strongly clustered graphs is shown to be a failure of applying it to the wrong object: mapped onto the treelike backbone rather than the clustered graph, the same calculation reproduces the exact threshold, order parameter and critical exponents. Everything is implemented in one class, in which a chygraph is specified once by its generating functions and then returns all three, and validated against Monte Carlo simulation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将复超图渗流阈值与序参量统一为同一自洽映射的两个不动点，进一步给出临界振幅、揭示了矩阶与各类量的对应层级，并通过张量扩展统一求解多种网络渗流模型。
AI.motivation: 复超图（含图、超图、多重网络、交互网络）的渗流阈值可通过矩张量谱统一计算，但该计算仅止于阈值，未给出序参量、临界振幅等更多信息；同时不同模型（如AND/OR逻辑、SIR混合）缺乏统一框架，且平均场在强聚类图上失效的根源不明。
AI.method: 作者证明张量A是非线性自洽映射在其平凡不动点处的雅可比矩阵，其非平凡不动点即巨分量占比，从而将阈值与序参量统一在同一指标集上。将展开推至下一阶，闭式给出临界振幅B。放松不同层参与的独立性假设，用含偏置的二阶矩替代无条件一阶矩来推广张量。最后以替换法求解六个文献模型。
AI.result: 得到修正形式S=BΛ+O(Λ²)的临界振幅；揭示层级：一阶矩定阈值，二阶矩定振幅，生成函数本身定远离阈值的序参量。放宽独立性后，边缘分布相同但阈值与序参量不同的分布被区分。AND与OR逻辑超图渗流共享同一chygraph、仅差一个生成函数；双混合层级SIR的家庭再生数从张量中得出。强聚类图上平均场的失效被归因于作用于错误对象，映射到树状骨架后精确复现阈值、序参量与临界指数。全部实现为一个类并经蒙特卡洛验证。
AI.conclusion: 复超图为多种网络渗流提供了统一理论：阈值与序参量是同一自洽映射的两个不动点，矩张量与生成函数构成层级结构。此前被视为平均场失效的强聚类问题实为对象选择错误，映射到树状骨架后可精确求解。

title: Hidden magnetic order within the pressure induced superconducting dome of UTe2
summary: Unconventional superconductivity typically occurs near magnetic instabilities, and the corresponding spin fluctuations are widely believed to play a crucial role in mediating electron pairing. UTe$_2$ is a promising candidate for exhibiting multiple spin-triplet superconducting phases when tuning with applied pressure and magnetic fields, but the nature of the magnetism driving these unconventional pairing states is undetermined. Our measurements of UTe$_2$ under applied pressures and magnetic fields reveal the presence of a magnetic order hidden within the pressure-induced superconducting dome, which vanishes together with the superconductivity once there is sufficiently high pressure to induce the three-dimensional antiferromagnetic phase. Extrapolation of the phase boundary of the hidden magnetic order, which is most likely antiferromagnetic in nature, points to a zero-temperature quantum critical point that coincides with the maximum transition temperature of the pressure-induced superconducting dome, suggesting that it could corresponds to the parent magnetic phase of the critical antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations driving the triplet superconductivity. These findings advance the understanding of the interplay of magnetism and superconductivity in an exemplar candidate triplet superconductor, which is necessary for revealing the microscopic origin of the different unconventional superconducting phases.

AI.tldr: 在UTe₂压力诱导的超导穹顶内发现隐藏磁序，其相边界外推指向的量子临界点与超导转变温度最大值重合，暗示该磁序可能是驱动三重态超导的母磁相。
AI.motivation: 非常规超导通常出现在磁不稳定附近，自旋涨落被认为对电子配对起关键作用。UTe₂是压力与磁场调控下可能呈现多个自旋三重态超导相的候选材料，但驱动这些配对态的磁性本质尚未确定。
AI.method: 在施加压力和磁场条件下对UTe₂进行测量，追踪隐藏磁序的相边界，并将其外推至零温。
AI.result: 发现压力诱导超导穹顶内存在隐藏磁序，该磁序在压力足够高以诱导三维反铁磁相时与超导一同消失。隐藏磁序（很可能是反铁磁性的）相边界外推给出零温量子临界点，与超导穹顶的最大转变温度重合。
AI.conclusion: 该隐藏磁序可能是驱动三重态超导的临界反铁磁自旋涨落的母磁相，推进了对UTe₂中磁性与超导相互作用的了解。

title: Frustrated junctions in interfacial networks
summary: Networks of interfaces in materials and living systems evolve through motion and rearrangement of interfaces and junctions. Local equilibrium at a junction requires interfacial force balance. We show that in three dimensions the classical Herring condition for triple lines is necessary but insufficient: four triple lines meeting at a quadruple node may each satisfy Herring equilibrium, while the four conditions remain mutually incompatible. Such a frustrated node has no admissible local equilibrium geometry. In the semi-isotropic limit, the six interfacial energies must form the edge lengths of a non-degenerate tetrahedron, with constructibility determined by the Cayley-Menger determinant. This hidden compatibility constraint arises from three-dimensional geometry and applies broadly to foams, polycrystals, tissues and other interfacial networks.

AI.tldr: 本文指出三维界面网络中四重节点的经典Herring平衡条件不充分：四条三重线可能各自满足Herring平衡却彼此不相容，形成"受挫节点"。半各向同性极限下，六个界面能须构成非退化四面体的棱长，可用Cayley-Menger行列式判定其可构造性。
AI.motivation: 材料与生物系统中的界面网络通过界面与节点的运动和重排演化，传统认为局部平衡只需满足Herring界面力平衡条件。作者希望检验该经典条件在三维情形下是否充分。
AI.method: 从界面力平衡的几何分析出发，考察三维中四条三重线交汇于一个四重节点的情形，并引入半各向同性极限，用Cayley-Menger行列式判断六个界面能能否作为非退化四面体的棱长。
AI.result: 发现经典Herring条件对三重线是必要但不充分的：四重节点处四条三重线可各自满足Herring平衡，但四个条件相互矛盾，该节点不存在可行的局部平衡几何。半各向同性极限下，六个界面能必须能构成非退化四面体的棱长。
AI.conclusion: 三维几何带来了隐藏的相容性约束，广泛适用于泡沫、多晶、组织等界面网络。

title: Plane-Wave Photon-Fock Cavity QED-DFT: Chiral-Cavity-Induced Topology in Graphene
summary: We develop an explicit plane-wave (PW) $\times$ photon-Fock approach to the quantized, velocity-gauge Pauli--Fierz Hamiltonian for periodic, first-principles calculations: because the quantized vector potential is spatially uniform, the light--matter coupling reduces to an operator-valued shift of the crystal momentum, $K\to K+\hat{\mathbf A}/c$, and the existing plane-wave machinery of ordinary solid-state DFT is reused essentially unchanged. This PW$\times$Fock construction puts first-principles cavity QED of periodic solids on the same footing as the Fock-space coupled-cluster and configuration-interaction methods already developed for molecules, opening hitherto inaccessible systems---materials in a linear or chiral cavity, in particular---to first-principles plane-wave calculations. We illustrate the method with monolayer graphene in linear and chiral cavities, obtaining a polarization-selective Haldane gap together with the corresponding density-of-states, real-space, and circular-dichroism optical signatures. A full Brillouin-zone Berry-curvature calculation confirms the topological character of the chiral-cavity gap directly: the occupied manifold carries a quantized Chern number that steps through a non-monotonic sequence, $C=1\to3\to{-1}\to1\to2\to{-1}\to1$, with two narrow, sign-reversed windows---a property of extended, vacuum-dressed matter with no counterpart in a finite molecular system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了平面波×光子Fock空间方法，将量子化速度规范Pauli-Fierz哈密顿量用于周期性固体的第一性原理计算，统一了固体腔QED与分子Fock空间方法，并用单层石墨烯展示了选择性Haldane带隙及拓扑Chern数转变。
AI.motivation: 现有第一性原理腔QED方法多针对分子，周期性固体的腔QED缺乏与平面波DFT兼容的从头算框架，尤其线性/手性腔中的材料体系难以处理。
AI.method: 利用量子化矢势空间均匀性，将光-物质耦合简化为晶体动量的算符平移K→K+Â/c，复用现有平面波DFT框架，构建PW×photon-Fock方法；以单层石墨烯在线性与手性腔中进行验证。
AI.result: 获得偏振选择性Haldane带隙及相应的态密度、实空间与圆二色光学特征；全布里渊区Berry曲率计算给出占据流形的量子化Chern数非单调序列C=1→3→-1→1→2→-1→1，并出现两个窄的反号窗口。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将周期性固体的第一性原理腔QED提升到与分子Fock空间耦合簇/CI同等水平，揭示了扩展真空缀饰物质特有的拓扑性质，是有限分子体系所不具备的。

title: Conductance of silicon nanotube junctions in high magnetic fields
