summary: We investigate coherent quantum transport through silicon nanotube (SiNT) junctions in high magnetic fields up to 60 T using a tight-binding model combined with the non-equilibrium Green's function formalism, and magnetic field included via Peierls substitution. We consider junctions of metallic nanotubes (6,0)+(6,0) and semiconducting ones (9,9)+(9,9), and examine the effects of the overlap length, inter-tube distance, magnetic-field direction, and field strength on the electronic transmission. In contrast to carbon nanotube junctions, the SiNT systems exhibit irregular transmission oscillations and do not show the emergence of highly conductive gateway states. The transmission is substantially more sensitive to a magnetic field perpendicular to the nanotube axis than to a parallel field, while increasing the field strength progressively modifies the transmission spectrum. Increasing the overlap length results in more frequent transmission oscillations, whereas increasing the inter-tube distance modifies their positions and amplitudes without changing their overall character. Generally, similar trends are observed for both types of junctions, involving metallic and semiconducting nanotubes. However, in the junction of semiconducting nanotubes, one observes peculiar additional field-dependent in-gap transmission features. These results demonstrate that the magnetic-field response of SiNT junctions is strongly governed by their geometry and differs qualitatively from that of pristine carbon nanotube junctions.

AI.tldr: 本文用紧束缚模型结合非平衡格林函数研究高磁场下硅纳米管(SiNT)结的相干量子输运，发现其磁响应强烈依赖几何结构，与碳纳米管结定性不同。
AI.motivation: 探究硅纳米管结在高磁场下的量子输运行为，并与碳纳米管结进行对比。
AI.method: 采用紧束缚模型结合非平衡格林函数形式，(Peierls替换引入磁场)，研究金属(6,0)+(6,0)与半导体(9,9)+(9,9)结，考察重叠长度、管间距、磁场方向与强度对透射的影响。
AI.result: SiNT结呈现不规则透射振荡，无高导"门态"出现；对垂直磁场远比平行磁场敏感；重叠长度增加使振荡更频繁，管间距改变振荡位置与幅度但不改变其性质。半导体管结还出现额外的场依赖带隙内透射特征。
AI.conclusion: SiNT结的磁场响应受几何结构强烈支配，与纯净碳纳米管结定性不同。

title: A summation rule for the four-coupling beta function of four-dimensional nonplanar Euclidean scalar $\varphi^{4}$ theory under factorial coefficient bounds, and a domain on which the summed beta function is well defined
summary: Let $\mathbf{c}=(λ,α,μ,ν)\in\mathbb{R}^{4}$ denote the four running couplings of four-dimensional nonplanar Euclidean scalar $\varphi^{4}$ theory, and let $B(\mathbf{c})=\sum_{p\ge2}\sum_{|\mathbf{m}|=p}β(\mathbf{m})\mathbf{c}^{\mathbf{m}}$ be its formal beta-function series. Assuming the factorial coefficient bounds $|β(\mathbf{m})|\le (p-1)!C^{p-1}$ for $|\mathbf{m}|=p$, we construct an explicit summation rule $\mathcal{S}$, given by a cut Borel--Laplace transform whose cut is placed by a scale-covariant real-analytic gauge. We prove that it assigns a well-defined real value to $B$ on an explicit nonempty open domain, in fact on all of $\mathbb{R}^{4}$. The summed function $\mathcal{S}B$ is linear and real, real-analytic on $\mathbb{R}^{4}\setminus\{0\}$, $C^\infty$ on $\mathbb{R}^{4}$ with Taylor series $B$ at the origin, and Gevrey-$1$ asymptotic to $B$ to all orders with an explicit remainder bound. At optimal truncation the remainder is $O(e^{-η/(C\|\mathbf{c}\|_\infty)})$ for any $η<1$. We show that $\mathcal{S}B$ reproduces the classical Borel sum and the ordinary sum of a convergent series up to errors of the same exponentially small order. Exact reproduction is impossible for any linear rule defined on the whole admissible class: regularity forces all weights to equal $1$, leading to divergence. Finally, we prove optimality under the stated hypothesis. Admissible series may diverge at every $\mathbf{c}\ne0$, and their Borel transforms may have the circle $|τ|=1/(C\|\mathbf{c}\|_\infty)$ as a natural boundary, so classical Borel-type summation need not be available on the class. Moreover, there exist two functions indistinguishable at the level of the coefficient bounds yet differing by exactly $(2π/C)e^{-1/(C\|\mathbf{c}\|_\infty)}$. All constants are explicit and all arguments are self-contained.

AI.tldr: 本文为四维非平面欧氏标量φ⁴理论的beta函数级数构造了一个显式求和规则S（切割Borel–Laplace变换），在系数阶乘界假设下证明其在整个ℝ⁴上有定义且性质良好，并给出最优性结果。
AI.motivation: 四维非平面标量φ⁴理论的beta函数通常是发散的渐近级数，且其Borel变换可能具有自然边界，经典Borel型求和不一定可用。作者希望在明确的系数界假设下，构造一个显式、自洽、性质良好的求和规则。
AI.method: 设c=(λ,α,μ,ν)为四个跑动耦合，B为其形式beta函数级数；在系数界|β(m)|≤(p-1)!C^{p-1}下，构造由尺度协变实解析gauge放置切割的切割Borel–Laplace变换S。
AI.result: 证明S在ℝ⁴（含0）上给出实值；SB线性、实、在ℝ⁴\{0}实解析、在ℝ⁴上C^∞且在原点的Taylor级数为B、Gevrey-1渐近且具显式余项界；最优截断余项为O(e^{-η/(C||c||_∞)}), η<1；S复现经典Borel和与收敛级数的普通和至指数小误差。并证明在所述假设下最优，及对全可容许类上的线性规则精确复现不可能。
AI.conclusion: 在该系数界假设下，切割Borel–Laplace求和规则给出了全域定义、性质良好且最优的求和方法；由于可容许级数可能在每个c≠0发散、Borel变换可能有自然边界，经典Borel型求和不总可用，且存在系数界层面不可区分但相差(2π/C)e^{-1/(C||c||_∞)}的两个函数。

title: Superconducting spin valve as a sensitive probe of spin-orbit coupling anisotropy
summary: Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) plays a central role in modern condensed matter physics and is crucial for the development of spin-based devices and quantum technologies. In particular, the interplay between Rashba SOC (R-SOC), arising from structural inversion asymmetry, and Dresselhaus SOC (D-SOC), due to bulk inversion asymmetry, significantly influences spin coherence and manipulation in two-dimensional and topological systems. Disentangling these SOC components is essential for spintronics, superconducting spintronics, or topological superconductivity. In this study, we experimentally investigate in-plane low-bias conductance anisotropy in epitaxial Fe/MgO/V/MgO/Fe/Co junctions under varying temperature and magnetic field conditions. By applying a theoretical model that accounts for distinct R-SOC and D-SOC contributions, we interpret the observed anisotropy as a reliable method to disentangle these effects. Comparison between experiment and theory reveals a 5 % contribution of D-SOC to total SOC, attributed to periodic interfacial lattice mismatch defects confirmed by high-resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM). Our findings offer a practical approach to isolate interfacial SOC components in superconducting spintronic systems with implications for engineering in spintronic and quantum devices, and provide further evidence of superconducting spin-triplet pairing in Fe/MgO/V-based superconductor/ferromagnet heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过外延Fe/MgO/V/MgO/Fe/Co结的面内低偏压电导各向异性实验，结合区分Rashba与Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合的理论模型，将二者贡献分离，发现D-SOC约占总SOC的5%，源于界面晶格失配缺陷，为超导自旋电子学中界面SOC的分离提供实用方法。
AI.motivation: 自旋轨道耦合（SOC）对自旋电子学、超导自旋电子学及拓扑超导至关重要。其中Rashba SOC（结构反演不对称）与Dresselhaus SOC（体反演不对称）的相互作用显著影响自旋相干与操控，因此区分这两种SOC组分是相关器件与量子技术发展的关键难题。
AI.method: 在变温与变磁场条件下，测量外延Fe/MgO/V/MgO/Fe/Co结的面内低偏压电导各向异性；采用能分别描述R-SOC与D-SOC贡献的理论模型对实验数据进行拟合解释，并利用高分辨扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）验证界面晶格失配缺陷。
AI.result: 实验与理论对比表明，D-SOC约占总SOC的5%，该贡献可归因于周期性界面晶格失配缺陷（由高分辨STEM确认）；同时为Fe/MgO/V基超导体/铁磁体异质结构中的超导自旋三重态配对提供了进一步证据。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种在超导自旋电子体系中分离界面SOC组分的实用方法，对自旋电子学与量子器件的工程设计具有意义，并进一步支持Fe/MgO/V基超导/铁磁异质结构中的超导自旋三重态配对。

title: Electric Current-Driven Microstructural Evolution in SrTiO3
summary: Polycrystalline SrTiO3 is employed as a model system to investigate microstructural evolution under applied electric currents. Under a substantial current density, well-aligned, elongated abnormal grains develop near the anode following a flash event, in contrast to previously reported cathode-side enhanced grain growth under negligible currents. The equivalent diameter of the abnormal grains increases linearly with time, deviating from classical parabolic grain growth kinetics. The applied current drives elemental redistribution near the anode, producing a Ti-rich region adjacent to a Sr-rich belt that migrates toward the cathode, from which the abnormal grains nucleate. Aberration-corrected scanning transmission electron microscopy and electron energy-loss spectroscopy reveal that the fast-moving grain boundaries (GBs) within the Ti-rich bulk region are Sr-enriched, O-depleted, and Ti-reduced. An analysis based on the Brouwer diagram suggests the formation of p-i-n regions under the applied electric field. Conversion between electronic and ionic currents at the p-i and i-n junctions, field-driven precipitation and dissolution of the Sr-rich Ruddlesden-Popper phase, and field-driven migration of Sr and O vacancies collectively explain the elemental redistribution and redox-modulated migration of the Sr-rich belt. Incomplete redox reactions at the moving junctions create the moving Sr-rich belt and generate a locally reducing environment, consequently producing fast-moving, Sr-rich, reduced GBs. These findings reveal new mechanisms of electric current-driven defect-mediated microstructural evolution.

AI.tldr: 多晶SrTiO3在大电流下于阳极附近形成异常长晶粒，源于电流驱动的元素再分布与氧化还原调控机制。
AI.motivation: 探究电场/电流驱动下微观结构演化的机制，尤其是闪烧事件后晶粒生长的异常行为，与以往报道的阴极侧晶粒增强生长不同。
AI.method: 以多晶SrTiO3为模型体系，施加高电流密度，利用像差校正扫描透射电镜与电子能量损失谱表征，并结合Brouwer图分析。
AI.result: 阳极附近出现取向一致、细长的异常晶粒，其等效直径随时间线性增长（偏离经典抛物线动力学）；电流驱动阳极附近元素再分布，形成Ti富集区与向阴极迁移的Sr富集带，异常晶粒由此形核；快速移动晶界为Sr富集、O贫化、Ti还原。
AI.conclusion: 电子/离子电流在p-i-n结处的转换、Sr富集RP相的场驱动沉淀溶解及Sr、O空位迁移共同解释元素再分布与氧化还原调控迁移；移动结处不完全氧化还原反应产生移动Sr富集带与局部还原环境，形成快速移动的Sr富集还原晶界，揭示电流驱动缺陷介导的微观结构演化新机制。

title: Combining physical models with dynamically acquired experimental information for the optimization of multicomponent NASICON fast ionic conductors in a self-driving laboratory
comment: 80 pages (45 pages main manuscript, 35 pages supplementary information), 7 main figures, and 19 supplementary figures
summary: Elemental substitution within existing structural frameworks is a widely applied strategy for developing advanced materials. Yet, optimizing target properties while maintaining phase purity usually demands extensive trial-and-error, which becomes substantially inefficient when navigating a complex design space. Here, we introduce a strategy that simultaneously and dynamically assesses composition-dependent synthetic accessibility and target properties via aggregated cost functions that guide autonomous experimentation in a truly self-driving and self-learning mode. Specifically, we developed a cost-guided autonomous solid-state synthesis (CASS) framework and demonstrate its application in the discovery of Na superionic conductor (NASICON) solid electrolytes. CASS successfully optimizes ionic conductivity and phase purity, leading to the identification of 18 promising compositions in 78 trials conducted in an autonomous laboratory, the A-Lab. Among these, we identified two fast-conducting NASICONs yielding total (bulk) ionic conductivity of 0.7 (3.96) and 0.3 (3.17) mS/cm. The successful deployment of CASS reinforces the potential of coupling self-driving autonomous laboratories with physics-informed generative models to accelerate materials discovery. Moreover, the interpretability of the design factors, informed by outcomes from both successful and failed syntheses, enables model refinement and generation of new chemical insights.

AI.tldr: 提出成本引导的自主固态合成(CASS)框架，将组成相关的合成可行性与目标性能统一为聚合成本函数，指导A-Lab自驱动实验发现NASICON固态电解质，78次试验筛选出18个候选，其中两个快离子导体总(体相)电导率达0.7(3.96)和0.3(3.17) mS/cm。
AI.motivation: 元素替代是开发先进材料的常用策略，但要在保持相纯度的同时优化目标性能通常需大量试错，在复杂设计空间中效率极低，亟需能自动平衡合成可行性与性能的自主实验方法。
AI.method: 构建成本引导的自主固态合成(CASS)框架：用聚合成本函数同时、动态评估组成相关的合成可行性与目标性能，以真正自驱动、自学习的方式引导A-Lab自主实验室进行实验；并结合物理信息生成模型辅助设计。
AI.result: 在A-Lab中78次试验即找到18个有前景的NASICON组成，其中两个快离子导体总(体相)离子电导率分别为0.7(3.96)和0.3(3.17) mS/cm，同时兼顾了离子电导率与相纯度优化。
AI.conclusion: CASS的成功应用表明自驱动自主实验室与物理信息生成模型结合可加速材料发现；成功与失败合成结果赋予设计因素可解释性，可用于模型精炼并产生新的化学洞见。

title: Exact selection of a toric-code vison crystal in a flux-conditioned Kitaev model
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Comments are welcome!
summary: We construct an exactly solvable extension of the spin-$1/2$ Kitaev honeycomb model in which conserved $\mathbb{Z}_2$ fluxes determine not only the signs but also the connectivity of nearest-neighbor Majorana hopping. At a tuned loop point, hopping survives only across opposite-flux plaquettes, so every vertex has active degree zero or two and the matter Hamiltonian fragments in each flux sector into independent Majorana rings and isolated zero modes. Exact ring spectra and bond counting then bound the matter energy over all local flux configurations and all four Wilson-loop sectors, and split it exactly into a frustrated triangular-lattice Ising term, whose extensively degenerate ground states are the fully packed loop coverings, and a non-negative Majorana residual. On admissible commensurate tori, the residual selects precisely the three translation-related $2/3$-vison crystals, which saturate the bound, and an exact fermion-parity identity shows that for antiferromagnetic coupling their vacua also survive projection, making them rigorous ground states of the spin model. Within a single crystal, a depth-one local unitary then maps the ground space onto that of a sheared square-lattice toric code, giving fourfold topological degeneracy. The model thus realizes exact nonperturbative gauge-matter feedback: the flux fixes where the Majorana fermions may move, and their zero-point energy selects in return a topologically ordered vison crystal with spontaneously broken translation symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了Kitaev蜂窝模型的一个精确可解扩展，其中Z2通量同时决定Majorana跃迁的符号与连通性，在特定loop点实现了量子自旋液体、拓扑序与平移对称破缺的精确nonperturbative耦合。
AI.motivation: 在Kitaev模型中，规范通量通常只决定Majorana跃迁的符号（符号结构）。作者希望构造一个模型，让通量还能决定跃迁的连通性，从而实现规范场与物质费米子之间真正的反馈（gauge-matter feedback），并寻找精确可解、可严格证明的基态与拓扑序。
AI.method: 构造自旋-1/2 Kitaev蜂窝模型的精确可解扩展，使Z2守恒通量决定最近邻Majorana跃迁的符号与连通性；调节到loop点，使跃迁只发生在异号通量面之间，物质哈密顿量按通量扇区分裂为独立的Majorana环与孤立零模。利用精确环谱与键计数对所有局部通量组态及四个Wilson环扇区给出能量下界，并精确分解为阻挫三角晶格Ising项（其高度简并基态为完全填满的loop覆盖）与非负Majorana残余。
AI.result: 在容许的commensurate环面上，残余项精确选出三个平移相关的2/3-vison晶体并饱和下界；精确费米子宇称恒等式表明反铁磁耦合下其真空态经投影后仍存活，构成自旋模型的严格基态。在单个晶体内，深度一的局域幺正变换将基态空间映射到剪切方格环面码的基态空间，给出四重拓扑简并。
AI.conclusion: 该模型实现了精确的nonperturbative规范-物质反馈：通量决定Majorana费米子可在何处移动，而它们的零点能反过来选出具有自发平移对称破缺的拓扑有序vison晶体。

title: Quantum Gates Built on a Spin Qubit and a Kitaev Parity Qubit
summary: Spin is typically traced out in the description of quantum-dot-based Kitaev chains to simplify the construction of Majorana fermions. Yet the intrinsic spin structure of poor-man's Majorana modes in minimal Kitaev chains under finite Zeeman fields offers a natural interface for the Kitaev parity qubit to interact with other spinful systems. Here, we establish such a platform to bridge the parity qubit and a quantum-dot spin qubit, with the effective coupling governed by the spin-dependent delocalization of the Majorana modes. Depending on whether the spin qubit is coupled to one or two chains constituting the parity qubit, the parity-spin coupling exhibits distinct forms: an anisotropic parity-conserving exchange interaction or a nontrivial exchange tensor tunable via the interchain superconducting-phase bias. Leveraging fast spin-qubit manipulation, we further demonstrate universal parity-qubit control, high-fidelity qubit-state readout, and entangling operations between the parity and spin qubits. These results turn the spinful structure of poor-man's Majoranas from a finite-field imperfection into a resource for hybrid quantum control.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用有限塞曼场下最小Kitaev链中poor-man's Majorana模式的固有自旋结构，构建宇称量子比特与量子点自旋量子比特之间的耦合平台，实现混合量子控制。
AI.motivation: 通常描述量子点Kitaev链时会追踪掉自旋以简化Majorana费米子的构造，但poor-man's Majorana模式在有限塞曼场下的自旋结构实际上可作为宇称量子比特与自旋系统相互作用的天然接口，此前被视为缺陷。
AI.method: 建立桥接宇称量子比特与量子点自旋量子比特的平台，其有效耦合由Majorana模式的自旋依赖离域决定；根据自旋量子比特耦合到构成宇称量子比特的一条或两条链，研究不同的宇称-自旋耦合形式，包括各向异性宇称守恒交换相互作用，或通过链间超导相位偏置可调的非平凡交换张量。
AI.result: 利用快速自旋量子比特操控，实现了通用宇称量子比特控制、高保真量子比特态读出，以及宇称与自旋量子比特之间的纠缠操作。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果将poor-man's Majorana的自旋结构从有限场缺陷转变为混合量子控制的资源。

title: Observation of universal hierarchical relaxation in a quantum simulator
summary: Autocorrelation functions play a key role in the theoretical characterization of the dynamical properties of interacting many-body quantum systems. Recently, bringing together the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis and hydrodynamics, it was theoretically predicted that the relaxation of autocorrelators can be described by the \textit{relaxation-overlap inequality}, which, when saturated, predicts a hierarchy of relaxation exponents for a set of operators that are easily identified and constructed. Here, we employ a trapped-ion quantum simulator to experimentally demonstrate it in the diffusive regime; to do so, we have extended the theory of the overlap-relaxation inequality to systems with multiple conservation laws. Our study thus opens the path to a thorough characterization of the relaxation to equilibrium and appearance of hydrodynamic behavior in quantum matter.

AI.tldr: 利用囚禁离子量子模拟器在扩散区域实验验证了自关联函数松弛的重叠不等式，并将其推广到多守恒律系统。
AI.motivation: 自关联函数是刻画相互作用多体量子系统动力学性质的关键。近期结合本征态热化假说与流体力学，理论上预测了"松弛-重叠不等式"，其饱和时给出算符松弛指数的层级结构，但缺乏实验验证。
AI.method: 采用囚禁离子量子模拟器进行实验；并将松弛-重叠不等式理论推广到具有多个守恒律的系统，以在扩散区域进行验证。
AI.result: 在扩散区域实验验证了松弛-重叠不等式，且通过扩展理论成功处理了多守恒律情形。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为全面刻画量子物质向平衡态松弛及流体力学行为的出现开辟了道路。

title: Nodal Orbital-Anti-Phase Superconducting State in Bilayer Nickelates
summary: The recent discovery of high-$T_c$ superconductivity in the bilayer nickelate La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ (La-327) under applied pressure and compressive strain opened a new avenue to elucidate the interplay between multiorbital intralayer and interlayer electronically driven Cooper-pairing in bilayer systems. Depending on the details of the electronic structure in the normal state, the superconducting gap in bilayer nickelates is predicted to have either bonding-antibonding $s_{\pm}$-wave symmetry, driven by dominant interlayer Cooper-pairing, or $d$-wave symmetry with substantial intralayer Cooper-pairing. Despite this general picture, the orbital structure of the superconducting gap in these multiorbital systems has been less explored. Here, we analyze the consequences of an orbital-anti-phase structure of the superconducting gap and discuss its possible experimental signatures. We demonstrate that additional pairs of nodes may appear on the $α$ and/or $β$ Fermi surface sheets due to the sign change of the superconducting gap between the involved orbitals. Apart from this additional nodal structure, which is not enforced by the symmetries of the gap function and can be probed in ARPES experiments, the orbital-anti-phase gap modifies the temperature dependence of the superfluid stiffness at low temperatures, providing a concrete experimental prediction to test its realization in bilayer nickelates and related multiorbital systems.

AI.tldr: 本文分析双层镍酸盐超导能隙的轨道反相结构，预测其会引入额外节点并改变低温超流刚度的温度依赖，为实验检验提供依据。
AI.motivation: 双层镍酸盐La-327高压下超导的发现，为研究多轨道层内/层间电子配对机制提供新平台，但其多轨道超导能隙的轨道结构尚不清楚。
AI.method: 理论分析超导能隙的轨道反相结构，并探讨其可观测的实验特征（ARPES节点测量、超流刚度温度依赖）。
AI.result: 轨道反相能隙可在α和/或β费米面片上产生额外节点对（非对称性要求），并改变低温超流刚度的温度依赖。
AI.conclusion: 额外节点结构和超流刚度变化可作为具体实验预测，用于检验双层镍酸盐及相关多轨道体系中轨道反相能隙的实现。

title: Superconductivity and Band Topology in Functionalized 2D Hexagonal MBenes
summary: Recently, two-dimensional transition-metal borides (MBenes) have attracted substantial interest due to their promising properties for electrocatalytic applications. Here, we explore their potential as novel two-dimensional superconductors and topological materials through first-principles calculations on both pristine and surface-functionalized hexagonal MBenes. We conduct a thorough examination of the structural, electronic, phononic, superconducting, and topological properties of 36 compounds with formulas M$_{2}$B$_{2}$ and M$_{2}$B$_{2}$T$_{2}$ (M = Sc, Ti, V, Zr, Nb, Hf, Ta, Mo, W; T = F, O, OH). Our analysis identifies 21 superconducting MBenes, including four with critical temperatures (T$_{c}$) exceeding 10 K, with Ti$_{2}$B$_{2}$O$_{2}$ exhibiting the highest predicted T$_{c}$ of 24 K based on the McMillan formalism. For the two most promising compounds, Ti$_{2}$B$_{2}$O$_{2}$ and V$_{2}$B$_{2}$(OH)$_{2}$, we further solve the anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg equations, obtaining zero-temperature superconducting gaps of 6.1 and 3.6 meV and anisotropic T$_{c}$ values of approximately 32 and 25 K, respectively. Symmetry-indicator-based analysis further reveals nontrivial normal-state band topology in several superconducting MBenes. These results indicate the coexistence of phonon-mediated superconductivity and nontrivial normal-state band topology within this material family, making MBenes promising platforms for future investigations of the possible emergence of topological superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算系统研究36种原始及表面功能化六方MBene（M₂B₂与M₂B₂T₂）的结构、电子、声子、超导与拓扑性质，发现21种超导MBene，其中Ti₂B₂O₂预测Tc高达24-32 K，并揭示超导与拓扑共存。
AI.motivation: MBene因电催化潜力受关注，但其作为二维超导体和拓扑材料的潜力尚未被系统探索。
AI.method: 对M=Sc, Ti, V, Zr, Nb, Hf, Ta, Mo, W，T=F, O, OH组成的36种M₂B₂和M₂B₂T₂化合物进行第一性原理计算，考察结构、电子、声子、超导及拓扑性质；对Ti₂B₂O₂和V₂B₂(OH)₂求解各向异性Migdal-Eliashberg方程，并用对称性指标分析能带拓扑。
AI.result: 识别出21种超导MBene，4种Tc超过10 K；Ti₂B₂O₂的McMillan Tc最高为24 K。Migdal-Eliashberg计算给出Ti₂B₂O₂和V₂B₂(OH)₂的零温超导能隙为6.1和3.6 meV，各向异性Tc约为32和25 K。多种超导MBene具有非平庸正常态能带拓扑。
AI.conclusion: MBene家族中声子介导超导与非平庸能带拓扑共存，是研究拓扑超导潜在出现的理想平台。

title: Ultrafast Electron Microscopy: A Quantitative Platform for Nonequilibrium Materials Research
summary: Macroscopic materials function is determined not merely by equilibrium structure, but by how carriers, phonons, fields, defects, interfaces, and collective order dynamically evolve after perturbation. Ultrafast electron microscopy (UEM) uniquely bridges this gap, coupling femtosecond-to-nanosecond timing with real-space, reciprocal-space, and energy-resolved contrast. Here, we review how these integrated capabilities now quantitatively map energy flow and conversion in electronic materials, decode electronic-structural coupling in quantum and correlated systems, and isolate the localized propagation of carriers, polaritons, strain, and phonons across optoelectronic and nanomechanical architectures. We emphasize the predictive design rules now emerging from direct metrology of carrier-lattice coupling, momentum-resolved phonon thermalization, defect-controlled phase transformations, and authentic operando switching. We critically assess UEM's ongoing maturation from a qualitative, proof-of-concept experiment into a rigorous, quantitative materials platform. This paradigm shift is actively driven by integrated multimodal detection, advanced energy-resolved spectroscopy, high-repetition-rate sources, multidimensional (4D and 5D) acquisition, and physically constrained forward modeling. Ultimately, the central opportunity lies in establishing a complete, causal link from initial excitation to localized energy flow, transient structure, and macroscopic device function. By prioritizing quantitative reproducibility and robust mechanistic interpretation, UEM is positioned to engineer materials in functional states that equilibrium thermodynamics simply cannot describe.

AI.tldr: 本文综述超快电子显微镜（UEM）如何从定性实验走向定量材料表征平台，实现从激发到宏观器件功能的因果链映射。
AI.motivation: 宏观材料功能不仅由平衡结构决定，更取决于扰动后载流子、声子、场、缺陷、界面和集体序的动力学演化，而UEM能够弥合这一认知空白。
AI.method: 综述UEM结合飞秒至纳秒时间分辨与实空间、倒空间、能量分辨对比度的能力，并依托多模态探测、能量分辨光谱、高重复频率源、4D/5D采集及物理约束正向建模。
AI.result: UEM可定量映射电子材料能量流与转换，解析量子与关联体系的电子-结构耦合，并隔离载流子、极化激元、应变和声子在光电与纳机电结构中的局域传播。
AI.conclusion: UEM正从概念验证转向严格的定量平台，核心机遇在于建立从初始激发到局域能量流、瞬态结构和宏观器件功能的完整因果链，从而指导平衡热力学无法描述的功能态材料设计。

title: Mixed-Valent Magnetism in CeFe$_2$ from Multi-Impurity DFT+DMFT
summary: The microscopic origin of magnetism in CeFe$_2$ has remained unresolved for almost forty years, where polarized-neutron diffraction and x-ray magnetic circular dichroism infer markedly different Ce $4f$ spin and orbital moments, that also are in disagreement with theory. We show here that within a relativistic multi-impurity DFT+DMFT framework, where the Fe $3d$ states are treated by spin-polarized T-matrix fluctuation exchange and Ce $4f$ orbitals by a bath-coupled configuration-interaction solver, this long standing problem is resolved. This level of theory is exclusive in reproducing magnetic moments (spin and orbital) for both the Ce and Fe atoms, yielding a total moment in agreement with the measured saturation moment. The theory put forth here is much closer to the atom specific moments reported from XMCD, compared to values from polarized-neutron diffraction. The occupation $\langle n_f\rangle=0.85$ and charge variance $δn_f^2=0.27$ establish substantial valence fluctuations, while the spectral function simultaneously recovers significant weight at the Fermi level together with separate incoherent structures. These results identify bath-mediated polarization and configuration mixing as the essential ingredients governing the electronic structure and magnetism of CeFe$_2$.

AI.tldr: 本文用相对论多杂质DFT+DMFT框架（Fe 3d用自旋极化T矩阵涨落交换，Ce 4f用浴耦合组态相互作用求解器）解决了CeFe$_2$磁性微观起源这一近四十年的难题，同时重现了Ce和Fe的自旋与轨道磁矩。
AI.motivation: CeFe$_2$磁性的微观起源近四十年来悬而未决：极化中子衍射与X射线磁圆二色（XMCD）给出的Ce 4f自旋与轨道磁矩差异显著，且均与理论不符。
AI.method: 在相对论多杂质DFT+DMFT框架中，Fe 3d态用自旋极化T矩阵涨落交换处理，Ce 4f轨道用浴耦合组态相互作用求解器处理。
AI.result: 该理论唯一能重现Ce和Fe两者的自旋与轨道磁矩，总磁矩与实测饱和磁矩一致；结果更接近XMCD给出的原子特定磁矩而非极化中子衍射值。占据数⟨n_f⟩=0.85、电荷方差δn_f²=0.27表明显著的价态涨落，谱函数在费米能级处恢复明显权重并伴有独立的非相干结构。
AI.conclusion: 浴介导极化与组态混合是支配CeFe$_2$电子结构与磁性的关键要素。

title: Nonequilibrium Dirac condensate in bosonic Kitaev chain
summary: We explore a nonequilibrium Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) in a bosonic Kitaev chain. Within a mean-field framework, we show that bosonic superfluid order develops once the pairing strength exceeds a critical threshold. The condensate order parameter adopts an alternating phase between even and odd sites, giving rise to a spontaneous sublattice ordering. By mapping the emergent sublattice degrees of freedom onto a pseudospin, the elementary Bogoliubov excitation is described by a non-Hermitian Dirac Hamiltonian, displaying two prominent features: a re-entrant bosonic Andreev bound state localized around boundaries, and a macroscopic degeneracy of exceptional Majorana bosons at the critical point.

AI.tldr: 在玻色Kitaev链中研究非平衡玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚，发现配对强度超过临界值后出现超流序，凝聚体序参量在奇偶格点间呈交替相位；将子晶格自由度映射为赝自旋后，元激发由非厄米狄拉克哈密顿量描述，呈现回返型安德烈夫束缚态和临界点处例外马约拉纳玻色子的宏观简并。
AI.motivation: 探索非平衡玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚在玻色Kitaev链中的行为，理解配对相互作用驱动的自发子晶格有序及相关元激发特性。
AI.method: 采用平均场框架分析玻色Kitaev链，识别配对强度临界阈值下的超流序；将新出现的子晶格自由度映射为赝自旋，并推导出描述Bogoliubov激发的非厄米狄拉克哈密顿量。
AI.result: 当配对强度超过临界阈值时形成玻色超流序，凝聚体序参量在奇偶格点间呈交替相位，导致自发子晶格有序；元激发表现为非厄米狄拉克哈密顿量，具有两个突出特征：边界附近的回返型玻色安德烈夫束缚态，以及临界点处例外马约拉纳玻色子的宏观简并。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了玻色Kitaev链中非平衡BEC的自发子晶格有序机制，并通过非厄米狄拉克物理刻画了其元激发，包括回返型安德烈夫束缚态与例外马约拉纳玻色子的宏观简并。

title: Superconductivity in structurally complex $σ$-Phase Re-X (X = V, Nb, Ta) and a derived medium-entropy alloys
summary: The structurally complex tetragonal sigma ($σ$)-phase provides a unique platform for investigating the interplay between chemical disorder, electronic structure, and superconductivity, particularly in Re-based alloys where unconventional superconductivity has been widely discussed. Here, we synthesize and investigate the superconducting properties of $σ$-phase Re-X (X = V, Nb, and Ta) alloys with compositions Re$_{0.76}$V$_{0.24}$, Re$_{0.56}$Nb$_{0.44}$, and Re$_{0.60}$Ta$_{0.40}$. These compositions lie within the narrow stability range of the $σ$ phase, underscoring the critical role of valence electron concentration in phase formation. To examine the influence of enhanced chemical disorder, we further synthesize the structurally complex medium-entropy alloy Re$_{0.56}$Nb$_{0.19}$Ta$_{0.19}$V$_{0.06}$, derived from these binary systems. Magnetization, electrical resistivity, and specific-heat measurements establish bulk type-II superconductivity in all compounds. Analysis of the electronic heat capacity is consistent with a fully gapped, weak-coupling BCS superconducting state. In contrast, the normal-state resistivity exhibits an unconventional negative temperature coefficient, and the superconducting transition temperature values obtained from resistivity measurements are higher than those determined from other measurements. Our results demonstrate that both the $σ$-phase Re-X alloys, spanning 3d, 4d, and 5d transition-metal substitutions, and their medium-entropy counterpart constitute an attractive family of model systems for investigating the effects of structural complexity, chemical disorder, and spin-orbit coupling on superconductivity in Re-based materials.

AI.tldr: 本文合成并研究了σ相Re-X (X=V, Nb, Ta)二元合金及衍生的中熵合金，发现它们均为II型体超导体，具有完全能隙的弱耦合BCS态，但正常态电阻率呈非常规负温度系数。
AI.motivation: σ相结构复杂，为研究化学无序、电子结构与超导性之间的相互关系提供了独特平台，尤其Re基合金中非常规超导性被广泛讨论。作者希望探究价电子浓度、增强的化学无序以及自旋轨道耦合对超导性的影响。
AI.method: 在σ相窄稳定范围内合成Re0.76V0.24、Re0.56Nb0.44、Re0.60Ta0.40三种二元合金，并由此衍生出中熵合金Re0.56Nb0.19Ta0.19V0.06；通过磁化、电阻率和比热测量研究超导特性，分析电子热容与正常态电阻率行为。
AI.result: 所有化合物均表现出II型体超导性；电子热容分析与完全能隙的弱耦合BCS超导态一致；正常态电阻率呈非常规负温度系数；电阻率测量得到的超导转变温度高于其他测量方法的结果。
AI.conclusion: σ相Re-X合金（涵盖3d、4d、5d过渡金属替代）及其中熵对应物构成一族有吸引力的模型体系，可用于研究结构复杂性、化学无序和自旋轨道耦合对Re基材料超导性的影响。

title: Rational Design of Low-Dimensional Hybrid Organic/Inorganic Interfaces for Enhanced Second-Harmonic Generation
summary: Hybrid interfaces formed by push-pull organic molecules physisorbed on two-dimensional (2D) semiconductors provide a structurally tunable platform for engineering second-harmonic generation (SHG). However, predicting and optimizing their macroscopic response remains a formidable challenge due to the phase-sensitive interference between the nonlinear responses of the adlayer and substrate. Here, we develop a physics-informed computational screening framework that decomposes the effective second-order susceptibility into its constituent substrate, molecular, and electric-field-induced SHG channels. Validated by fully atomistic first-principles calculations across representative interface structures, this model maps the complete orientation-resolved tensor landscape of chemically modulated carbon-conjugated polar molecules on 2D substrates with distinct symmetry. Crucially, our findings dismantle the conventional reliance on static polar descriptors, demonstrating that the ground-state permanent dipole magnitude is a fundamentally unreliable proxy for macroscopic nonlinear response. Instead, we show that the ultimate criterion for SHG maximization is encoded in the phase-resolved projection of the full anisotropic molecular hyperpolarizability tensor. On non-centrosymmetric substrates, the coherent interference between the physisorbed adlayer and the underlying 2D matrix induces a characteristic Fano-like asymmetry and ranking reversals that are entirely absent on centrosymmetric platforms. By establishing that functionalization topology, dynamic spatial orientation, and substrate point-group symmetry constitute a single, non-separable parameter space, this work provides a systematic blueprint for the rational assembly, predictive discovery, and non-invasive characterization of next-generation low-dimensional hybrid materials for nonlinear optoelectronics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出物理信息计算筛选框架，将有效二阶非线性极化率分解为衬底、分子和电场诱导SHG通道，揭示分子超极化率张量的相位分辨投影而非静态偶极是SHG最大化关键，并展示非中心对称衬底上Fano型干涉与排序反转。
AI.motivation: push-pull有机分子在2D半导体上的杂化界面可用于调控二次谐波产生(SHG)，但adlayer与衬底非线性响应之间的相位敏感干涉使宏观响应难以预测和优化。
AI.method: 建立物理信息计算筛选框架，将有效二阶极化率分解为衬底、分子与电场诱导SHG通道；结合全原子第一性原理计算验证，对化学调控的碳共轭极性分子在不同对称性2D衬底上绘制完整的取向分辨张量图景。
AI.result: 基态永久偶极大小不能可靠预测宏观非线性响应；SHG最大化判据在于完整各向异性分子超极化率张量的相位分辨投影。非中心对称衬底上adlayer与2D基体相干干涉产生Fano型不对称与排序反转，而中心对称平台无此现象。
AI.conclusion: 功能化拓扑、动态空间取向和衬底点群对称性构成不可分的统一参数空间，为低维杂化非线性光电子材料的设计、预测发现与非侵入表征提供系统蓝图。

title: Thermal quasi-Devil's staircase in an anisotropic triangular-lattice Rydberg array
summary: A Devil's staircase is a sequence of transitions between topological sectors as a control parameter is varied. Such staircases are predicted in frustrated magnets and lattice gauge theories, but observing them is hard: the winding number that labels each sector is topologically protected, so local quantum dynamics alone cannot move the system from one step to the next. Here we propose and analyze an experimentally feasible way to realize a thermal quasi-Devil's staircase in a finite Rydberg-atom array. We study the anisotropic triangular-lattice Ising antiferromagnet using a dimer mapping, a directed-string description, exact thermodynamics, and Monte Carlo simulations. In the defect-free string manifold, the commensurate--incommensurate onset follows from a simple energy--entropy balance, and the exact Ising critical relation reduces to the same condition when triangle-rule defects are rare. On a finite lattice, this onset appears as a quasi-Devil's staircase of winding-sector crossovers, which we resolve through winding distributions, structure factors, and directional correlations. The key point is that thermal fluctuations overcome the topological barriers that block sector changes under purely quantum dynamics, and the staircase exists precisely at the finite sizes and tunable effective temperatures of current Rydberg platforms. This makes the effect directly observable in existing experiments. Our comparison also shows that the finite-size steps are not phase transitions: in the thermodynamic limit only a single phase transition survives, and the system crosses over to a defect-dominated paramagnet.

AI.tldr: 在有限Rydberg原子阵列中，利用热涨落克服拓扑势垒，实现可观测的准“魔鬼阶梯”（winding扇区交叉）。
AI.motivation: 魔鬼阶梯（控制参数变化时拓扑扇区间的转变序列）在阻挫磁体和格点规范理论中有预言，但因winding数受拓扑保护、局域量子动力学无法使系统跨步，故难以观测。
AI.method: 研究各向异性三角晶格Ising反铁磁体，采用dimer映射、有向弦描述、精确热力学与Monte Carlo模拟。
AI.result: 无缺陷弦流形中公度-非公度起始由能量-熵平衡给出，稀有三角规则缺陷时精确Ising临界关系约化为同一条件；有限晶格上表现为winding扇区交叉的准魔鬼阶梯，通过winding分布、结构因子和方向关联加以分辨。
AI.conclusion: 热涨落可克服纯量子动力学下的拓扑势垒；该阶梯存在于当前Rydberg平台的有限尺寸与可调有效温度下，可直接在现有实验中观测；有限尺寸台阶并非相变，热力学极限下仅存单个相变，系统转而进入缺陷主导的顺磁体。

title: Light-induced rectified orbital magnetization in electron-hole bilayers
summary: Circularly polarized light can rectify orbital motion into a static magnetization through the inverse Faraday effect (IFE), but in electron-hole bilayers the electron and hole contributions cancel exactly when their properties are equivalent. We show that electron-hole bilayers in transition-metal dichalcogenide platforms avoid this cancellation through effective-mass asymmetry alone, and that the surviving orbital IFE is sensitive to interlayer coupling. In the weak-coupling regime, a two-component Drude description yields an induced magnetization of order one Bohr magneton per carrier for representative terahertz driving. In the strong-coupling regime, where the carriers bind into interlayer excitons, we treat the relative motion using a hydrogenic model with a Rytova-Keldysh interaction and obtain a reduced but finite response. We give closed-form expressions that allow estimates across a broad parameter range and identify where the response is largest.

AI.tldr: 电子-空穴双层中由于电子与空穴贡献相互抵消，逆法拉第效应通常被抑制；本文指出过渡金属二硫族化物平台中有效质量不对称可避免抵消，且残余轨道逆法拉第效应受层间耦合调控。
AI.motivation: 圆偏振光可通过逆法拉第效应（IFE）将轨道运动整流为静态磁化，但在电子-空穴双层中，当电子和空穴性质等价时其贡献完全抵消，因此需要寻找打破这种抵消的机制。
AI.method: 以过渡金属二硫族化物电子-空穴双层为平台，利用有效质量不对称打破抵消。弱耦合区采用双组分Drude描述；强耦合区载流子束缚为层间激子，采用含Rytova-Keldysh相互作用的类氢模型处理相对运动。
AI.result: 弱耦合区在典型太赫兹驱动下得到每载流子约一个玻尔磁子的诱导磁化；强耦合区响应虽减弱但有限。给出闭式表达式，可用于广泛参数范围的估计，并识别响应最大的区域。
AI.conclusion: 有效质量不对称足以避免电子-空穴双层中的IFE抵消，残余轨道IFE对层间耦合敏感，闭式结果可用于估计和优化该效应。

title: Projected amorphous topological insulators
comment: 7 Pages, 4 Figures, and 1 Table (Supplemental Material as Ancillary file)
summary: We introduce projected amorphous topological insulators (PATIs) that despite containing only a fraction ($x$) of otherwise randomly selected {\it disconnected} sites of a parent crystal, feature a quantized global topological invariant ({\it strong} PATIs) when its effective Hamiltonian is constructed by integrating out the residual sites of the original lattice. Within the topological regime of the parent model, additionally, there exists a critical $x$ below which such systems foster a {\it fragile} PATI that only supports quantized local topological marker on a small fraction of sites therein. Both strong and fragile PATIs accommodate in-gap modes near the boundary. The system also hosts a normal insulator in the entire trivial parameter regime of the lattice-based model for any $x$, devoid of gapless boundary modes, for which both global topological invariant and local topological marker vanish. We demonstrate these {\it possibly} generic outcomes by starting with a parent square lattice-based model for time-reversal symmetry breaking insulators. Then the strong-to-fragile PATI quantum phase transition, tunable via $x$, is characterized by the {\it mean} correlation length exponent $ν\in (1.00,1.46)$.

AI.tldr: 提出"投影非晶拓扑绝缘体(PATI)"概念：从晶体中随机选取部分断开格点，通过积分掉残余格点构建有效哈密顿量，可实现全局量子化拓扑不变量(strong PATI)或在临界x以下仅具局域拓扑标记(fragile PATI)。
AI.motivation: 探索非晶/无序体系中拓扑性质如何在仅保留部分格点的条件下依然保持量子化，并区分强与脆弱拓扑相。
AI.method: 从破缺时间反演的方晶格母体模型出发，随机选取比例为x的断开格点，积分掉残余格点构造有效哈密顿量，计算全局拓扑不变量、局域拓扑标记及边界态。
AI.result: 发现strong PATI具全局量子化不变量，x低于临界值时出现仅少数格点具局域标记的fragile PATI，两者均有带隙内边界模；平凡区存在无能隙边界模的正常绝缘体。强-脆弱相变由x调控，平均关联长度指数ν∈(1.00,1.46)。
AI.conclusion: 投影非晶拓扑绝缘体可能是一类普适现象，为无序/非晶体系中拓扑相的调控提供了新途径。

title: Bounds on Bose-Einstein Condensation of Higgs modes in a Superconductor
summary: Collective modes in a superconductor correspond to fluctuations in the amplitude (Higgs mode) or the phase (Goldstone mode) of the order parameter. Starting from the BCS Hamiltonian, we derive a microscopic Hamiltonian for the coupled Higgs-Goldstone-electron system that contains all interactions among these degrees of freedom. The Higgs subsystem is a weakly interacting Bose gas: Higgs modes experience a mutual attraction mediated by the virtual exchange of Bogoliubov quasi-particle pairs. They also interact with external electromagnetic-fields with a coupling constant that we derive explicitly. We use this theory to examine whether an optically pumped gas of Higgs modes can undergo Bose-Einstein condensation. We identify a density window, bounded below by the equilibrium condensation criterion and above by collapse due to the attractive interaction, in which condensation can occur and we derive the expected density of Higgs-modes due to external pumping. This pumping depends crucially on non-parabolic corrections to the electron dispersion around the Fermi-energy. We show that the pumped mode density is compatible with condensation for realistic material parameters. We suggest possible experimental signatures of this non-equilibrium condensate.

AI.tldr: 从BCS哈密顿量出发，推导了包含所有相互作用的耦合Higgs-Goldstone-电子微观哈密顿量，并研究光泵浦Higgs模能否发生Bose-Einstein凝聚。
AI.motivation: 超导体中的集体模（Higgs振幅模、Goldstone相位模）是重要自由度，但缺少同时包含集体模-电子间所有相互作用的微观理论，且光泵浦Higgs模的非平衡凝聚可行性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 从BCS哈密顿量推导耦合的Higgs-Goldstone-电子微观哈密顿量；将Higgs子系统视为弱相互作用Bose气体（由Bogoliubov准粒子对虚交换产生相互吸引），并显式推导其与电磁场的耦合常数。
AI.result: 发现一个密度窗口：下界由平衡凝聚判据决定，上界由吸引力导致坍缩决定，其间可发生凝聚；泵浦依赖于费米能附近电子色散的非抛物修正；对现实材料参数，泵浦模密度满足凝聚条件。
AI.conclusion: 光泵浦的Higgs模可在适当密度窗口内形成非平衡Bose-Einstein凝聚，并提出可能的实验特征。

title: Exact phase diagram of the XXZ Heisenberg chain in a staggered magnetic field
summary: We study the phase diagram of the spin-1/2 XXZ Heisenberg chain in a staggered magnetic field. An exact solution is obtained along the phase boundary, where the exchange anisotropy and the staggered-field strength satisfy an exact analytical relation, yielding a highly degenerate manifold of ground states with off-diagonal long-range order. We demonstrate that these exact ground states lie on the boundary between the ferromagnetic phase and a gapless Luttinger liquid phase. Upon further decreasing the anisotropy, the gapless phase eventually gives way to a gapped quantum-disordered phase. Large-scale density-matrix renormalization group calculations confirm this phase structure and indicate that the transition across the exact boundary is of first order. Our results provide an exact benchmark for understanding quantum phase transitions driven by staggered magnetic fields in one-dimensional quantum spin systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究交错磁场下自旋-1/2 XXZ海森堡链的相图，在相边界上给出精确解，并确定相结构与一级相变。
AI.motivation: 理解一维量子自旋系统中由交错磁场驱动的量子相变，并为相变提供精确基准。
AI.method: 在交换各向异性与交错场强度满足精确解析关系时求解模型；使用大规模密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）验证相结构。
AI.result: 精确基态高度简并并具有非对角长程序，位于铁磁相与无能隙Luttinger液体相边界；各向异性进一步降低时，无能隙相进入有能隙量子无序相；跨精确边界的转变为一级相变。
AI.conclusion: 结果为交错磁场驱动的一维量子自旋系统量子相变提供了精确基准。

title: Antisymmetric breathing in altermagnetic skyrmions
summary: A skyrmion in an altermagnet with \(d\) wave symmetry consists of two elliptical sublattice textures with perpendicular long axes. For each sublattice component $η=A,B$, we define an effective skyrmion radius $R_η=\sqrt{a_ηb_η}$, where $a_η$ and $b_η$ are the distances from the skyrmion center to its boundary along $y$ and $x$, respectively. For the anisotropic exchange parameters studied, the equilibrium radius at zero field is smaller than in a reference with parallel sublattice textures and otherwise identical parameters. A magnetic field perpendicular to the film expands one sublattice skyrmion and contracts the other, generating a radius difference $\dR=R_A-R_B$ and a net magnetic moment. The exchange modulation used to represent uniaxial strain also produces a nonzero radius difference at zero field. Because the strong and weak exchange directions are interchanged between the two sublattices, a common directional change of the exchange couplings increases one radius and decreases the other. Unlike the magnetic coupling, this mechanism vanishes when the two sublattice exchange tensors become identical. The radius difference also supports an antisymmetric breathing mode. After a short field pulse, it oscillates in quadrature with the uniform helicity, the common rotation of the wall magnetization within the film plane, at \(49.5\,\mathrm{GHz}\) for the reference parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文研究d波对称交替磁体中的斯格明子结构，其由两个长轴互相垂直的椭圆子晶格织构组成，并探讨磁场与应变对子晶格半径差及动力学的影响。
AI.motivation: 交替磁体具有d波对称时，两个磁性亚晶格可能存在各向异性交换，导致斯格明子呈现不同于常规铁磁体的织构。作者希望理解这种子晶格各向异性如何影响斯格明子的平衡半径、磁矩响应以及动力学模式。
AI.method: 作者为每个亚晶格η定义有效斯格明子半径R_η=√(a_ηb_η)，其中a_η、b_η为沿y、x方向从中心到边界的距离。通过调节各向异性交换参数、垂直磁场以及代表单轴应变的交换调制，研究子晶格织构、半径差ΔR=R_A−R_B与净磁矩的变化，并分析半径差对应的反对称呼吸模式动力学。
AI.result: 在所研究的各向异性交换参数下，零场平衡半径小于具有平行子晶格织构且其他参数相同的参考体系。垂直磁场使一个子晶格斯格明子膨胀、另一个收缩，产生半径差与净磁矩。用于表示单轴应变的交换调制也能在零场下产生非零半径差。由于两个亚晶格的强、弱交换方向互换，交换耦合的共同方向改变会使一个半径增大、另一个减小；该机制在两子晶格交换张量相同时消失。半径差还支持反对称呼吸模式，在短磁场脉冲后与均匀螺旋度以49.5 GHz做正交振荡。
AI.conclusion: d波交替磁体中的斯格明子具有子晶格分辨的椭圆织构与可调控半径差，磁场和应变均可诱导净磁矩与反对称呼吸模式，其动力学通过均匀螺旋度耦合，为交替磁体中斯格明子的调控提供了新机制。

title: Hamiltonian learning reveals optoelectronic mechanisms across thermodynamic state space in soft semiconductors
summary: Predicting optoelectronic response across thermodynamic state space requires coupling finite-temperature nuclear dynamics to electronic structure at scales where direct first-principles calculations are impractical. Machine-learning force fields and Hamiltonian-learning models provide scalable predictions, but integrating them into reliable and interpretable workflows remains challenging. Here, we introduce FLOW-OTTER, a modular, model-agnostic framework that automates molecular dynamics, Hamiltonian prediction, observable extraction, reliability assessment, and Hamiltonian-level interpretation. We demonstrate FLOW-OTTER in halide perovskites, soft semiconductors whose anharmonic fluctuations strongly modulate electronic response. Using FLOW-OTTER, we show that independently learned nuclear and electronic models remain predictive when composed end-to-end, reproducing experimental temperature- and pressure-dependent band-gap trends using models trained only on first-principles targets at zero pressure. By resolving the nonlinear evolution of Pb-$s$/Br-$p$ antibonding at the valence-band maximum, it identifies the microscopic origin of the asymmetric pressure response. FLOW-OTTER thus establishes Hamiltonian learning as a general route from thermodynamic trajectories to experimentally grounded optoelectronic mechanisms.

AI.tldr: FLOW-OTTER：模块化、模型无关框架，自动整合MD、哈密顿量学习、可观测提取与可解释分析，在卤化物钙钛矿中复现实验带隙趋势并揭示压力响应微观起源。
AI.motivation: 预测跨热力学态的光电响应需耦合有限温核动力学与电子结构，但直接第一性原理计算难以扩展；机器学习力场与哈密顿量模型虽可扩展，却难以集成到可靠、可解释的工作流中。
AI.method: 提出FLOW-OTTER：模块化、模型无关框架，自动化分子动力学、哈密顿量预测、可观测提取、可靠性评估及哈密顿量级解释。在卤化物钙钛矿（软半导体、强非谐涨落）中演示，将独立学习的核模型与电子模型端到端组合，仅用零压第一性原理目标训练。
AI.result: 独立学习的核与电子模型组合后仍具预测力，可复现温度与压力依赖的实验带隙趋势（训练数据仅零压）；通过解析价带顶Pb-s/Br-p反键的非线性演化，识别出非对称压力响应的微观起源。
AI.conclusion: FLOW-OTTER确立哈密顿量学习作为从热力学轨迹到实验可验证光电机制的通用路径。

title: From dimensional reduction to tetramerization in mixed ferro-antiferro breathing pyrochlores
summary: We study the spin-1/2 nearest-neighbor Heisenberg model on the breathing pyrochlore lattice in the mixed ferro-antiferromagnetic regime, where one tetrahedral sublattice is antiferromagnetic and the other ferromagnetic. The classical ground-state manifold is then that of the nearest-neighbor face-centered-cubic (fcc) antiferromagnet built from composite tetrahedral moments. Classical Monte Carlo simulations and the self-consistent Gaussian approximation show that thermal order-by-disorder lifts its subextensive degeneracy and selects the collinear Type-I state with wave vector $X=(1,0,0)$ through a strongly first-order transition. Pseudofermion functional renormalization group calculations for $S=1/2$ and $S=1$ reveal a nonmagnetic window adjacent to the decoupled antiferromagnetic-tetrahedron limit, beyond which $X$ order reappears. Density matrix renormalization group calculations show that this window is not featureless: the antiferromagnetic tetrahedra develop nearly ideal tetramer correlations, with four bonds carrying $\langle\mathbf{S}_i\cdot\mathbf{S}_j\rangle\simeq-1/2$ and the two opposite bonds $\simeq+1/4$, while the structure factor retains broad maxima at $X$. A third-order effective Hamiltonian in the tetrahedral-singlet manifold explains this: reversing the sign of the inter-tetrahedron coupling converts Tsunetsugu's dimer selection into a uniform tetramer selection, as confirmed by exact diagonalization. A dynamic high-temperature expansion traces how local tetrahedral excitations give way to low-energy $X$-centered spectral weight. Finally, we place density-functional parameters for eight structures of spin-3/2 breathing chromium thiospinels in the classical phase diagram. The mapping reproduces the $\mathbf{k}=(1,0,0)$ order of CuInCr$_4$S$_8$, accounts for the absence of order in LiGaCr$_4$S$_8$, and predicts Type-I order for LiInCr$_4$S$_8$.

AI.tldr: 研究呼吸烧绿石晶格上混合铁磁-反铁磁Heisenberg模型，揭示热序失序选择Type-I态、非磁窗口中的近理想四聚体关联，并映射到铬硫尖晶石实验。
AI.motivation: 呼吸烧绿石晶格中两个四面体子晶格可分别取反铁磁与铁磁，产生新的阻挫与简并，但其基态选择、量子涨落效应及与真实材料（铬硫尖晶石）的联系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 经典蒙特卡洛与自洽高斯近似；赝费米子泛函重整化群（S=1/2、S=1）；密度矩阵重整化群；四聚体单态流形上的三阶有效哈密顿量+精确对角化；动力学高温展开；密度泛函参数映射到经典相图。
AI.result: 经典热序失序通过强一阶相变选择波矢X=(1,0,0)的共线Type-I态；FRG显示反铁磁四面体极限附近存在非磁窗口，之后X序重现；DMRG表明窗口内反铁磁四面体形成近理想四聚体关联（4个键≃-1/2，2个对边≃+1/4），结构因子在X处保留宽峰；三阶有效哈密顿量解释为互四面体耦合符号反转使Tsunetsugu二聚体选择变为均匀四聚体选择；动力学高温展开追踪局域四面体激发向X中心低能谱权重演化；DFT参数映射再现CuInCr4S8的(1,0,0)序、解释LiGaCr4S8无磁性、预测LiInCr4S8为Type-I序。
AI.conclusion: 混合铁磁-反铁磁呼吸烧绿石中，热涨落选择X序，量子涨落产生带近理想四聚体关联的非磁窗口，其机制由有效哈密顿量的耦合符号反转解释，并成功联系到多种铬硫尖晶石材料的磁性行为。

title: Valley Berry curvature dipole induced nonlinear valley Hall effect
summary: Valley Hall effect is a signature effect in the field of valleytronics, and recent studies have pushed this effect into the nonlinear regime. Here, we reveal a previously unexplored type of nonlinear valley Hall effect which arises from a valley Berry curvature dipole (vBCD) mechanism. We show this nonlinear valley Hall effect is forbidden for conventional time-reversal-connected valleys, but is supported in the class of valleytronic systems featuring time-reversal-invariant valleys. The candidate layer groups and detailed symmetry constraints on vBCD are obtained. It shows the nonlinear valley Hall response, as well as the nonlinear charge Hall response, can be well controlled by tuning the driving field direction. We demonstrate our proposal in an effective model study and in a concrete material example, strained Nb$_{3}$SBr$_{7}$, by first-principles calculations. The nonlocal transport signature of this vBCD induced nonlinear valley Hall effect is also discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种由谷Berry曲率偶极(vBCD)机制产生的新型非线性谷霍尔效应,该效应在时间反演相连的谷中被禁戒,但在时间反演不变的谷体系中可实现,并可通过调控驱动场方向控制响应。
AI.motivation: 谷霍尔效应是谷电子学的标志性效应,近期研究已将其拓展到非线性领域,但由谷Berry曲率偶极驱动的非线性谷霍尔效应尚未被探索。
AI.method: 通过对称性分析获得候选层群及vBCD的对称约束,采用有效模型研究,并通过第一性原理计算在应变Nb$_{3}$SBr$_{7}$材料中验证,同时讨论非局域输运信号。
AI.result: 揭示了vBCD诱导的非线性谷霍尔效应;该效应在常规时间反演相连谷中禁戒,而在时间反演不变谷体系中存在;非线性谷霍尔响应与非线性电荷霍尔响应均可通过调节驱动场方向控制;在应变Nb$_{3}$SBr$_{7}$中得到验证并给出非局域输运特征。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出并验证了一种新的vBCD机制非线性谷霍尔效应,为谷电子学非线性输运提供了新方向,并给出可实验探测的材料候选与非局域输运信号。

title: Selective strain tuning of nonequilibrium multiferroic dynamics in BiFeO$_\text3$
comment: 15 pages, 4 main figures and 8 Supplemental Material figures
summary: Quantum materials are characterized by intertwined orders, and a fundamental goal in condensed matter physics is to achieve their selective control in such a way that one order parameter can be tuned while leaving others largely unaffected. Although significant progress has been made in thermal equilibrium, realizing such control out of equilibrium remains highly challenging. Here we employed \textit{in situ} tensile strain to selectively manipulate the photoinduced lattice dynamics associated with ferroelectric and magnetic orders in multiferroic BiFeO$_3$. By applying MeV ultrafast electron diffraction to freestanding BiFeO$_3$ membranes under tunable strain, we showed that tensile strain markedly suppresses the ultrafast photoinduced reduction of the ferroelectric displacement. By contrast, the photoinduced dynamics of the antiferrodistortive rotation of the oxygen octahedra, which modulates the magnetic order, remains insensitive to strain. Not only do these findings reveal distinct microscopic pathways underlying nonequilibrium multiferroic dynamics, they also establish tunable strain as an effective route for engineering ultrafast phase control in correlated materials.

AI.tldr: 通过原位拉伸应变选择性调控多铁BiFeO₃薄膜中超快光诱导的晶格动力学：铁电位移响应被显著抑制，而反铁畸变氧八面体旋转几乎不变。
AI.motivation: 量子材料存在相互交织的有序态，核心目标是实现选择性调控（调节一个序参量而不影响其他）。平衡态已有进展，但非平衡态下的选择性控制仍具挑战。
AI.method: 对自由悬浮BiFeO₃薄膜施加可控原位拉伸应变，结合MeV超快电子衍射，测量光诱导的铁电位移与反铁畸变氧八面体旋转动力学。
AI.result: 拉伸应变显著抑制光诱导的铁电位移减小；而调控磁序的氧八面体反铁畸变旋转的光诱导动力学对应变不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了非平衡多铁动力学的不同微观路径，并确立可调应变作为相关材料超快相控制的有效手段。

title: A Spatial Localizer for Constituent-Resolved Exciton Wannier Functions
summary: Excitons are composite quasiparticles: beyond a center-of-mass position, each carries an internal electron-hole dipole governing its coupling to electric fields and other excitons. Exciton Wannier functions locally represent exciton bands, but resolving this dipole requires localizing the electron and hole simultaneously. We show that, in one dimension, the projected electron and hole position operators fail to commute when the covariant derivative of the quantum geometric dipole (QGD) matrix (the difference between the hole and electron non-Abelian Berry connections) is nonzero. This precludes a common eigenbasis and bounds the joint electron-hole spread from below. For one band, the internal dipole is gauge invariant and center-of-mass methods suffice; for multiple bands, no existing construction yields a gauge minimizing both position uncertainties. We introduce an ``exciton spatial localizer,'' a Hermitian operator embedding both projected positions in a Clifford-algebra structure. Its spectral minima locate the exciton's center-of-mass and dipole coordinates, while its eigenvectors yield exciton Wannier functions jointly localized in electron and hole coordinates without gauge fixing, an ansatz, or iterative optimization. In an interacting bilayer model, combined reflection--time-reversal symmetry or a nonsymmorphic particle--hole symmetry forces the QGD matrix to be traceless at every momentum while allowing it to remain nonzero. A two-band exciton subspace with zero net internal dipole then decomposes into a symmetry-related pair of exciton Wannier functions with opposite center-of-mass positions and internal dipoles. Adding the interlayer dipole as a Clifford component further separates intralayer and interlayer exciton Wannier functions in a six-band subspace.

AI.tldr: 本文研究激子Wannier函数的联合电子-空穴局域化问题，提出"激子空间定位子"算子以实现无需规范固定的激子Wannier函数。
AI.motivation: 激子作为复合准粒子除质心位置外还携带内部电子-空穴偶极，但现有激子Wannier函数方法无法同时局域化电子与空穴，且多带情况下缺乏同时最小化两者位置不确定性的规范构造。
AI.method: 证明在一维中，当量子几何偶极(QGD)矩阵的协变导数非零时，投影的电子与空穴位置算符不对易，无法共享本征基；构造一个将两个投影位置嵌入Clifford代数结构的厄米"激子空间定位子"算子。
AI.result: 该算子的谱极小值定位激子的质心与偶极坐标，本征矢给出联合局域化的激子Wannier函数；在相互作用双层模型中，对称性迫使QGD矩阵在每个动量处无迹但可非零，零净偶极的双带子空间分解为对称相关的激子Wannier函数对。
AI.conclusion: 激子空间定位子提供了一种无需规范固定、无猜试或迭代优化的激子Wannier函数构造方法，并可通过引入层间偶极作为Clifford分量进一步分离层内与层间激子。

title: Quantum heat transport and effects of quantum thermal devices in noncommuting coupled spins
summary: Quantum heat transport governs energy exchange processes and statistical laws in non-equilibrium quantum systems, and plays a pivotal role in quantum thermodynamics. We investigate the steady-state thermal transport of a noncommuting coupled spin system. We employ the quantum dressed master equation approach within the framework of open quantum system theory to accurately analyze the non-equilibrium dynamics, ensuring the validity of transport results in the strong coupling regime. Our results demonstrate that noncommuting spin coupling serves as a significant resource for modulating the nonlinearity of the heat current. Specifically, in the weak spin-coupling regime, the system exhibits robust negative differential thermal conductance (NDTC) across various spin numbers. By deriving analytical expressions for the heat current in both the single-spin and large-spin limits, we reveal that this NDTC behavior is governed by microscopic cycle fluxes. Physically, this arises because spin excitation channels induced by the cold reservoir are suppressed under a large temperature bias, thereby blocking energy exchange cycles. Conversely, in the strong spin-coupling and large temperature bias regime, the quantum system demonstrates pronounced thermal rectification. This high rectification efficiency originates from the unidirectional saturation of the heat current, rendering the system a promising candidate for high-performance thermal diodes. Furthermore, we extend the model to a three-terminal configuration to construct a quantum thermal transistor. By manipulating the temperature of the gate reservoir, we achieve efficient modulation and amplification of heat flow between the source and drain. The heat amplification factor is shown to far exceed unity in specific operating regions, confirming significant thermal amplification.

AI.tldr: 研究非对易耦合自旋系统的稳态热输运，揭示NDTC起源于微观循环流，强耦合下具有高热整流效率，并构建三端量子热晶体管实现热放大。
AI.motivation: 量子热输运是量子热力学与非平衡量子系统的核心问题，非对易耦合自旋系统的强耦合热输运机制尚需准确刻画，且其调控资源（非线性、整流、放大）有待挖掘。
AI.method: 采用开放量子系统框架下的量子缀饰主方程（dressed master equation）方法，保证强耦合区输运结果有效性；推导单自旋与大自旋极限下的热流解析表达式，并扩展至三端构型构建量子热晶体管。
AI.result: 弱自旋耦合下多种自旋数均呈现稳健负微分热导（NDTC），由微观循环流主导——大温差抑制冷库诱导的自旋激发通道从而阻断能量交换循环；强耦合与大温差下实现显著热整流，源于热流的单向饱和；三端器件通过调控门库温度实现热流高效调制与放大，放大因子远超1。
AI.conclusion: 非对易自旋耦合可作为调控热流非线性、整流与放大的重要资源，该系统有望用于高性能热二极管与量子热晶体管。

title: Incipient superconductivity and tunable Chern insulators in twisted Bernal bilayer-trilayer graphene
summary: Moiré superlattices assembled by twisting Bernal and rhombohedral multilayer graphene host a rich set of interaction-driven magnetic and topological states, yet superconductivity has not been observed in these systems except in proximity to a transition-metal dichalcogenide. Here we report incipient superconductivity and tunable Chern insulators in twisted Bernal bilayer-trilayer graphene encapsulated by hexagonal boron nitride. Across twist angles from $θ= 1.05^\circ$ to $1.50^\circ$, Chern insulators form at integer and fractional moiré fillings for electron doping, with Chern numbers up to |C| = 3 set by twist angle and tuned by doping. At $θ= 1.18^\circ$, a symmetry-broken metallic region forms for hole doping and hosts a trivial insulator at band filling $ν= -2$. Displacement field alone drives this insulator into a pocket of incipient superconductivity with a sharp transition, a well-defined critical current, and a critical temperature that peaks near the insulating boundary, although the resistance does not fall to zero. In-plane magnetic field expands the pocket, which persists to more than four times the weak-coupling Pauli limit, and stabilizes a second pocket in which Fraunhofer-like modulation of the critical current signals phase-coherent pairing. Twisted Bernal bilayer-trilayer graphene thus offers a single gate-tunable system in which pairing can be interfaced with Chern insulators whose topology is itself an adjustable parameter.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在hBN封装的扭转Bernal双层-三层石墨烯中观测到初现超导性和可调陈绝缘体。在θ=1.05°–1.50°范围内出现整数和分数填充的陈绝缘体（|C|≤3），并在θ=1.18°时通过位移场将平凡的ν=-2绝缘体驱动为初现超导口袋。
AI.motivation: 扭转Bernal和菱面体多层石墨烯的莫尔超晶格可承载丰富的相互作用驱动磁性和拓扑态，但除在过渡金属二硫化物近邻效应下外，一直未观测到超导性。作者希望在本征扭转多层石墨烯中实现超导并研究其与陈绝缘体的界面。
AI.method: 制备hBN封装的扭转Bernal双层-三层石墨烯器件，在θ=1.05°–1.50°范围内测量输运性质，利用位移场和面内磁场调控电子/空穴掺杂下的陈绝缘体和金属态，观测初现超导、临界电流、临界温度及Fraunhofer型调制。
AI.result: 电子掺杂下形成整数和分数莫尔填充的陈绝缘体，陈数达|C|=3，由扭转角和掺杂调控。在θ=1.18°、空穴掺杂下出现对称性破缺金属区，ν=-2处为平凡绝缘体；位移场将其驱动为初现超导口袋，具有尖锐转变、明确临界电流和靠近绝缘边界的临界温度峰值（但电阻未降至零）。面内磁场扩大口袋，使其持续至弱耦合Pauli极限的四倍以上，并稳定第二个口袋，其中临界电流的Fraunhofer型调制表明相位相干配对。
AI.conclusion: 扭转Bernal双层-三层石墨烯提供了一个单一栅极可调系统，可将配对与陈绝缘体界面化，且陈绝缘体的拓扑本身可作为可调参数。

title: ATLAS: Atomic Translation & Language for Automated Structures
summary: The automated generation of three-dimensional atomic structures from natural-language descriptions remains a persistent challenge, as large language models lack intrinsic geometric reasoning. We introduce ATLAS, a holistic framework that integrates seven modular components-ranging from a density-based structure analyzer and a JSON-based semantic bridge to a deterministic build engine, physical validator, and intent-aware scorer-to translate user prompts into physically valid coordinates. The build engine executes a component algebra that encompasses named structures, unary and binary operations (supercell, resizing, rotation, translation, union, subtraction, intersection), and geometric variables, while the validator enforces periodic-boundary conditions and system-specific checks on bonding, coordination, vacuum, and composition. ATLAS supports nine major build categories, including heterojunctions, surfaces, nanoparticles, and defects, and is equipped with a score-driven automatic refinement loop that leverages a curated test suite for systematic component-level improvement.

AI.tldr: ATLAS 是一个将自然语言转化为三维原子结构的模块化框架，内含结构分析器、语义桥、确定性构建引擎、物理验证器与意图评分器。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型缺乏内在的几何推理能力，直接从自然语言自动生成三维原子结构仍是长期难题。
AI.method: 集成七个模块化组件：基于密度的结构分析器、JSON 语义桥、确定性构建引擎、物理验证器、意图感知评分器等；构建引擎执行组件代数，涵盖命名结构、一元/二元操作（超胞、缩放、旋转、平移、并集、差集、交集）及几何变量；验证器强制周期性边界条件并对成键、配位、真空和组分进行系统专属检查。
AI.result: 支持九大构建类别，包括异质结、表面、纳米颗粒和缺陷，并配有基于评分驱动的自动精炼循环，利用精选测试套件进行系统性组件级改进。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS 为自然语言到物理有效三维原子结构的自动生成提供了整体化、可验证且可迭代优化的解决方案。

title: Library of carbon nanotube junctions: data-driven insights into structure-magnetotransport relationships
summary: Electronic transport in carbon nanotube (CNT) assemblies is controlled by a heterogeneous population of CNT--CNT junctions, yet most microscopic studies consider only a few representative systems. Here, we construct a library of 146 single-walled carbon nanotube (SWCNT)--SWCNT junctions spanning broad structural and electronic diversity and analyse their magnetotransport using an automated workflow combining molecular dynamics, tight-binding theory, Peierls magnetic coupling, and non-equilibrium Green's functions.The resulting transport data are subsequently analysed using machine-learning methods. Two complementary transport descriptors reveal distinct structure--transport hierarchies. The averaged first transmission-step value is governed primarily by the mean chiral angle of the two nanotubes forming a junction, whereas the energy gap of the junction depends predominantly on the metallic or semiconducting character of the constituent CNTs. Temperature generally suppresses the averaged transmission while reducing the extracted gap, whereas a perpendicular magnetic field affects transmission much more strongly than the gap. Signatures of interference-driven transport remain visible even at $300~\mathrm{K}$. Notably, semiconducting--semiconducting junctions retain the largest gaps but, once shifted into their conducting regime, can exhibit transmission comparable to or exceeding that of metallic junctions. These results establish statistically robust junction-level trends that can inform future network-scale models of CNT assemblies.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了146个单壁碳纳米管(SWCNT)-SWCNT结的库，结合分子动力学、紧束缚理论、Peierls磁耦合与非平衡格林函数自动化工作流分析磁输运，并用机器学习揭示两类结构-输运层级规律。
AI.motivation: CNT集合体的电子输运由异质多样的CNT-CNT结主导，但多数微观研究仅考虑少数代表性体系，缺乏统计稳健的结级规律。
AI.method: 构建覆盖广泛结构与电子多样性的146个SWCNT-SWCNT结库；采用分子动力学+紧束缚+Peierls磁耦合+NEGF的自动化工作流计算磁输运；用机器学习方法分析输运数据，提取两个互补输运描述符。
AI.result: 平均第一透射台阶值主要由两纳米管平均手性角决定，而结能隙主要取决于组成CNT的金属/半导体性质；温度整体抑制平均透射并降低提取能隙，垂直磁场对透射影响远大于能隙；300K下仍可见干涉驱动输运特征；半导体-半导体结保持最大能隙，进入导电区后透射可媲美或超过金属结。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了统计稳健的结级趋势，可为未来CNT集合体的网络尺度模型提供依据。

title: Symmetry-protected intraband exciton-phonon scattering and its breakdown by mass asymmetry
summary: The coupling of excitons to lattice vibrations is typically treated via phenomenological models that artificially separate long-range Fröhlich and short-range Holstein interactions. Recent analytical work has established that, in the delocalized limit, Fröhlich scattering is suppressed by electron--hole interference. Here we present a model-space Bethe--Salpeter framework to evaluate exciton--phonon coupling across the extended-to-localized crossover. We establish a fundamental distinction between the \emph{inclusive} exciton--phonon coupling weight, obtainable via an exact completeness sum rule without summation over excited states, and the \emph{exclusive} intraband (internal-state-preserving) scattering amplitude that governs low-energy decoherence. We prove an exact symmetry theorem: for an inversion-symmetric relative-coordinate Hamiltonian with equal electron and hole masses, the intraband Fröhlich vertex vanishes identically, protecting the exciton from low-energy polar phonon scattering. When mass asymmetry is introduced, the finite-momentum relative wavefunction acquires a complex phase twist that breaks this protection. By analyzing the long-wavelength limit, we derive a controlled small-$q$ activation law showing that the intraband vertex scales as $F_{00}(q) \propto Δq^2 \langle r^2 \rangle$, where $Δ$ parameterizes the mass asymmetry. Finally, we compute the second-order polaron self-energy shift and demonstrate that mass asymmetry dramatically enhances phonon dressing, confirming that the symmetry theorem directly governs the many-body energy renormalization of the exciton. These results provide a rigorous conceptual framework for understanding the competition between long-range and local exciton--phonon coupling in polar semiconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出模型空间Bethe-Salpeter框架研究激子-声子耦合，区分inclusive耦合权重与exclusive带内散射振幅，证明电子-空穴质量相等时带内Fröhlich顶点严格为零的对称性定理，并给出质量不对称下的小q激活律。
AI.motivation: 传统唯象模型人为分离长程Fröhlich与短程Holstein相互作用；近期解析工作表明在离域极限下Fröhlich散射受电子-空穴干涉抑制，需要统一框架描述从离域到局域的整个交叉区域。
AI.method: 采用模型空间Bethe-Salpeter框架，结合完备性求和规则（无需对激发态求和）计算inclusive耦合权重；定义exclusive带内散射振幅描述低能退相干；并推导长波极限下的小q行为及二阶极化子自能移动。
AI.result: 证明精确对称性定理：反演对称相对坐标哈密顿量且电子空穴质量相等时，带内Fröhlich顶点恒为零；质量不对称引入复相位扭转破坏保护，带内顶点满足F00(q) ∝ Δq²⟨r²⟩；二阶自能计算显示质量不对称显著增强声子修饰。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解极性半导体中长程与局域激子-声子耦合竞争提供了严格的概念框架，并表明对称性定理直接支配激子的多体能量重整化。

title: Nodal-Line Semimetals with Non-Quantized Berry Phase
summary: Nodal-line semimetals (NLSMs) are topological materials characterized by one-dimensional band crossings in momentum space, which typically carry a Berry phase quantized to integer multiples of $π$. Here, we extend the conventional paradigm to a class of NLSMs in which the Berry phase can take arbitrary fractional or even irrational multiples of $π$. This non-quantized Berry phase leads to a splitting of Landau levels when a magnetic field is applied parallel to the nodal ring, an effect that can be detected via Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations in the magnetoconductivity. Despite the absence of a quantized topological invariant, drumhead-like surface states with weak dispersion persist at open boundaries. Notably, two identical surface states localize on the same boundary, in contrast to conventional NLSMs, where they reside on opposite boundaries. A systematic symmetry analysis shows that such NLSMs can be realized in a broad range of magnetic space groups. Our work opens a new avenue for exploring NLSMs beyond the conventional framework of a quantized Berry phase.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一类新型节线半金属，其贝里相位可取任意分数甚至无理数倍的π，而非传统的量子化整数倍，并预言了朗道能级劈裂、鼓面膜表面态及广泛磁空间群实现。
AI.motivation: 传统节线半金属的贝里相位被量子化为π的整数倍，这一范式限制了对更广义拓扑物态的探索，作者希望突破该限制。
AI.method: 通过理论建模与系统对称性分析，研究非量子化贝里相位节线半金属的能带与拓扑性质，并分析其在磁空间群中的可实现性。
AI.result: 发现磁场平行于节线环时朗道能级发生劈裂（可由Shubnikov-de Haas振荡探测）；开边界下存在弱色散的鼓面膜表面态，且两个相同表面态局域于同一边界；该系统可在广泛磁空间群中实现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作突破了量子化贝里相位的传统框架，为探索新型节线半金属开辟了新方向。

title: Exact benchmarks for the plasmon-pole approximation: Multi-scale screening and the breakdown of the quasiparticle picture
summary: The $GW$ approximation is the gold standard for calculating quasiparticle band structures, yet its computational cost frequently necessitates the use of the plasmon-pole approximation (PPA). While PPA is known to be highly accurate for simple metals and weakly correlated semiconductors, its regime of validity in materials with competing energy scales remains poorly quantified. Here, we construct an exact, numerical benchmark of the PPA using the Lehmann representation of the density response on finite one-dimensional Hubbard clusters. By analytically convolving the exact non-interacting Green's function $G_0$ with the exact pole representation of the screened interaction $W$, we compute the $GW$ self-energy without numerical frequency integration. We demonstrate that in single-scale Mott insulators, the moment-conserving PPA is essentially exact. However, in multi-band semiconductors where interband transitions introduce a low-energy screening channel that competes with high-energy Mott fluctuations, the PPA systematically misjudges the quasiparticle gap by several electron-volts. Furthermore, we show that strong multi-pole screening can drive the exact quasiparticle weight $Z \to 0$, destroying the quasiparticle picture-an effect entirely missed by the PPA, which artificially stabilizes sharp quasiparticles. Finally, we propose a computationally inexpensive diagnostic based on the polydispersity of the loss function's spectral weight, which accurately predicts PPA failure \textit{ab initio}. Our results provide a rigorous framework for assessing the validity of dynamical screening approximations in strongly correlated materials.

AI.tldr: 本文对等离激元近似(PPA)在强关联材料中的有效性进行严格数值基准测试，发现多能带体系中PPA会严重误判准粒子带隙并错误地稳定准粒子图像。
AI.motivation: GW近似是计算准粒子能带结构的金标准，但计算成本高，常需采用等离激元近似(PPA)。PPA在简单金属和弱关联半导体中很准，但在存在竞争能量尺度的材料中其有效性尚缺乏定量评估。
AI.method: 在一维有限Hubbard团簇上，利用密度响应的Lehmann表示构建PPA的精确数值基准。通过将精确的非相互作用格林函数G0与屏蔽相互作用的精确极点表示解析卷积，无需数值频率积分即可计算GW自能。
AI.result: 在单尺度Mott绝缘体中，保矩PPA基本精确；但在多能带半导体中，带间跃迁引入与高能Mott涨落竞争的低能屏蔽通道，PPA系统性地误判准粒子带隙达数电子伏特。强多极点屏蔽可导致精确准粒子权重Z→0，破坏准粒子图像，而PPA完全遗漏此效应，反而人为稳定尖锐准粒子。作者提出基于损失函数谱权重多分散性的低成本诊断方法，可从头准确预测PPA失效。
AI.conclusion: 研究为评估强关联材料中动态屏蔽近似的有效性提供了严格框架，并给出了预测PPA失效的实用诊断工具。

title: Cavity-waveguide coupling in phononic crystals
summary: Phononic crystal platforms provide a promising route toward scalable on-chip quantum networks, where mechanical excitations mediate interactions between solid-state qubits. A key building block of such architectures is the cavity-waveguide system, in which localized mechanical modes couple to propagating phononic modes. However, a quantitative understanding of the mechanisms governing this coupling remains incomplete. In this work, we investigate the interaction between localized modes of snowflake-type phononic crystal cavities and a phononic crystal waveguide using finite-element simulations and experimental measurements. We show that the coupling strength is primarily governed by the spatial overlap between the displacement fields of the corresponding isolated cavity and waveguide modes. After accounting for the effective-mass dependence of the normalized cavity displacement amplitude, we establish a strong correlation between the spatial overlap and the interaction strength across a wide range of mode combinations. Deviations from this leading-order behavior are associated with Bloch-phase effects, variations in waveguide group velocity, and intrinsic hybridization of waveguide modes. Furthermore, we provide experimental evidence for cavity-waveguide coupling in a GaAs phononic crystal membrane by observing a clear resonance in the spectral broadening of the photoluminescence emission from an embedded quantum dot, which serves as a local probe of the mechanical field. The observed resonance at approximately 398 MHz is in good agreement with the corresponding cavity resonance near 395 MHz predicted by finite-element simulations. Our results identify spatial mode overlap as a leading-order design parameter for cavity-waveguide coupling and provide practical guidelines for controlling interactions between localized and propagating modes in phononic crystal structures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过有限元仿真与实验测量，研究雪花型声子晶体腔局域模与声子晶体波导传播模的耦合，证明耦合强度主要由孤立腔模与波导模位移场的空间重叠决定，并在GaAs声子晶体薄膜中实验验证了约398 MHz的腔-波导耦合共振。
AI.motivation: 声子晶体平台有望实现可扩展的片上量子网络，其中腔-波导系统是核心构建单元，但局域机械模与传播声子模之间耦合机制的定量理解仍不完整，缺乏明确的设计规律。
AI.method: 采用有限元仿真研究雪花型声子晶体腔局域模与波导模的相互作用，计算孤立腔模与波导模位移场的空间重叠，并考虑归一化腔位移幅度的有效质量依赖；同时在GaAs声子晶体薄膜中，以嵌入量子点光致发光谱展宽作为机械场的局域探针进行实验测量。
AI.result: 空间重叠与耦合强度在广泛模式组合下呈现强相关性；偏离主导阶行为可归因于Bloch相位效应、波导群速度变化及波导模的固有杂化；实验观测到约398 MHz的展宽共振，与仿真预测的约395 MHz腔共振吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 空间模式重叠是腔-波导耦合的主导阶设计参数，为声子晶体结构中局域模与传播模相互作用的调控提供了实用设计指南。

title: X2SBench: an open benchmark for evaluating crystal structure determination from powder diffraction
comment: 36 pages including 11 pages of supplementary information
summary: Progress towards practical powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) structure determination requires evaluation beyond small crystals and idealized patterns. X2SBench combines 152,587 simulated structure-pattern pairs with 591 curated measurements, extending evaluation to larger cells, lower-symmetry structures and diverse compositions. Fixed splits, defined inputs and common structural metrics support comparisons by crystal system, atom count and element count. Joint stratification locates weaknesses within these groups. On 558 paired targets, an X2SBench-fine-tuned model improves recovery from simulated patterns but loses accuracy on measured inputs, revealing a gap in experimental transfer. Background subtraction and smoothing improve recovery for one tested checkpoint, while augmentation and reference-lattice comparisons identify further opportunities for measurement adaptation and reliable cell estimation. An open platform provides data access and standardized result submission, establishing a shared basis for community evaluation and progress towards practical PXRD analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出X2SBench基准，用大规模模拟与实测PXRD数据评估结构解析，揭示模拟到实验的迁移差距。
AI.motivation: 实用PXRD结构解析需超越小晶体与理想图谱的评估，现有评测范围与标准化不足。
AI.method: 构建152,587对模拟结构-图谱与591条实测数据，覆盖更大晶胞、低对称与多元组成；设定固定划分、统一输入与结构指标，按晶系、原子数和元素数分层比较。
AI.result: 在558个配对目标上，微调模型提升模拟图谱恢复率，但实测输入准确率下降；背景扣除与平滑对某检查点有益，增强与参考晶格对比可改进测量适配与晶胞估计。
AI.conclusion: 提供开放平台与标准化提交，建立社区评估基础，推动实用PXRD分析。

title: Spin-Polarized Magnetic Metal Electrodes for Magnetic Tunnel Junctions
comment: 40 pages, 7 figures, Invited perspective published online at MetalMat
summary: Magnetic tunnel junctions are foundational components of spintronic memory, sensing, and computing, and their performance depends critically on the magnetic metallic electrodes. This Perspective examines electrode materials through the lens of magnetic order and the distinct microscopic mechanisms that generate spin-selective tunneling. Conventional ferromagnets, including CoFeB and half-metallic Heusler alloys, support exchange-split electronic states and symmetry-filtered tunneling, whereas compensated collinear and noncollinear antiferromagnets exploit sublattice selectivity, spin-orbit anisotropy, vector spin textures, and magnetic multipoles. Altermagnets provide a collinear, zero-net-moment route based on symmetry-allowed momentum-dependent spin splitting. Across these material classes, we compare the origins of tunneling polarization, the roles of barrier evanescent states and interface termination, and strategies for electrically writing and reading the relevant magnetic order. This comparison reveals a broader design principle: effective electrode polarization is not a scalar bulk quantity, but a momentum-, orbital-, symmetry-, and interface-resolved transport property. Beyond the pursuit of ever larger tunneling magnetoresistance, future progress will depend on converting the unconventional spin polarization of emerging magnetic metals into electrically addressable, thermally robust, and reproducible tunneling functionality at realistic interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文综述磁性隧道结电极材料，从磁序与自旋选择性隧穿机制角度比较铁磁体、半金属、补偿共线/非共线反铁磁体及交替磁体，提出电极极化应是动量、轨道、对称性和界面分辨的输运性质。
AI.motivation: 磁性隧道结性能关键取决于磁性金属电极，但传统以体相标量极化理解电极的方式不足以描述新兴磁序材料中的复杂隧穿机制。
AI.method: 以磁序和自旋选择性隧穿微观机制为视角，系统比较不同电极材料类别：CoFeB等传统铁磁体与半金属Heusler合金、补偿共线与非共线反铁磁体、交替磁体；并比较隧穿极化起源、势垒衰逝态、界面终止及电学读写策略。
AI.result: 揭示有效电极极化不是标量体相量，而是动量、轨道、对称性和界面共同决定的输运性质；不同材料通过交换劈裂、对称性过滤、子晶格选择性、自旋轨道各向异性、矢量自旋织构和磁多极等机制产生自旋选择性隧穿。
AI.conclusion: 未来进展不再仅追求更大隧穿磁阻，而在于将新兴磁性金属的非常规自旋极化转化为现实界面下可电学寻址、热稳定且可重复的隧穿功能。

title: Unified description of exciton, phonon and plasmon dispersions in 2D materials from an optical conductivity approximation
summary: The modified Coulomb interaction in two-dimensional (2D) materials gives rise to unique, non-analytic low-momentum dispersions of excitons, phonons, and plasmons. Here, we describe the 2D dispersion of longitudinal excitations by introducing the optical conductivity approximation (OCA), a unified framework that evaluates the finite-q longitudinal response probed by electron energy-loss spectroscopy (q-EELS) by only using the q = 0 optical conductivity. By doing so, the approach demonstrates that the linear dispersion of all the above mentioned excitations is mainly due to the form of the 2D macroscopic Coulomb interaction rather than to the dispersion of the underlying band structure. Applying this approach to hexagonal boron nitride and graphene we accurately reproduce the energy and intensity dispersions of the hBN longitudinal-optical phonon and low-energy bright excitons, along with the graphene pi-plasmon. Our work also provides an efficient computational scheme to describe low momentum EELS data without the need to calculate the response functions at dense moment

AI.tldr: 提出光学电导率近似(OCA)统一框架，仅用q=0光学电导率即可计算二维材料有限q纵向响应，揭示激子、声子、等离激元的线性色散主要源于二维宏观库仑相互作用形式。
AI.motivation: 二维材料中修正的库仑相互作用导致激子、声子、等离激元出现独特的低动量非解析色散，且传统q-EELS计算需在密集动量点计算响应函数，代价高昂。作者希望建立一个统一且高效的理论框架来解释并预测这些色散。
AI.method: 引入光学电导率近似(OCA)，通过仅使用q=0的光学电导率来评估由q-EELS探测的有限q纵向响应，建立统一描述二维纵向激发的框架。将该方法应用于六方氮化硼(hBN)和石墨烯进行验证。
AI.result: OCA准确重现了hBN纵向光学声子及低能亮激子的能量和强度色散，以及石墨烯的π等离激元。研究表明这些激发的线性色散主要来自二维宏观库仑相互作用形式，而非能带结构色散。同时提供了无需在密集动量点计算响应函数的高效计算方案。
AI.conclusion: OCA为二维材料低动量EELS数据提供了高效、统一的描述方法，阐明了二维库仑相互作用在决定激发色散中的主导作用，并可推广至其他二维体系。

title: Real-axis least-squares bath discretization for real-time transport in quantum-dot Josephson junctions
summary: Efficient real-time methods are essential for resolving transient coherence and nonlinear transport in driven superconducting nanostructures. Such simulations remain challenging because finite representations of the BCS continuum generate recurrences, while the damping used to suppress them smears gap-edge structure and artificially shortens coherent lifetimes; finite-broadening regularization of the gap-edge singularity likewise imposes a lifetime-resolution floor. Here we extend the driven Liouville--von Neumann approach to superconducting reservoirs---a noninteracting quantum dot with Bogoliubov--de Gennes leads---building an explicit-Hamiltonian framework that hosts a family of bath discretizations (uniform and Gaussian baselines and a new real-axis least-squares recipe, with mode energies, spectral weights, and mode-resolved dampings optimized jointly under gap-aware constraints)---making the broadening an independently calibrated numerical parameter whose leading long-time effect extrapolates controllably along the joint ($γ\to0$, $N_b\to\infty$) refinement path while cutting computational cost by over an order of magnitude versus the high-resolution DLvN reference. The compressed baths recover established current-phase relations, multiple-Andreev-reflection structure, quasiparticle-trapping oscillations, and integer and fractional Shapiro locking; the lifetime analysis yields the parameter-free leading-order relation $κ\simeq w_{\mathrm{bath}}γ_{\mathrm{eff}}$ and resolves damping-induced decay rates below the resolution scale of a previous finite-broadening calculation. As an explicit Hamiltonian reservoir representation, the framework generalizes naturally to multiterminal normal--superconducting geometries and offers a route toward interacting impurity solvers, while finite-gap strong-drive locking amplitudes mark its present quantitative boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文将driven Liouville-von Neumann方法扩展到超导储层（BdG引线），构建显式Hamiltonian框架，通过联合优化的浴离散化（含新的实轴最小二乘方案）实现高效、可控的瞬态相干与非线性输运模拟。
AI.motivation: 驱动超导纳米结构中的瞬态相干与非线性输运模拟亟需高效实时方法，但现有方法面临两大难题：BCS连续谱的有限表示会产生recurrences，而用于抑制它的阻尼会抹平gap-edge结构并人为缩短相干寿命；此外gap-edge奇异性的有限展宽正则化也会施加寿命分辨率下限。
AI.method: 将driven Liouville-von Neumann方法扩展到超导储层，即非相互作用量子点加Bogoliubov-de Gennes引线，构建显式Hamiltonian框架；提供一族浴离散化方案（均匀、高斯基线及新的实轴最小二乘方案），联合优化模能量、谱权重和模分辨阻尼并施加gap-aware约束，使展宽成为可独立校准的数值参数。
AI.result: 压缩浴复现了电流-相位关系、多重Andreev反射结构、准粒子俘获振荡以及整数和分数Shapiro锁定；寿命分析给出无参数领头阶关系κ≈w_bath·γ_eff，并分辨出低于先前有限展宽方法分辨率尺度的阻尼诱导衰减率；计算成本相比高分辨率DLvN参考降低一个数量级以上；领头长时效应沿联合(γ→0, N_b→∞)细化路径可控外推。
AI.conclusion: 作为显式Hamiltonian储层表示，该框架可自然推广到多端normal-superconducting几何，并为相互作用杂质求解器提供路径；有限gap强驱动锁定幅度标记了当前的定量边界。

title: Anisotropic Magnetic and Transport Properties of RAlGe (R = Y, Gd-Tm, Lu)
summary: We grew single crystals of the RAlGe family for R = Y, Gd-Tm, Lu and characterized them with powder X-ray diffraction, temperature dependent specific heat measurements as well as temperature and field dependent resistance and magnetization measurements. These RAlGe materials crystallize in an orthorhombic Cmcm crystal structure in which the R atoms occupy a position with $m$2$m$ point symmetry. We find that when R is a moment bearing rare earth atom, the RAlGe materials order antifferomagnetically at $T_{\text{N}}$ ranging from 5 K (TmAlGe) to 39 K (TbAlGe). A second, lower temperature antiferromagnetic transition is also detected in the range 6-8 K for R = Tb-Ho, but no lower transition is observed (for T above 1.8 K) for R = Er, Tm. The R = Tb-Tm members show evidence for strong crystal field effects influencing the physical properties, where the crystal field favors an easy $a$-axis for R = Tb-Ho and an easy $b$-axis for R = Er, Tm. Of these compounds, strongly uniaxial behavior is observed for DyAlGe and TmAlGe. At T = 2 K, rich metamagnetism is observed when the external field is applied along the $a$-axis for R = Tb--Ho, whereas a single metamagnetic transition is observed (up to 70 kOe) with the field along the $b$-axis when R = Er and Tm. All RAlGe materials show metallic transport behavior and have moderate positive magnetoresistance up to 60-150 % at 2 K superimposed on top of metamagnetic features. The field dependent magnetization measurements on non-moment bearing YAlGe show clear de Haas-van Alphen oscillations, indicating the Fermi surface includes small, high mobility pockets.

AI.tldr: 本文生长了RAlGe（R=Y, Gd-Tm, Lu）单晶，系统研究了其晶体结构、磁性与输运性质，发现除Y和Lu外均反铁磁有序，并表现出强晶场效应、丰富变磁性及de Haas-van Alphen振荡。
AI.motivation: 探究RAlGe家族稀土金属间化合物的磁性与输运性质，理解稀土磁矩、晶场效应及费米面特征对该体系物理性质的影响。
AI.method: 生长R=Y、Gd-Tm、Lu的RAlGe单晶；采用粉末X射线衍射确定结构，结合变温比热、变温变场电阻与磁化测量进行表征。
AI.result: 材料为Cmcm正交结构，R占m2m对称位置；磁性稀土时反铁磁有序，TN从5 K(TmAlGe)到39 K(TbAlGe)；Tb-Ho在6-8 K出现第二磁转变，Er、Tm无；Tb-Tm有强晶场效应，Tb-Ho易轴a、Er-Tm易轴b，DyAlGe和TmAlGe呈强单轴行为；Tb-Ho沿a轴出现丰富变磁性，Er、Tm沿b轴单一变磁转变；均呈金属输运并有60-150%正磁阻；YAlGe显示de Haas-van Alphen振荡，表明费米面有小的高迁移率口袋。
AI.conclusion: RAlGe家族展现了由稀土磁矩和晶场效应调控的多样反铁磁与变磁行为，并具有金属性输运及小费米面口袋特征，为研究稀土磁性金属间化合物提供了良好平台。
