title: Pomeranchuk-like electronic localization above 100 K in twisted MoS$_{2}$
summary: Twisted transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) have manifested a rich variety of emerging physical phenomena, yet experimental studies have so far been largely limited in their valence bands (p-doped). Here, we show correlated electronic states in the conduction bands (n-doped) of near-AA-twisted bilayer MoS$_2$ with twist angles ranging from $\sim2.3^\circ$ to $\sim3.5^\circ$, down to the mK temperature regime. A strongly reconstructed correlated phase diagram as a function of twist-angle has been observed - correlated gaps persist to temperatures approaching $160$ K at small twist angles, but collapse to only $\sim20$ K at intermediate angles, where a richer landscape of interaction-driven states emerges. At the largest twist-angle $\sim 3.5\,^{\circ}$, correlated resistance at 1 electron per moiré unit cell is enhanced upon heating, consistent with thermally assisted localization, or, a Pomeranchuk-like behaviour. Its magnetic-field response, however, is highly anisotropic, which differs markedly from that of canonical isospin moiré Pomeranchuk effect in graphene systems. Strikingly, such signature can persist even above 100 K around a filling of 2 electrons per moiré, despite of its weak resistive nature. Our results establish the twisted MoS$_2$ as a platform for studying the complexity of charge localization, internal flavour degrees of freedom, and band topology in conduction bands of semiconducting moiré systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文在近AA堆叠的转角双层MoS2导带中观察到强关联电子态，揭示随转角变化的关联相图及反常Pomeranchuk样行为。
AI.motivation: 转角TMD研究此前主要局限于价带（p掺杂），导带（n掺杂）中的关联物理尚待探索。
AI.method: 制备转角约2.3°–3.5°的近AA堆叠双层MoS2，在mK温区测量其n掺杂导带的输运与磁响应。
AI.result: 观察到随转角强烈重构的关联相图：小转角关联能隙可维持至约160 K，中间转角骤降至约20 K且呈现更丰富的相互作用驱动态；3.5°时每莫尔元胞1电子处电阻随升温增强，类似热助局域或Pomeranchuk行为，但磁响应高度各向异性，区别于石墨烯体系；该特征在约100 K以上、每莫尔2电子填充处仍可持续。
AI.conclusion: 转角MoS2可作为研究半导体莫尔体系导带中电荷局域化、内禀味道自由度与能带拓扑复杂性的平台。

title: Radiation-technological processes under intense irradiation of a complex fractal medium
summary: A fracton model of a complex medium has been constructed to study physicochemical processes for radiation-technological purposes that occur under intense irradiation. The possibility of shock-wave generation, as well as of percolation phenomena involving fractal aggregates, has been studied in the search for an ideal thermal insulator.

AI.tldr: 构建了用于研究强辐照下辐射工艺中物理化学过程的复杂介质分形模型，考察冲击波生成与分形聚集体渗流现象，以寻找理想隔热材料。
AI.motivation: 为辐射工艺目的研究强辐照条件下复杂介质中的物理化学过程，并探索理想隔热材料。
AI.method: 构建复杂介质的分形模型，研究冲击波生成以及涉及分形聚集体的渗流现象。
AI.result: 模型可用于考察强辐照下的冲击波生成与分形聚集体的渗流行为。
AI.conclusion: 该分形模型为辐射工艺中复杂介质的行为研究及理想隔热材料的探索提供了分析框架。

title: Local order in natural sanidine disentangled via single crystal diffuse scattering
summary: Natural sanidine commonly preserves metastable chemical disorder at ambient conditions, but the local structural correlations associated with this disorder remain poorly understood due to a reliance on average-structure analysis alone. Here, we investigate single-crystal diffuse scattering in a natural sanidine from Drachenfels, Germany, with consistent observations across additional samples from Laacher See, Germany, and Vesuvio, Italy. The diffraction data reveal pronounced anisotropic diffuse features, including characteristic bowtie-like intensity distributions in reciprocal space. To resolve the origin of these features, we combine three-dimensional difference pair distribution function (3D-$Δ$PDF) analysis with force-field calculations and Monte Carlo modelling. The 3D-$Δ$PDF shows correlated deviations from the average structure and indicates a strong coupling between occupational and displacive disorder. Force-field calculations demonstrate that the aluminosilicate framework responds strongly to the local alkali occupancy, with the largest structural variation occurring along the $a$ direction. Guided by these observations, we construct a disorder model in which K/Na occupational short-range order is combined with chemically constrained Al/Si distributions and local framework relaxations. The model reproduces the main experimental diffuse-scattering features and shows that the bowtie-like diffuse scattering arises from correlated framework distortions driven primarily by local K/Na order.

AI.tldr: 通过单晶漫散射、3D-ΔPDF、力场计算与蒙特卡罗模拟，揭示天然透长石中K/Na占位有序与骨架畸变耦合产生的领结状漫散射起源。
AI.motivation: 天然透长石在常温下保留亚稳态化学无序，但其局部结构关联因仅依赖平均结构分析而认识不足。
AI.method: 对德国Drachenfels及Laacher See、Vesuvio样品进行单晶漫散射测量，结合三维差分对分布函数(3D-ΔPDF)分析、力场计算与蒙特卡罗建模。
AI.result: 衍射显示明显的各向异性漫散射及倒空间领结状强度分布；3D-ΔPDF表明占位无序与位移无序强耦合；力场计算显示铝硅酸盐骨架对局部碱金属占位响应强烈，沿a方向结构变化最大；所建模型重现主要实验特征。
AI.conclusion: 领结状漫散射源于主要由局部K/Na有序驱动的相关骨架畸变，占位-位移耦合是理解透长石化学无序的关键。

title: Subnanometer thermodynamic overlayers on bimetallic nanoparticles
comment: main text: 18 pages, 5 figures; SI: 62 pages, 53 figures
summary: Nanoparticle properties are governed by their surfaces, yet their atomic-scale surface structures remain challenging to predict. Here, we report that bimetallic nanoparticles can form a thermodynamically controlled "shell-dimer" architecture in which one metal forms an overlayer only a few atomic layers thick on another. Using Au-Rh as a model system, atomic-resolution imaging and molecular dynamics show that an ultrathin Au overlayer forms on Rh, stabilized by competition among surface, interfacial, and strain energies. Anisotropic strain limits its growth to the subnanometer scale, and changes in surface chemistry can destabilize the overlayer altogether. Across a range of bimetallic nanoparticles, we found that overlayer formation is associated with elemental immiscibility and lattice mismatch. These findings provide a basis for understanding and controlling surface structures in multimetallic nanoparticles.

AI.tldr: 双金属纳米颗粒可形成热力学稳定的"壳-二聚体"结构，一金属在另一金属上形成几原子层厚的超薄覆盖层，由表面、界面和应变能的竞争稳定。
AI.motivation: 纳米颗粒性质由其表面决定，但其原子级表面结构仍难以预测，需要理解并控制多金属纳米颗粒的表面结构。
AI.method: 以Au-Rh为模型体系，结合原子分辨率成像和分子动力学模拟，并在一系列双金属纳米颗粒中考察覆盖层形成规律。
AI.result: 超薄Au覆盖层在Rh上形成；各向异性应变将其生长限制在亚纳米尺度；表面化学变化可破坏覆盖层；覆盖层形成与元素不混溶性和晶格失配相关。
AI.conclusion: 该发现为理解和控制多金属纳米颗粒的表面结构提供了基础。

title: Atom-Resolved Machine Learning of Dielectric and Piezoelectric Response
summary: Predicting dielectric and piezoelectric responses in structurally complex materials requires large simulation cells, for which density-functional perturbation theory (DFPT) calculations scale as $\mathcal{O}(N^4)$ and become computationally prohibitive. However, machine-learning approaches have remained challenging, limited either by the large amounts of expensive DFPT data required for direct regression or by the cubic cost of reconstruction. We here propose a machine-learning framework that learns the ionic response as an atom-indexed field: DART (Direct Atom-Resolved response-Tensor learning) learns these fields directly and achieves high accuracy from small training sets, whereas LARS (Linear-scaling Atom-Resolved Response Solver) reconstructs them from learned microscopic ingredients through sparse linear solves and requires no DFPT labels for the ionic dielectric or piezoelectric tensors. Using DART, we extrapolate to 314 stackings of AlN/ScN superlattices absent from training and identify a high-response polar candidate, for which DFPT gives a laterally clamped piezoelectric strain coefficient $d_{33,f}=14.511$ pC/N and $k_t^2=20.46\%$, exceeding the ordered 1AlN/1ScN reference by 63% and 66%.

AI.tldr: 提出DART与LARS两个机器学习框架，直接学习原子分辨的离子响应场，用小训练集高精度预测介电与压电张量，无需DFPT标签，并成功外推发现高性能AlN/ScN超晶格压电材料。
AI.motivation: 复杂材料介电与压电响应预测需大模拟胞，DFPT计算随N^4增长而难以承受；现有机器学习方法或需大量昂贵DFPT数据做直接回归，或重建成本为立方级，均受限。
AI.method: 将离子响应建模为原子索引场：DART直接学习响应张量场，小训练集即可高精度；LARS通过学习微观要素并结合稀疏线性求解重建响应，训练无需DFPT标签（针对离子介电/压电张量）。
AI.result: 利用DART外推至训练集外的314种AlN/ScN超晶格堆叠构型，识别出高响应极性候选；DFPT验证其横向钳制压电应变系数d33,f=14.511 pC/N，k_t^2=20.46%，较有序1AlN/1ScN参考分别提升63%和66%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以低成本、少数据实现复杂结构介电/压电响应的高精度预测与材料发现，可有效加速高性能压电材料筛选。

title: Crystal symmetry predicts unconventional magnetism
summary: Unconventional compensated magnets combine zero net magnetization with momentum-dependent spin polarization, but identifying them usually requires knowledge of their magnetic order. Here we show that crystal symmetry can constrain unconventional magnetic character before the magnetic ground state is known. Starting from a non-magnetic crystal structure and a specified magnetic sublattice, we generate symmetry-compatible compensated orders and classify their spin textures using spin-space-group symmetry. We identify materials whose generated candidates are all unconventional, either across a defined search space or after restricting the magnetic-cell size. Within the experimental benchmark, 68% of the prioritized materials are unconventional, compared with 9% of the remaining materials. Screening the Materials Project yields thousands of promising candidates for unconventional compensated magnetism. First-principles calculations for $\mathrm{VGe_3}$ and tetragonal $\mathrm{Fe_2SiO_4}$ connect these symmetry predictions to the energetics and spin textures of competing magnetic orders. In $\mathrm{VGe_3}$, a noncoplanar candidate permits mixed-wave spin polarization along a fixed axis without spin-orbit coupling, combining components that are odd and even under momentum reversal. This framework enables crystallography-guided searches for unconventional compensated magnets without first determining their magnetic ground states.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种仅依赖晶体对称性、无需预先知道磁基态即可识别非常规补偿磁体的方法，并在Materials Project中筛选出数千候选材料。
AI.motivation: 非常规补偿磁体兼具零净磁化与动量依赖的自旋极化，但传统识别方法需要先确定磁序，成本高且受限。
AI.method: 从非磁晶体结构和指定磁子晶格出发，生成对称性允许的补偿磁序，并用自旋空间群对称性对自旋织构分类；通过限定搜索空间或磁胞尺寸筛出候选全为非常规的材料，并用第一性原理计算验证VGe₃和四方Fe₂SiO₄。
AI.result: 实验基准中优先材料68%为非常规，其余材料仅9%；筛选Materials Project得到数千个候选。VGe₃中非共面候选在无自旋轨道耦合下实现沿固定轴的混合波自旋极化，兼具动量反演下的奇偶分量。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了无需先确定磁基态的晶体学引导式非常规补偿磁体搜索。

title: From Processing to Functionality: Engineering Accessible Material States in Cu-Embedded SiO$_x$ Memristive Devices
summary: Resistive switching in oxide-based devices is widely governed by stochastic defect processes, yet a predictive link between fabrication conditions and functional behavior remains elusive. Here, we establish a multiscale framework connecting plasma-defined deposition conditions to macroscopic device functionality in sputtered SiO$_x$/Cu/SiO$_x$-based systems. By combining large-scale statistical analysis of more than 50,000 experimentally characterized devices with physics-based plasma and atomistic simulations, we show that device behavior does not emerge from deterministic process-to-performance mappings, but from a probabilistic cascade spanning defect formation, defect-state evolution, and functional-regime emergence. Data-driven clustering reveals a continuous functional state space composed of operational switching types, while inverse modeling identifies the reconstructed oxygen-vacancy density as an effective latent descriptor capturing the combined influence of structural disorder and defect topology. This latent descriptor is strongly coupled to both Cu redistribution and electrical response, linking otherwise hidden material properties to observable device characteristics. Furthermore, macroscopic switching behavior is argued to arise from ensemble integration across spatially heterogeneous subdomains, providing a physical explanation for the pronounced variability of large-area devices. These findings shift the perspective from deterministic defect engineering toward probabilistic defect-state design and establish a physically grounded framework for understanding and controlling functional variability in such oxide-based systems, such as memristive or resistive-switching devices.

AI.tldr: 该论文建立了一个多尺度框架，将溅射SiO_x/Cu/SiO_x系统的等离子体沉积条件与宏观器件功能行为联系起来，提出器件行为源于概率性缺陷级联而非确定性工艺-性能映射。
AI.motivation: 氧化物基阻变器件的行为主要由随机缺陷过程主导，但制造条件与功能行为之间缺乏可预测的联系，亟需建立从工艺到功能的物理关联框架。
AI.method: 结合超过5万个器件的实验统计分析与基于物理的等离子体和原子模拟，运用数据驱动聚类和逆向建模，识别出重构氧空位密度作为有效潜在描述符。
AI.result: 数据聚类揭示了由操作开关类型构成的连续功能状态空间；逆向建模识别出重构氧空位密度为有效潜在描述符，其与Cu再分布和电响应强耦合；宏观开关行为源于空间异质子域的系综整合，解释了大面积器件的显著变异性。
AI.conclusion: 研究将视角从确定性缺陷工程转向概率性缺陷态设计，为理解和控制氧化物基（如忆阻器或阻变器件）系统中的功能变异性提供了物理基础框架。

title: AI-guided high-throughput discovery of iridium- and ruthenium-free palladium-oxide catalysts for durable acidic oxygen evolution
summary: Catalyzing acidic oxygen evolution at the proton-exchange-membrane water electrolysis (PEMWE) anode relies almost entirely on iridium or ruthenium, drawn from concentrated supply chains that constrain gigawatt-scale deployment. We report an artificial intelligence (AI)-guided, human-supervised closed-loop platform (>90% automation) integrating combinatorial sputter synthesis, high-throughput screening, machine-learning composition-property models, adaptive multi-objective optimization, and context-aware large-language-model reasoning, where lead catalysts advanced to long-term validation in 1 M H2SO4 at 10 mA cm-2. Navigating a combinatorial metal oxide space, the platform iteratively evaluated the activity-stability trade-off of 2,942 catalysts across 53 material systems and 26 elements, surfacing Ir- and Ru-free complex oxides such as InMnPdOx and NiTaPdOx that conventional design logic, and off-the-shelf language models, would not predict. In retrospective benchmarking, our sequential learning agent advanced the activity-stability frontier faster than fixed-policy Bayesian optimization or in-context language-model selection. During long-term testing, NiTaPdOx operated at lower overpotential than PdOx, but both eventually exceeded 0.5 V: PdOx at ~200 h and NiTaPdOx at ~470 h. InMnPdOx showed a similar overpotential improvement in addition to a dramatic increase in operational stability, retaining overpotential below 0.5 V over 1,000 h of operation. The additive elements promote the formation of a nanostructure that is associated with catalytic activity while stabilizing Pd against corrosion. The results highlight the power of AI-driven science in addressing long-standing challenges in materials chemistry, and the greater availability of Pd relative to incumbent Ir and Ru offers a near-term option to ease supply constraints on scaled electrochemical H2 generation.

AI.tldr: 本文报道一个AI引导、人类监督的闭环平台（>90%自动化），通过组合溅射合成、高通量筛选、机器学习模型、多目标优化和LLM推理，在2942种催化剂中发现了无Ir/Ru的复杂氧化物（InMnPdOx、NiTaPdOx），其中InMnPdOx在1 M H2SO4、10 mA cm-2下稳定运行超1000 h且过电位低于0.5 V。
AI.motivation: PEMWE阳极的酸性析氧反应几乎完全依赖Ir和Ru，其供应链集中于少数地区，限制了吉瓦级规模化部署，亟需寻找供应更充足的替代催化剂。
AI.method: 构建AI引导、人类监督的闭环平台（>90%自动化），整合组合溅射合成、高通量筛选、机器学习成分-性能模型、自适应多目标优化及上下文感知LLM推理；在组合金属氧化物空间中迭代评估2942种催化剂的活性-稳定性权衡，并以长周期测试（1 M H2SO4、10 mA cm-2）验证。
AI.result: 覆盖53个材料体系、26种元素，发现InMnPdOx和NiTaPdOx等无Ir/Ru复杂氧化物；序贯学习智能体在活性-稳定性前沿推进速度上优于固定策略贝叶斯优化和上下文LLM选择；NiTaPdOx过电位低于PdOx但分别在约470 h和约200 h超过0.5 V，InMnPdOx则在1000 h以上保持过电位低于0.5 V。添加剂元素促进纳米结构形成，提升活性并稳定Pd抗腐蚀。
AI.conclusion: AI驱动科学可解决材料化学长期挑战；Pd相对Ir/Ru供应更充足，为缓解规模化电解制氢的供应约束提供了近期可行方案。

title: Molecular Beam Epitaxy of AgTaO3
summary: We report the first synthesis of single-crystal AgTaO3 thin films using molecular-beam epitaxy (MBE). High-quality epitaxial AgTaO3 films were grown on both (001)- and (111)-oriented SrTiO3 substrates using sequential deposition of atomic silver and TaO2 layers under an ozone/oxygen atmosphere (80 % O3 + 20 % O2). X-ray diffrac- tion and reciprocal space mapping demonstrate that the films are coherently strained to the SrTiO3 substrates with sharp rocking curves comparable to the substrates, indicating high structural perfection. High-angle annular dark-field scanning trans- mission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) confirms coherent, low defect growth for (001)pc-oriented films. For (111)pc-oriented films, initial coherent growth proceeds up to 10 nm before transitioning into a Ta-rich surface region. Energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) reveals a narrow cation intermixing region at the sub- strate interface for both orientations. This work demonstrates an effective synthesis route for single-crystal AgTaO3 thin films, providing a platform to investigate strain engineering and emergent interfacial properties in silver-based tantalates.

AI.tldr: 首次用MBE合成单晶AgTaO3薄膜，在SrTiO3(001)和(111)衬底上实现高质量外延，为银基钽酸盐应变工程和界面研究提供平台。
AI.motivation: AgTaO3作为银基钽酸盐具有潜在的有趣物理性质，但此前缺乏单晶薄膜的合成方法，限制了应变工程和界面性质的研究。
AI.method: 采用分子束外延，在臭氧/氧气（80% O3+20% O2）气氛下，通过原子银与TaO2层的顺序沉积，在(001)和(111)取向SrTiO3衬底上生长AgTaO3薄膜；用XRD、倒易空间映射、HAADF-STEM和EDX进行表征。
AI.result: 薄膜与衬底共格应变，摇摆曲线尖锐（与衬底相当），结构完整度高；(001)pc取向薄膜缺陷少、生长共格；(111)pc取向薄膜初始共格生长至约10 nm后转变为富Ta表面区；两种取向界面均有窄的阳离子互混区。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了单晶AgTaO3薄膜的有效合成路线，为研究银基钽酸盐的应变工程及新兴界面性质提供了材料平台。
